games.name: A Bumpy Ride
games.summary: Take a jaunt into the world of A Bumpy Ride, a casual train-driving and exploration game! Inspired by railroading of the 19th century with a whimsical spin, you'll adventure around the open frontier in your trusty little train, picking up passengers and freight.

games.name: A Smithing Game
games.summary: A Smithing Game is an online 2-4 player game where you smith weapons and fight other players with them.

games.name: AFK Tactics
games.summary: No level ups. No brainrot progression. AFK Tactics is a strategic autobattler where choices matter. Your party grows through adaptative synergies, skills & items, not XP bars. 200+ heroes with unique passives, traits & classes, 30+ factions with differents playstyle, mecanics. Theorycraft, conquer.

games.name: ASCII Survivors
games.summary: Everything is ASCII. A survivor-like roguelite where every monster, bullet, and explosion is made of text on a CRT screen. 8 characters, 16 weapons, 6 enchantments, 4 game modes. See how long your terminal holds.

games.name: Age of Gods
games.summary: A competitive turn-based strategy game where positioning, unit synergy, and map control decide everything. Capture structures, build your army, and outplay your opponents in tactical battles with up to 8 players.

games.name: Agebringer
games.summary: The Crimson Core has been stolen. The end of the world draws near. The thief hides high atop the Infinity Tower. Gather your courage, take up your weapons... The Red Crusade has begun.

games.name: Almost Nearly Borderline Perfect
games.summary:
a girl forms a crush on an older woman in the middle of an alcoholic spiral

Adelaide has been alone for a long time and values privacy above all. Her peaceful life is interrupted when she has a one night stand with an employee who seems to care about her a bit too much.

games.name: Andon
games.summary: Play as a wanderer in the grim, post-nuclear future. Trapped in an decrepit building in the City of Andon, you must use your drone piloting skills to locate and retrieve parts to repair your radio. Meanwhile, your supplies run low, and you're constantly at risk of starvation and hypothermia.

games.name: Arcane Angler
games.summary:
Arcane Angler is a fishing MMORPG where players embark on an adventure to catch rare and mystical fish, level up their skills, collect powerful gears, and compete on global leaderboards.

Explore different fishing locations, battle anomalies, complete quests, and become the ultimate angler in this ever-evolving fishing universe.

games.name: Artsec
games.summary: A short, science themed story game about a secret research facility - dedicated to unwrap the mystery behind strange, otherworldly objects. Meet unique characters, prove your worth, work in the laboratories - and lose your mind.

games.name: Ashes Remember Us
games.summary: Ashes Remember Us is a horde-based roguelike with tower-defense elements. Protect your fire, build deadly traps, customize your weapons, and face endless mutant hordes and vicious bosses. Every run is different – how long can you survive?

games.name: Becoming Captain
games.summary: Dive into a unique Roguelike Deckbuilder experience with Becoming Captain, set in a sci-fi realm where piracy is nearly eradicated—except on the notorious Calamity. Will you become its captain or die trying?

games.name: Betrayed
games.summary: Enter Betrayed, a 3-16 player party shooter where trust is scarce, and deception is paramount. Navigate diverse maps, use proximity voice chat to strategize, and earn currency for traitorous tools. Will you prove innocence or master deception? Gather your friends for suspense and laughter!

games.name: Bio Fail
games.summary: Bio Fail is a dark 2D platformer where you play as a biological anomaly—a monster that possesses humans. Control their bodies, fight your way through levels, solve puzzles, and destroy everything in your path. One body—one chance

games.name: Bomberball
games.summary: Bomberball is a sci-fi multiplayer sports-shooter hybrid with class-based loadouts. Run, pass, and throw a planet-killer bomb into the opposing team’s rift. Fight in tightly-crafted arenas, and coordinate formations with your teammates. Experience the fast-paced, strategic combat of the future.

games.name: Books of Horror
games.summary: Books of Horror is a first-person horror game where you face Airana, a mysterious AI that controls your captivity. To escape, you must overcome procedurally generated simulations based on ancient “Books of Horror”

games.name: Bow-wow Battle
games.summary: Be a dog. Bark. And win. "Bow-wow Battle" is a 1v1 game where you bark into your mic for real! Steam Online Multiplayer supported! Push the tug-of-war gauge with voice volume and rapid-fire barks! Adorable dogs, Dog Road story mode, and Crab Survival. With friends, family, or your crush — bark out!

games.name: Bright Lights of Svetlov
games.summary: Bright Lights of Svetlov is a short, story-focused first person quest about a Soviet family facing harsh trials. Set in a fictional provincial town, it carefuly recreates the atmosphere and vibe of mid 1980s.

games.name: Canine Derby Manager
games.summary: Manage your dog racing kennel in this management sim. Carefully craft you routine for training , hire the best staff and work your way from bottom of E-Rank to Champion status!

games.name: CardBoard
games.summary: CardBoard captures the fun of a board game with the deep strategy of a roguelike deckbuilder. Gather companions or brave it alone. Choose from a variety of characters with unique cards and dice, and battle across dynamic themed boards. No healer required—just a little faith in the cards.

games.name: Catmarine
games.summary: Catmarine is a chaotic, co-operative, typing game. Type to navigate through an ocean world with your cat submarine, the Catmarine! Use the various terminals inside of the Catmarine to maneuver it and to defend against oceanic dangers. Communicate, collaborate, and type as fast as you can!

games.name: Chess 2048
games.summary: Chess 2048 – Classic chess moves meet fresh puzzle-strategy twists: watch the board reshape, adapt on the fly, and master piece combos. Then escape poison gas, jump between water tiles, use portals, and pull off clever tricks.

games.name: Color Connect
games.summary: Color Connect is a fun puzzle game where you connect dots of the same color to score points!

games.name: Common Loot
games.summary: Common Loot is an interactive music video for MC Frontalot's song of the same name. It can be completed within roughly the length of the song (2:56). In this simple dungeon crawler, players must kill enemies and gather loot to sell.

games.name: Constance
games.summary: Constance is a 2D hand-drawn action adventure featuring a paintbrush-wielding artist, striving to escape from a colorful but decaying inner-world, created by her declining mental health.

games.name: Country of Snow
games.summary:
The Ageless Winter. A curse that was cast upon Canada. A never-ending winter that withers the land. The only way to stop the curse to cut out the root of the curse, an agent of the Calamity, the sinister Ice Witch herself!

Join Cedrick, a Knight of Narvikk, whose sworn duty is to preserve the land. Thus, he must vanquish the Ice Witch! In his efforts to put an end to the Ageless Winter, he gathers allies and a share of adversaries as well.

Here is hoping that he can put an end to the curse by the end of his journey.

games.name: Cozy Farm Manager
games.summary: Cozy farming meets management sim - Hire and develop a team of farmhands, fulfill major contracts, combat pests with chemicals or biodiversity, and manage a limited water supply. Grow your farm’s reputation through thoughtful planning, sustainable choices, and smart business decisions!

games.name: Cozy Snow Friends
games.summary: Glide down the snowy slopes, meet adorable characters, ride the cable car, and simply enjoy the moment.

games.name: Cube Kingdoms
games.summary: You are the Lord of a small village in a medieval fantasy world. Build your kingdom by expanding your economy, defending yourself, recruiting troops, making your people happy (or not), all while your neighbors are breathing down your neck.

games.name: Curse: The First Knot
games.summary: Curse: The First Knot delivers an atmosphere-driven psychological horror experience, built on environmental storytelling and a slowly escalating tension rather than constant shock. Jump scares are merely a tool; the true fear lies in realizing what is happening, piece by piece.

games.name: Cybro
games.summary: Government gig becomes personal. Return to a corrupt city on a contract to recover stolen software, only to uncover a conspiracy. Fight back with guns, stealth, hacking, and raw action as betrayal hits close and escape becomes the only way out.

games.name: Dark Pals
games.summary: In this singleplayer mascot horror game you're trapped in an abandoned children’s asylum. Solve twisted puzzles with your Ink Blaster, evade its disturbing mascots, and uncover secrets you had long forgotten about. Do you remember?

games.name: Data Duty
games.summary: Congratulations on your new position as Chief Technology Officer of Dubitably Data! Learn about cybersecurity as you survive cyber-based disasters, complete objectives, explore, and interact with the custom 3D office environment! All in a fun little indie game!

games.name: Dating 4 Girls
games.summary:
"Heartbroken Player" is a live action interactive video game. As a "cow and horse" in the company, on the night when the comet arrived, you unexpectedly traveled into a love game. In order to return to the real world before shutting down in seven days, you must complete the "love" task assigned by Police Flower Andy. You thought you were in love with the game characters you created, Mona, Feifei, and Heyi, so easy! However, they repeatedly encountered obstacles. With the help of your best friend Arlo, you step back into the world of girls and discover that the attributes you set at will have a huge impact on their lives. With deeper contact, you finally understand that 'although the characters are virtual, the love between you is real'. In the end, under your influence, the girls unexpectedly broke through the system settings and developed self-awareness. You decided to work together to prevent the game server from shutting down!

Please make your choice carefully!!!

games.name: Devil of the Plague
games.summary:
Devil of the Plague is a 1–4 player co-op horror and survival game set in a dark ritual world.
Play as plague doctors, explore cursed locations, complete rituals, survive infected creatures, and face the ancient demon ASAG. Work together with your team, manage limited resources, and escape before the plague consumes you.

games.name: Die in the Dungeon
games.summary: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

games.name: Dostavka
games.summary: In DOSTAVKA, you’ll have to survive an alien invasion — but even worse, survive a shift as a fast food worker!

games.name: Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape
games.summary: Survive the Experiment

games.name: DripDrip
games.summary: If your computer was given a double-dose of Benadryl, this is the nightmare it'd have. How much blood can you keep while you study and work?

games.name: Early Bird Gets the Space Worm
games.summary: Early Bird gets the Space Worm is a small, casual, incremental game about collecting Space Worms. Explore the expansive skill tree to unlock ever larger birds, upgradeable weapons, and destroy all the things.

games.name: Emoji Bomb
games.summary: A collection of super-fast micro-games in just 5 seconds! Challenge records with reflexes and concentration in a variety of emoji mini-games!

games.name: Exit Loops: Street 001
games.summary: You are trapped in a never-ending street loop. Observe your surroundings carefully and identify anomalies. Make the right choice at the end of each street and try to escape the loop.

games.name: FinCrementalOS
games.summary: Blast away with a submarine's cannon and sort your desktop for minigames in this incremental fish shooting and simulated operating system hybrid!

games.name: Finalloop
games.summary: 《FINALLOOP》 is a roguelike game that combines real-time combat with deckbuilding mechanics. Engage in fast-paced battles where every decision matters, face ever-changing enemies and challenges, and build unique decks to craft your ultimate tactical playstyle!

games.name: Forehead Chip
games.summary: FOREHEAD CHIP is a cyberpunk narrative platformer where you play as Chip, a recruit in the IMPLANT CORPS. Capture as many HOLDOUTS as you can to get on the scoreboard, explore a divided city, uncover secret twists, and most importantly, win the FOREHEAD CHIP!

games.name: Gamble With Your Friends
games.summary: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.

games.name: Gambonanza
games.summary: Gambonanza is a mind-bending roguelike where every move counts. Unlock over 100 innovative Gambits and harness powerful synergy with your chess pieces to transform your board into a festival of explosive combos and tactical twists!

games.name: GladiEaters
games.summary: Cook and command teams of living food in this narrative creature battler. GladiEATers blends seven chef stories in top-down JRPG adventures and roguelike gauntlets, featuring 6v6 battles, spicy cooking minigames and online multiplayer.

games.name: Glitchers
games.summary:
Lost in a strange universe, Trix must team up with a brute-force heroine on the brink of death to find the pieces of a legendary armor and defeat a cruel Emperor who seeks to wipe out all the heroes of the Ruled Earth.

On this journey, Trix faces ruthless enemies in dynamic battles, unleashing powerful strikes and special skills, along with an incredible power—the ability to hack this universe and create epic combos.

In each hack, players combine hacking gems to trigger chain reactions, defeating enemies and solving puzzles along the way.

games.name: Goblin Vyke: The Thief Tycoon
games.summary: At night, you're a thief, sneaking into dungeons to steal goods. By day, you're a cunning merchant, haggle to sell at high prices. Master the art of stealth, steal the Demon Lord's hidden treasures. Recruit employees, expand your business. Grow from a penniless goblin to a black market tycoon!

games.name: Godway: Only Up Simulator
games.summary: A breathtaking run on rails to the heavens! Godway tests you with dynamic obstacles, platform jumping, and escalating difficulty. Fall, rise again, and push your limits to claim your place beside the god at the summit. The path to immortality begins here.

games.name: Golf Around 2
games.summary: It's time to Golf Around... 2! Golf madness for up to 16 players! Tactically use grenades, weapons, and perks to navigate around crazy maps. Level up and trick out your character. Play custom maps!

games.name: Golf-Like
games.summary: Golf-Like is a minimalist indie golf game focused on precision, physics, and compact level design. Each level is designed as a small puzzle where every shot matters, encouraging thoughtful play rather than speed or randomness. Simple controls combine with increasingly complex mechanics to create a focused and rewarding gameplay experience.

games.name: Gravity Shooter
games.summary:
Control the ball with gravity, destroy approaching enemies, and survive the onslaught!
Gravity Shooter is a sci-fi shooter that incorporates Bullet Heaven elements.

- A fresh shooter experience with gravity manipulation! -
Unlike typical shooting games, your main weapon is a "ball".
Operate the ball using the gravity generation device, "Gravity Shield".
Freely manipulate this ball to destroy enemies, collect items, and obtain further weapons and skills!

- Fight using a wide variety of weapons and skills! -
Level up by acquiring items or obtain equipment capsules to gain powerful weapons and skills.
Combine a wide variety of weapons and skills to survive the ever-intensifying enemy onslaught!

- Conquer diverse stages and enemies! -
Unique stages are available in this game, each with its own characteristic enemies and bosses.
Conquer all stages and defeat the formidable enemies you have yet to see!

games.name: Heave-Ho: Uphill
games.summary: A punishing physics-based co-op game where you and your friends must push a vehicle to the top of the world. Coordinate your moves and overcome brutal obstacles. With no checkpoints, one wrong push means starting over. Are you ready to reach the peak or lose your friends trying?

games.name: Hook & Roll
games.summary: Roll, swing, and boost your way through this fast-paced third-person platforming driving game. Hop on your Monowheel, master your hook, find the perfect line, and beat the clock to rise through the ranks of the Roller Tournament.

games.name: Hover Point
games.summary: Hover Point is a minimalist bullet hell where you don’t need to press a single button. Your movement is your weapon. Experience pure arcade action as you dodge chaotic patterns and auto-fire at swarming enemies. Whether you use mouse, keyboard, or controller. it’s high-intensity survival made simple

games.name: Ice Age
games.summary: As primitive human, in the wild Ice Age prehistoric world, Hunt and tame wild beasts such as mammoths and sabretooth, build homes, and survive.

games.name: Intertwined
games.summary: A 2D metroidvania where your final boss is the character you didn’t choose. Play as Seren or Umbra—Master directional spear combat, explore a broken world, and uncover the truth behind your bond.

games.name: Katanegai
games.summary:
A censored port of Katanegai.
Upon learning of their parents' passing, the Minami siblings—Seia and Nagi—returned to their ancestral village.
With few villagers remaining, they settled into a quiet life together...
But when Nagi fell gravely ill, Seia sought help at the shrine—where he encountered a mysterious black-clad shrine maiden named Yami.
This is a tale of defiling wishes to fulfill the—all to save the one most precious to you.

games.name: Koloboke: Sickness Simulator
games.summary: This is a difficult game that takes the best from Dark Souls - the rolls Combined with a first-person camera, it turns into a truly butt-blasting mix

games.name: LaVonne's Bouncing Idle
games.summary: A satisfying physics-based idle game where you deploy an army of neon bouncing balls to obliterate geometric blocks. Buy crazy upgraded balls, level up your lab, and watch the numbers scale into infinity.

games.name: Lavalads
games.summary: A chaotic local multiplayer brawler where up to 4 players duel on a shrinking lava island. Play free-for-all or in teams, draft powerful spells, and knock rivals into the flames to be the last standing Lavalad.

games.name: LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom
games.summary:
LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom is a funny point-and-click adventure game set in a medieval kingdom where nothing is as it seems. What starts out as a simple quest quickly turns into a tangle of puzzles, strange items and quirky characters. Explore, combine, question - just don't get more involved than necessary!

Get ready for hours of fun, unexpected twists and turns... and a little love story.

games.name: Lumo Idle Park
games.summary:
Welcome to Lumo Idle Park a relaxing idle game with a visual style inspired by the colorful, vibrant world of early 2000s Sega games.

If you grew up with a Dreamcast or remember that golden era of bold, bright arcade-style graphics — Lumo Idle Park was made with that spirit in mind.

games.name: Lunar Strike
games.summary: Lunar Strike blends speculative fiction with a game world grounded in hard science. The game focuses on compelling survival and character-driven storytelling over combat. A race against time to preserve the evidence of humanity’s presence on the Moon before its inevitable collapse and destruction.

games.name: Maelstrom
games.summary: Maelstrom is a licensed open source port of the original shareware game for the Macintosh by Ambrosia Software, Inc. It is a fast-action, asteroids-like game, with classic pixel graphics and original sounds.

games.name: Matreshka
games.summary: Matreshka is a first-person psychological horror experience, you must navigate a maze of old soviet building by elevator. Searching for a way to escape.

games.name: Mayor May Knott
games.summary: A creepy-cozy 3D adventure, about a shy girl who accidentally becomes mayor of a haunted ghost town.

games.name: Meltopia
games.summary: A minimalist game where you venture into a snowy world filled with mysteries and glacial secrets. Explore by melting snow with a heat cannon, collect valuable resources and ancient artifacts, and rescue frozen characters. But most importantly — find and assemble the remains of an ancient Mammoth!

games.name: Memoria Arcana
games.summary: A single-player card game of memory and fate. Reveal cards to form poker-style combos, earn points, and overcome cursed stages that twist your field. Unlock and upgrade Arcana cards to alter runs and reshape destiny with every turn.

games.name: Mike Goes on Hike
games.summary: Become a real tourist in Mike Goes on Hike! Amazing wild landscapes, inexpressible atmosphere of hiking and important vital lessons are waiting for you. Go all the way to the end to fulfill the request of your beloved grandfather.

games.name: Mining Merchant
games.summary: Your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life. Mine precious ore, smelt it into shiny jewelry, add rare gemstones and sell to every customer who walks in. Mine by day, sell by night, solo or in co-op, and become a successful merchant.

games.name: Miskatonic
games.summary: Miskatonic is a text-based strategy game where players take the role of an ancient god, determined to harvest fear for power. Incept your victims through dialogues with their psyche, study the limits of their mind by unlocking their stories, and manipulate the maze with powerful abilities.

games.name: Monster Lily
games.summary: A Deeply Tactical ASCII Roguelike with unique and often surprising mechanics. Explore Hanwu Divinity College and uncover its secrets.

games.name: Monster Ops 18
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: MrToilet
games.summary: MrToilet is a demonic toilet monster who has possessed your toilet, craft the right poo, then feed it into his mouth using your ass!

games.name: Mythic Kart Maker
games.summary: Mythic Kart Maker is fantasy kart racing level editor, with vehicular combat, whimsical characters, & a vibrant 3D prerendered art-style, with gameplay akin to classic "kart racers".

games.name: Nemunai
games.summary:
Retro survival horror inspired by Japanese folklore.
Explore a cursed village, uncover its dark truth, and face deformed creatures in direct 2D fighting-style combat.

games.name: Our Bad Ending
games.summary: A girl’s dark, romantic desire for her best friend and the spiral of pursuing a doomed love.

games.name: Password Manager
games.summary: Password Manager is a free browser-based party game for 2-6 players. Players receive a call from Ralph, a panicked office worker whose boss has been locked out of his computer. Players work together using word association to build a long, memorable password from a box of floppy disks found on the desk. Each player must justify how their chosen word connects to the previous one. Once the password is complete, players must remember and re-enter it correctly with only three attempts. Best played in person or on a call with friends.

games.name: Path of The Runecaster
games.summary: Defeat massive hordes of enemies to grow ever more powerful! Unlock new runes and spells to create insane combinations! Gain tons of experience and learn the true meaning of the Runecaster’s path.

games.name: Pennies 12
games.summary: A roguelike coin-flipping arcade machine.

games.name: People are Tools
games.summary: Your friends are your only gear! In this chaotic co-op adventure, use your teammates as pickaxes, grapples, and tools to navigate procedurally generated caves and find fuel for your ship. Just remember: you’re not alone down here…

games.name: Pixel Clicker
games.summary: A pixel art-style clicker game where you tap to blast pixels and bosses, upgrade, automate, and travel through diverse biomes, from lush jungles to the far reaches of space, all wrapped in an immersive soundscape. Climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate pixel boss.

games.name: Plantera 2: Golden Acorn
games.summary: The round blue Helpers return to tend to the garden once more and grow the big magical oak tree that have been rumored to have placed its seed there. Tend to the oak tree and grow it to the sky to harvest its Golden Acorns.

games.name: Pogo With Friends
games.summary: Team up with your friends with your pogo sticks and pass the obstacles! Reach the highest peak in this adventure playable with up to 4 friends. Pass through villages and caves, but be careful of the bosses. Let's see if you can reach the treasure waiting for you with your friends?

games.name: Project DevourSlime
games.summary: A platformer… but you can take the platforms with you!?Control DevourSlime and solve puzzles by absorbing and shooting out the platforms near you.Battle corrupted lab machinery and hostile contaminants, stay ahead of the toxic gas, and rescue your companions.Plan your own unique escape route!

games.name: Protocol: Zero-Day
games.summary: Protocol: Zero-Day is a brutal and fast-paced Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Wield your electric baton, master lightning-fast dashes, and survive endless hordes of corrupted anomalies. Navigate the shattered digital grid, upgrade your stats, and purge the system before you are overrun. Pure skill, zero compromises.

games.name: Proton VR
games.summary: ProtonVR is a VR Roguelike/Roguelite Retro Shooter dream-inspired by classic 90s shooters and movies. Customize your weapons arsenal, buy attachments, upgrades and choose your playstyle. Fight commandos, cyborgs, robots, zombies and much more!

games.name: Quiet in the Library
games.summary: Quiet in the Library is a point and click horror game about working the night shift in a library while danger lurks.

games.name: Red: Flame & Fable
games.summary: Will you succumb to the darkness or cleave through it with your lantern? Red: Flame & Fable is a handcrafted 2D platforming action-adventure which follows the story of Red. Red must defeat terrifying creatures, find her family and fight back against the darkness imbued by the flower curse.

games.name: Rock Quest: A Rhythm Adventure
games.summary: Rock Quest: A Rhythm Adventure is a hybrid rhythm-action RPG where battles play out as high-stakes musical showdowns. Hit notes in time to attack, miss and take damage. Lead your rock band through a weird New Orleans teeming with danger and mystery.

games.name: Rogue Voltage
games.summary: The engineering roguelike. Construct your combos by wiring circuits. Build crazy machines to zap the monsters and trigger satisfying chain reactions. Discover devastating synergies and create overpowered builds.

games.name: Rooster Wars Arena: MFC Combat Battle
games.summary: Small fighters. Big battles.

games.name: Rootnote
games.summary: Your mission in this singleplayer adventure-survival game is to restore the forest's decaying life force. Cleanse the infested root by uniting the powers of the guardians and using their music. Build a boat or swing with your vine to discover new places.

games.name: S.O.R.N.
games.summary: S.O.R.N. is a 3rd-person mecha action shooter with fast paced combat and lots of customization.

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: SpookY2K
games.summary: You wake up on a cold bathroom floor, only to discover that you somehow time travelled to a Halloween party in 1999! As you try to make sense of your situation and get closer to the other guests, will your clueless involvement let the party take a deadly turn?

games.name: Stab!
games.summary: STAB! is a competitive 2–4 player card game where the only rule that matters is simple: trust no one. Build temporary alliances and betray them at the exact moment it hurts the most! In this game, loyalty is an illusion and survival depends on how well you can deceive everyone at the table.

games.name: Stubborn Shibas
games.summary: A tricky puzzle game full of some seriously stubborn Shibas!

games.name: Sugoi Adventure! DragonSlayer
games.summary: A game of choices where you get to become a hero, impress hot girls, and slay a dragon. Choose your own adventure and make it truly sugoi!

games.name: Summer Haze/Glory Days
games.summary: Go on a cross-country tour with your band in pursuit of fame, success, and happiness in this drama visual novel set during the summer of 2007.

games.name: Sunshore City
games.summary: Sunny paradise awaits!

games.name: Terminal Breaker
games.summary: After infiltrating the famous testing site known as Light City, you are tasked with destroying it once and for all.

games.name: The Aurora Chronicles
games.summary: A crew of four. Mysteries at the edge of known space. A utopia that might be more fragile than it appears. The Aurora Chronicles is an episodic sci-fi visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover buried secrets, and test whether hope can survive what you discover.

games.name: The Bunker Notes
games.summary: "The Bunker Notes" is a visual novel about a concrete trap where the past whispers through the cracks of rusted doors. In this world, survival is everything; meeting another person might be your last mistake.

games.name: The Curse 404
games.summary: The Curse 404 is a psychological horror puzzle game set inside a mysterious house trapped in a repeating time loop. Each time you awaken, the environment resets but the clues you discover remain.

games.name: The End Comes Tomorrow: Gamebook Edition
games.summary:
A narrative choice adventure about the end of the world.
Live out your last day on earth however you please. Your choices will quickly veer into the unpredictable.

games.name: The Endless Village
games.summary: Automate your growth, uncover a gorgeous city, and chase the ultimate metric: Liveliness. This cozy idle clicker lets you unlock passive income boosts and powerful minigames to rapidly scale your empire. Attract every unique citizen and claim your spot on the global leaderboard!

games.name: The Martial World of Drinking: Wu Song
games.summary: In Wu Song, you will step into the passionate Water Margin world as the hero Wu Song and embark on a unique card-based strategic adventure!

games.name: This is Fine: Maximum Cope
games.summary: The world famous meme debuts in his first video game. Play as Question Hound in a retro adventure platformer, traversing perilous pits and enraged enemies to overcome the manifestations of his anxieties!

games.name: Tidesworn
games.summary: A Viking-themed MMORPG

games.name: Time Kings: Modern War in Medieval Age
games.summary: Modern firepower. Medieval chaos. Survive the impossible.

games.name: To the Sunset
games.summary: Yuto, a lethargic shut-in, steps out into the outside world through the “action button,” which becomes active when pressed. A 3D adventure game that lets you look into Youto's daily life while making full use of the action buttons.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Side-Scroller Edition
games.summary:
This project reimagines the classic Tomb Raider games through a 2D side-scrolling lens.

Re-experience familiar locations, redesigned with new platforming challenges and traps unique to the side-scrolling perspective!

It features 10 stages, taking Lara Croft across iconic locations such as India, Greece, and Venice!

Hidden throughout the game are 100 optional Golden Crystals for players seeking full completion. A hidden bonus stage is unlocked after completing the game with all 100 Crystals collected!

games.name: Totem
games.summary: Totem is a contemplative and spiritual experience in which you successively embody three totem animals: a bird, a wolf, and an elephant. Each animal represents a stage of an inner journey, guiding the player through the memories and emotions that shape a lifetime.

games.name: Unknown Entity
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Unknown Entity, a strange being with no form or memories, who will fight trapped bosses in the hope of discovering where it is, who it is, and why it seems to be watched at all times, in this Free To Play game.

games.name: Waifu Cam Girl
games.summary: Build your own streaming empire! Help your charming waifu cam girl attract viewers, collect likes, and become more and more successful with clever upgrades.

games.name: What You Don't See
games.summary: What You Don’t See is a first-person paranormal horror game with narrative elements supported by environmental and character-driven storytelling. The player takes on the role of a paranormal investigator and communicates with the ghost of Irene - the spirit of a murder victim, with fragmented memories who is trapped in a liminal space— find closure about her cause of death.

games.name: Which hand?
games.summary: Solve the titan’s riddle, uncovering more hidden rules and connections each time you try

games.name: Who tells your story
games.summary: The only limit is your imagination!

games.name: Withering Realms
games.summary: A ghost and her doll guardian explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards, tombs, caves and rotting estates that surround it in this Horror Action RPG from the creator of Withering Rooms.

games.name: Yappy Bird
games.summary: Yappy Bird is a voice-controlled descent into chaos. Your mic is your controller—your dignity is optional. Yell to flap, whisper to glide, fail in silence. Test your lungs, your neighbours’ patience, and your questionable life choices.

games.name: Zereoton Hauntings 2
games.summary: Zereoton Hauntings 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.

games.name: Zomdied
games.summary: A hardcore top-down zombie survival RPG. Scavenge for supplies, craft essential gear, and fight to survive against an ever-evolving horde that grows stronger and more dangerous the longer you last.

games.name: Zumbi Olé: The Minigame
games.summary: Zumbi Olé is unlike anything you've ever played: an action-survival game where you don't just fight… you OLÉ! Outplay clumsy zombies, dominate infested arenas, wipe out undead hordes and rack up points to show the world your true OLÉ skills.

games.name: Astra GalaxyX
games.summary: Pilot a spacecraft across the galaxy, facing waves of incoming enemies, powerful enemy ships, and massive bosses.

games.name: Blood Clicker
games.summary:
Blood Clicker is a simple idle clicker game built around one goal: collect as much blood as possible.

Start with a single drop and build your way up by clicking, buying upgrades, and increasing your blood production. As your numbers grow, you will unlock stronger ways to earn more with every click and every second.

Whether you want to play actively or let the game build progress over time, Blood Clicker is designed to be easy to jump into and satisfying to keep growing.

games.name: Born Again
games.summary:
Su-jin is a very good girl, but she has a bit of a bad habit. But that's okay, because this week, she's definitely got everything under control.

A visual novel with roughly 6k words and over 40 illustrations produced for Daydrinking Jam. This game is for mature audiences only and may cause eyestrain.

games.name: Car Down
games.summary: Dodge obstacles, collect cars, and build your dream garage in this fast-paced arcade car collection game.

games.name: ChatBoss
games.summary:
ChatBoss is a Twitch chat boss raid game where streamers and viewers team up in real time to defeat powerful bosses directly through chat. Viewers join a party, choose a class, type the words shown on screen to attack, charge ultimates, and coordinate with the streamer to survive the raid.

The game is designed for livestream interaction, with party-based combat, class roles, streamer-led raid mechanics, Twitch chat commands, boss attacks, rankings, and short daily raid sessions.

games.name: Duty Free Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your own airport duty free shop, manage stocks, catch smugglers, sell & grow!

games.name: Gather CCG
games.summary:
Gather CCG is a turn-based online card game where players take on the role of Alchemists, competing to master elemental powers and outsmart their opponents through clever strategy.

Build and customize your deck with units, spells, and weapons powered by the five elemental forces — Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Darkness.
Each match is a test of your strategy and timing as you summon powerful units, cast devastating spells, and unleash explosive elemental combos that can turn the tide of battle.

Climb through the ranked ladder, collect new cards, and expand your collection to strengthen your deck.
Refine your playstyle and rise to become the ultimate Alchemist.

Whether you enjoy tactical battles or creative deck-building, Gather CCG offers a vibrant and competitive online experience that rewards both strategy and imagination.

games.name: Gladiator 3D
games.summary:
Gladiator 3D is a fast-paced arcade arena fighter where you create a lobby, challenge your friends, or battle solo against AI.

Block, parry, kick, and strike your way through flashy gladiator duels where every fight is about timing, mind games, and claiming GLORY OVER YOUR ENEMIES!

games.name: Hunted Hunter
games.summary: Hunted hunter, is a game in which you'll have to take the form of objects on the game map, to blend into the background, in order to eliminate your opponents before they eliminate you. Everyone hunts everyone. Hide well, win games and have fun!

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Cozy Fantasy Worlds
games.summary: Piece by piece, world by world.

games.name: Mel-Practice
games.summary:
Mel-Practice is a point and click adventure game where you must find a way to kill yourself within a dream in order to escape. Only thing that can properly end you in this world is one particular individual, who you must track down throughout the whole game via talking to and helping others within the dream world. Explore wacky worlds, talk to... interesting characters, play minigames, and take in the vibes!

This game was made as part of a 8 month project for my college animation class. It was meant to release as a full game but I got too ambitious during its conception. So now, you just get a demo! However there is a very good chance that I don't work on this project anymore afterwards from losing interest in it over the project's duration. Though I may return to this project at some point or in some alternative way. I did take the time after the project ended though to touch up anything I wanted to either look better or weirder.

games.name: Not My Hand
games.summary: A psychological horror puzzle about an strange VHS tape that captured a disturbingly realistic ritual. Each viewing changes what happens on screen. Notice these changes, figure out what they mean and see if you can rewrite the ending.

games.name: Pixie Plates
games.summary: A magical cooking adventure full of charm and tasty treats!

games.name: The Family Trip
games.summary: An 13-year-old boy travels with his parents to a cabin in a remote area for a short trip. During their stay, they explore the surroundings, visit a nearby abandoned house, and spend their evenings at the cabin. The trip does not continue as planned.

games.name: The Woman Above
games.summary: The Woman Above — a psychological horror game where, during your vacation, you check into a rented apartment and on the very first night hear strange moans coming from the apartment above. Will you dare to go and find out what’s happening up there?

games.name: They Not Fae!
games.summary: A short horror where you help a teenage girl rescue her cat, exploring a creepy building filled with creepy monsters.

games.name: Tippy Putts
games.summary: Tilt the course sink the putt

games.name: Unarchived
games.summary: Unarchived is a kinetic visual novel about 3 V-Tuber's brief careers and their tragic end.

games.name: Vital Charge
games.summary: Vital Charge is an indie fighting game featuring a revive mechanic, and unique attacks associated with a timer

games.name: World Heroes Perfect
games.summary: The 1995 arcade fighting classic World Heroes Perfect returns—now enhanced and coming to Steam! Enjoy smooth online with rollback netcode, and up your game in the full-featured Practice Mode! Solo thrills and high-level online battles await you in this definitive version of the game!

games.name: Besitupia: Mediator
games.summary: Waking up in a mysterious bunker, you realize that you've ended up on a planet full of mysteries and dangers. Use your skills and intuition to overcome obstacles and escape to freedom.

games.name: Bloom
games.summary: New responsibilities, budding romance! Astra Vale has been asked to take charge in making improvements to Café Bloom. Problem is, she can't quite decide who to ask for help. Her ice-cold coworker, the charming local artist, her best friend, or the mysterious new regular

games.name: Cookingo
games.summary: Welcome to Cookingo, your peaceful little escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. In this game, cooking is more than just making food—it’s a foodie haven, where you can savor each calm, happy moment.

games.name: Crystalline Bliss
games.summary: Embark on a journey to serenity within the eternal realms of pure consciousness in Crystalline Bliss. This lo-fi, melancholic, psychedelic voxel puzzle game transports you to the otherworldly landscapes beyond our reality. Delve into the mysteries of your soul and find your path to joy.

games.name: DiceRogue
games.summary: This is a new type of strategic roguelike where you fight by combining "dice x cards x tiles." You can create your own strategy by linking the "special effects" of the rolling dice with the "cards" that are activated according to the roll.

games.name: Electro Man
games.summary: Electro Man seeks revenge against the robots which wronged him.

games.name: Growth
games.summary: Growth is a fast-paced one-button game.

games.name: Lost Deltarune
games.summary: Lost Deltarune is a fan-made RPG based on the world of DELTARUNE. Set in an alternate Dark World, the game features turn-based bullet-hell combat, puzzle-solving, custom chiptune soundtracks, and an original narrative centered on player choice and control.

games.name: Magic Hero Incremental
games.summary: Magic Hero Incremental is a click-based incremental game focused on growth and progression. Players create their own unique hero through character creation, then defeat enemies to gather resources and grow stronger.

games.name: Mash Motion: Sprint Rush
games.summary:
Step onto the track in Mash Motion: Sprint Rush, a fast-paced arcade sprint where four runners line up and race for victory. Compete against three rivals in a straight dash to the finish, where every race is quick, intense, and decided in seconds.

With a nostalgic pixel art style and a classic stadium setting, the game captures the spirit of retro sports titles. The focus is simple: line up, race, and aim for first place. Each run is a short burst of competition that encourages immediate replay and constant improvement.

Whether you win or fall just behind, every race pushes you to try again and chase a cleaner, faster finish.

games.name: My Lovey-Dovey Angel Is a Total Deadbeat: Seriously Scary!
games.summary: Hulotte’s classic visual novel is now on Steam! After an injury ends his track dream, Sakuma Tsumugi meets a clumsy Love Angel and begins a sweet search for his destined special someone.

games.name: Pepper Rush
games.summary: Half duck. Half dog. Total chaos. Rosan got separated from Grandpa Spike in Pepper City and needs to get to the airport ASAP! Dodge insane traffic, eat peppers to turn into an unstoppable beast, and avoid sweets so you don't get too fat to run. It's crunch time in Pepper Rush!

games.name: Poop Right Now
games.summary: "Poop Right Now" is a puzzle game. Players play the role of "Courier" who have just entered the industry here to transport "Poop" to the right place. Please carefully arrange the transportation route to ensure that the "Poop" can be transported safely and accurately to its destination.

games.name: She Couldn't Do Anything
games.summary: Join Ann in "She Couldn't Do Anything" as loneliness, desperation, and an unexpected visitor take her down a dark, thrilling path that leaves her dazed, breathless, and utterly powerless...

games.name: Trickshot Tactics
games.summary: Billiards will never be the same again! Trickshot Tactics is where sharp minds meet sharper shots, a wild mix of deck building, strategy, and pure skill. Play your cards, bend the rules, and show who really knows how to handle a cue!

games.name: A Game About Making A Planet
games.summary: A Game About Making A Planet is a short incremental auto clicker game. Make a planet by merging particles together.

games.name: Achieve-Its
games.summary: Welcome to Achieve-Its, the adorable and fast-paced platformer that challenges you to collect as many achievements as possible in record time! Dive into a vibrant, colorful world filled with cute characters, tricky obstacles, and a plethora of achievements waiting to be unlocked.

games.name: Amazons vs Zombies
games.summary: Lead a squad of elite Amazons in a post-apocalyptic tactical action RPG. Battle hordes of mutated weirdos, recruit and upgrade unique heroines, and uncover the truth behind Virus G in a story-driven survival adventure.

games.name: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads
games.summary: A mini action city-builder in a post-post-apocalyptic world. Grow your settlement. Fend off waves of enemies. Restore nature.

games.name: Axe Cop
games.summary: Fight all of the bad guys! Axe Cop and his team of colorful characters must go on an epic adventure, that covers his ten-year comic book history, to rid the world of all bad guys once and for all!

games.name: Billgard
games.summary: Smash your friends in Billgard, a chaotic physics-based party brawler for couch and online multiplayer with up to 8 players. Kick your opponents off the table across different game modes!

games.name: Blood Vial
games.summary: Blood Vial is a retro-inspired FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons.

games.name: Board Forge
games.summary: Board Forge is a creative board game experience where you design, build, and play your own custom game boards. Place trivia questions, movement traps, and player swap tiles, then challenge friends in local or online multiplayer matches through Steam.

games.name: Burn The Witch: Toll of the Bell Bearer
games.summary: Forge powerful cards and reshape your strategy in this roguelike deck-builder set in a cursed forest. Adapt your deck, seek favor from the gods. With challenges, minigames for rewards, and no two runs the same, only the strongest will survive.

games.name: Darkest Cube
games.summary: Darkest Cube fuses card games, roguelikes, and RPG elements – adapt your starting deck with cards gained from quests, and adjust your strategies to seal the mysterious Dark Cubes.

games.name: Faehnor Online
games.summary: A handcrafted MMORPG developed by a solo creator, where exploration relies on real paper maps. Get lost, find your way, and set out to conquer a world that will never take you by the hand.

games.name: Find the Differences 3D
games.summary: A game of finding differences in 3D environments. In 30+ levels with 6 different themes you can find: Hidden object, colour, size, rotation and location differences. Also Find the same objects in different environments. Control with the mouse and navigate with the free camera. Have fun!

games.name: Five Dice
games.summary: A deck-building strategy game where you roll FIVE DICE and blend tactics with luck to prevail in battle!

games.name: Galactic Overthrow
games.summary: Conquer the galaxy in this streamlined space conquest and empire management game. With the heart of a classic 4x experience, but with campaigns that can be finished in one short sitting. Play any way you want: Open ended sandbox, race against bots, multiplayer vs friends, and more.

games.name: Game Saloon Simulator
games.summary: Step into the world of fun and become the boss of your own game saloon! In this game, you’ll serve customers, enjoy interactive games, and get a taste of the relaxing and enjoyable experience that awaits you.

games.name: HorrorMon Photography
games.summary: Photograph hallucinations of monsters to make them disappear. When the monsters become real, defend yourself and take more photos to complete your monster dex!

games.name: HyphoSphere
games.summary: HyphoSphere is a fungal idle game where you build a mycelial empire from a single filament to a cosmic singularity. Players click to harvest nutrients, construct living organisms, and watch their network spread across the planet and beyond.

games.name: Islantiles
games.summary: Islantiles is a cozy, minimalistic city-builder where you raise your civilization from adorable settlers to ridiculously effective explorers. Unlock groundbreaking technologies as you venture across a chain of unknown islands and discover over-the-top synergies.

games.name: Jammer Dash
games.summary: Jammer Dash is a free rhythm 2D game in which you move and destroy objects on beat made for Windows and Linux! Inspired by many awesome games such as Muse Dash, Geometry Dash and osu!. Made in Unity and C#.

games.name: Lilacs in the Breeze
games.summary: A trans otome game about a woman beginning a new leaf—until her childhood friend shows up at her door.

games.name: Mazemerizzz II
games.summary: Moe is napping again and this time, it's a NIGHTMARE! The Watcher has Moe trapped in a massive endless maze filled with danger! Zombies, minotaurs and bone crushing, spikey, gaseous, flame filled traps. Equipped with just a torch, Moe must find a way to wake up.

games.name: Meow My Crop!
games.summary: Meow My Crop! is a cozy farming mini-game where every keystroke and click makes your crops grow. Team up or sneak around to steal your friends’ fruits, then trade your hard-earned harvest for cute decorations to style your own little plot.

games.name: Murim Survival
games.summary: Murim Survival is a survival roguelite where you battle relentless enemies within a time limit. Explore a world on the brink of collapse, master martial arts, collect powerful equipment, and unlock unique traits to become a true hero of the Murim. The fate of this world is in your hands.

games.name: Pet Troll
games.summary: Run cute, jump cute and fall cute. A colorful troll platformer that is absolutely out to get you, where adorable pets get betrayed by every “friendly” object you meet, falling straight into your perfectly timed doom.

games.name: Prime Monster
games.summary: A card-based political roguelike about surviving in a parliament of literal monsters. Fight for votes, break rules, weather scandals and force through absurd laws to keep the top job in this democratic dystopia of truly monstrous proportions.

games.name: Sticker/Ball
games.summary: STICKER/BALL is a pool game roguelike from the future. Fire balls. Hit dice. Earn points. Add stickers. Trigger crazy combos. Enjoy the chaos, it’s on purpose.

games.name: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
games.summary: Exterminate monsters by throwing objects like snowballs and rocks at them in a short, high-score game. This was part of a McDonald's Happy Meal promotion.

games.name: Sweet Valentine Chocolatier
games.summary: A cozy, heartwarming visual novel in which you take a familiar face (boy or girl) on a romantic spring festival date. Customize your player character (femme or masc) and play several low-stakes mini games!

games.name: The Bigger Picture
games.summary:
Just Press The Button...
Go through the levels, pressing the buttons as they appear to zoom out and see more of your environment.
Push levers to move platforms and walls.
Get to higher points by jumping into pipes or bouncing on trampolines.
Walk past arrows to pan across the screen and discover more at the current zoom level.
Turn fans on and off to get to blocked areas.

games.name: Tiny Space Pirate
games.summary: Tiny Space Pirate is a cozy top-down space adventure where you explore a handcrafted galaxy, upgrade your ship, and help quirky space locals. Complete light quests, play relaxing mini-games, and discover tiny stories across the stars.

games.name: U.V.S. Nirmana
games.summary:
U.V.S. Nirmana is an engineering puzzle game from Coincidence, the creators of Kaizen: A Factory Story and the inventors of the Zach-like.

Set off on the Unreturning Void Ship Nirmana as it continues a journey of uncountable eons toward the edge of the universe. Stop by distant worlds and ancient civilizations, helping them as part of your pilgrimage with your companions, the Renunciants.

games.name: World of Warships: Legends
games.summary: World of Warships: Legends is a global multiplayer free-to-play online game in which you can master the seas on the decks of history’s greatest warships! Recruit Legendary Commanders, upgrade your vessels, and stake your claim to naval domination alongside and against players from around the world.

games.name: Wunder: The Double-sided Deckbuilder
games.summary: Wunder is a game of chance about flipping coins. Build a deck of coins with their own risk & reward; upgrade each side to tilt the odds in your favour, bolster your strategy with strange talismans and defeat the Ferryman at his own game.

games.name: Your Crown Is Mine
games.summary: Take the throne and fix the corrupt kingdom— or worsen it! A villainess life sim and visual novel where you balance your stats and romance rival nations' leaders for foreign policy purposes. How will you rule the country?

games.name: Aleae
games.summary: Raise, multiply, and battle with dice — a dice deck-building roguelike! Utilize a unique system where all dice on the field roll simultaneously and their outcomes collide to shape the fight. In both battles and events, everything is up to the roll. Embark on a journey where luck meets strategy!

games.name: Allelon
games.summary: Play as Ollie and Spade, a rebel and detective, on both sides of a high-profile murder case, in a dual-character investigative-stealth experience. Discover the secrets plaguing the citizens of Andropolis.

games.name: Assassin of Aliens
games.summary: Play as space warrior in this 2d person sci-fi shooter game. Mission is to kill different enemies like spiders and troopers and end of level destroy big ufo ship and collect skulls

games.name: Candellum
games.summary: Play as a candle warrior fighting to keep your flame alive in a world where fire means life and death. Steal wax from enemies to survive, wield your flame tactically in intense hack-and-slash combat, and uncover the dark secrets of a dormant wax factory filled with danger !

games.name: Cloudsea
games.summary: Cloudsea is a low-poly exploration game set in the clouds of the world of Cloudsea. Explore the floating islands of Cloudsea in airships, manage crew, gather resources, solve quests, trade, and fight in airship-to-airship and melee combat!

games.name: Concrete Abyss
games.summary: Concrete Abyss is an atmospheric first-person action game set within the vast substructure E-01 — a dead concrete-metal world where surveillance systems still operate and system units perceive you as an anomaly.

games.name: Core
games.summary: Core is a "Retro" style fps or rather FPP [first person puncher?] about a robot going into the earth and destroying it from the inside out.

games.name: Dark Adelita
games.summary: Dark Adelita is a brutal, 2D action platformer rooted in Mexican folklore. As Angela, a fearless Adelita, fight your way through mythic horrors, dodge deadly traps, and face legendary bosses from Mexico’s past—all while uncovering a supernatural threat born from revolution.

games.name: Dead as Disco
games.summary: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

games.name: Dungeonloop
games.summary: Turn-based grid roguelite.

games.name: Fairy Sweet Days
games.summary: ChatGPT: This game has two modes: Fairy Training and Confectionery Management. In Fairy Training, you help Lily White by raising a confectionery fairy and deciding how she grows. Touhou characters like Reimu and Marisa may visit, and your trained fairy can appear in other players’ games.

games.name: Forage Wizard
games.summary: An incremental crafting game where you click your way to alchemical mastery. Progress through a branching skill tree and explore the forbidden woods. Collect resources and build machines of magic. Slay monsters, farm crops and automate your production to become the all-powerful Forage Wizard!

games.name: Gangs of Asia
games.summary:
Dominate rival gangs by seizing buildings, summoning unique fighters, and unleashing devastating special attacks. Whether you're battling alongside friends in co-op or unleashing chaos in PvP, the game offers shared split-screen, online multiplayer, and free-for-all modes to keep the action fresh.

Experience a fusion of skill-based 1v1 Kung Fu combat and real-time strategy. Command a diverse army—from mighty Sumo and agile Ninjas to legendary Kung Fu Masters—seize territory, manage resources, and unleash special attacks to crush your opponents and claim victory!

games.name: Giantfall
games.summary: A minimalist medieval kingdom builder, tower defence real time strategy game where you build defences, research weapons, raise armies to defend the realm. Lead your people, build and defend the kingdom against an invasion of Giants.

games.name: Grief
games.summary: Grief is a psychological horror game with a dark, scary atmosphere. The game takes place in a Soviet-style apartment somewhere in Estonia in 1998.

games.name: HamsterCraft
games.summary: Defend and grow your cheese with an army of heroic hamsters in this chaotic 2D Tower Defense adventure! Build, upgrade, and outwit waves of enemies, all while keeping things squeaky clean.

games.name: Handmancers
games.summary: Handmancers is a Rock, Paper, Scissors Roguelite deckbuilder with a first-person twist where clear tactical choices meet deck-building depth. Craft your deck, enhance your cards, equip tricky artifacts and face powerful enemies in strategic fights

games.name: House Fixer Simulator
games.summary: Repair. Renovate. Resell.

games.name: In the Black
games.summary: In The Black is a PC space combat sim based on realism from the designers of Crysis, MechWarrior 2, and X-Wing.

games.name: Kingdom Rules
games.summary: Restore a struggling kingdom in a cozy medieval strategy game: build farms, houses, and barracks, balance taxes, grow your population, and repel raids.

games.name: Leaks In Space
games.summary: Build your spaceships, craft, survive, fight and explore sectors full of peril and adventure. With limitless creativity and surviving fatalities, Leaks in Space offers unique 2D space-sim sandbox experience for adventurers.

games.name: Little Petsville Desktop
games.summary: LITTLE PETSVILLE Desktop: A simple pet raising game!

games.name: Manickologi
games.summary: Manickologi is a game about getting sidetracked on your way back home. Follow mani the manickologist and his robot friend Stefan on their adventure. Swap between characters to make use of their unique skillsets. Collect hidden treasures and complete quests.

games.name: Mannequin Syndrome
games.summary: Investigate mannequin-controlled zones, perform rituals, and survive encounters with corrupted AI entities. Mannequin Syndrome is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror game where every move counts. Explore, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

games.name: Midnight Ramen Shop
games.summary: Start a tiny night-time ramen shop, serve warm bowls, decorate your cozy space, and turn quiet nights into a thriving business.

games.name: Midnight Saturn
games.summary: A grizzled private eye in a sci-fi adventure takes a murder case no one else will touch. He’s seen it all before, but nothing’s prepared him for a conspiracy that leads off-world. Something big is about to happen. Whatever it is... it goes live at midnight.

games.name: Motorslice
games.summary: Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure.

games.name: Nano Flat Owner
games.summary: You are a owner of nano flats, responsible for decorating each mini space to attract tenants and earn impressive profits! As your income grows, keep buying more units and gradually expand your rental kingdom, easily stepping toward financial freedom!

games.name: Necro Survivors
games.summary: Necro Survivors is a dark fantasy survivorlike action roguelite where players fight waves of monsters, upgrade their character, unlock abilities, and create powerful builds during fast, replayable runs.

games.name: Never Second in Rome
games.summary:
Never Second in Rome is a turn-based historical game with RPG and management elements. You take the role of a Roman centurion in the army of Julius Caesar.

Starting right before the beginning of the Gallic War, you will assume command of a century in a newly raised legion.

games.name: Nightmare Before Blackgate
games.summary: A nightmare takes shape in the quiet of the night. Explore an abandoned house and a haunting cemetery as something watches you from the darkness. In Nightmare Before BlackGate, reality warps… and you're never alone.

games.name: Outworld Station
games.summary: Take the helm as a new Station Commander and exploit an alien star system in this stunning space-station factory automation game. Amass resources and construct starships using increasingly advanced manufacturing and expand your station in a hostile universe!

games.name: Parrydox: Battle of the Alamo
games.summary: Defend the Alamo and rewrite history in this confined bullet hell! Play as Shieldon, a shield who can only parry, who was tasked with rewriting the Alamo's fate. But, the enemies and its commander won't let it come easily. Can you defeat who awaits in the end, or will you be left to be remembered?

games.name: Plentiful
games.summary: Stack stones to shape the world. A relaxing game about harnessing nature.

games.name: RD Racing
games.summary:
RD Racing is a casual combat racing game where speed and firepower decide who survives. Compete in intense top-down races, destroy rival drivers, earn cash, and upgrade your vehicle to dominate the competition.

Inspired by the classic Death Rally game, the game brings back the thrill of arcade vehicular combat — but with a modern twist and colorful 3D cartoon-style graphics. Fast races, explosive weapons, and strategic upgrades create a chaotic and addictive gameplay loop.

Win races. Eliminate opponents. Build the ultimate combat machine.

games.name: Red Protocol
games.summary: A psychological sci-fi thriller aboard an orbital quarantine station. Interrogate 10 astronauts, identify 4 infected crew members, and prevent a mutiny before Earth reentry.

games.name: Rune Dice
games.summary: Throw dice, create explosive chain reactions, and defeat waves of enemies in Rune Dice! Collect ancient runes with diverse abilities, add synergies between relics, heroes, and special dice. All combined, this will give you an excellent experience in our roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Scouts Out
games.summary: Scouts Out is a score-driven arcade helicopter shooter built around control, pressure, and survival.

games.name: Sewer Raiders
games.summary: Descend into the dark sewers in this co-op horror dungeon crawler. Fight off mutants, complete puzzles, and collect Golden Toilet Work together or go alone every run is unique.

games.name: Shadows of the Afterland
games.summary:
Madrid, 1960. The old city zoo is rocked by a mysterious death, catapulting a soul to the threshold between the world of the living and the afterlife. But when the transition goes awry, the soul arrives with the memories of Carolina, one of the pioneers in Madrid's police force, who has yet to be born.

Step into Carolina’s shoes and plunge into a riveting adventure to unravel the enigma shrouding these ominous events. Explore the wacky realm of the afterlife, teeming with unique characters and with its own set of rules.

games.name: Space Memory TDG
games.summary: Dive into 'Space Memory TDG,' an action-packed memory game set in space. Match pairs, master turret mode, disrupt UFO activities, and collect points through speed and strategy.

games.name: Synthwave Show Dawn
games.summary: Synthwave Show/Dawn est un jeu de tir compétitif en Alpha ouverte sur PC à la troisième personne mêlant hero shooter et jeu de rythme. Pour attaquer, il faut être raccord avec le rythme tout en accomplissant l’objectif de la capture de base. On y incarne des stars ayant chacune un style de musique, jouable en arène en 4 contre 4 dans un monde light cyberpunk.

games.name: The Awakener: Battle Tendency
games.summary: The Awakener: Battle Tendency is a hack-and-slash survivor game that blends Eastern fantasy with Western high fantasy. You will control “Awakeners” from different eras and regions to fight against demonic echoes and twisted fate, striving to rewrite a destiny once doomed to fail.

games.name: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows
games.summary: In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending your family from paranormal creatures. Explore the world and solve environmental puzzles to save your loved ones and uncover the mystery.

games.name: The Repair Man
games.summary: The Repair Man is a Platformer Exploration game where you have to fix the kingdom of New York City. You control the Repair Man, one of the last remains of the Repair Men Association and you have to fix and clean the streets of YOUR city.

games.name: The Traveller Tale
games.summary: A fully voiced, old-school first-person CRPG where you build your party, explore towns, caves, and dungeons, and face deadly foes in turn-based combat. Take on quests, meet memorable characters, and craft, fish, and mine in a world full of danger and discovery.

games.name: Thornhold
games.summary:
Thornhold is a forest-defense autobattler where water is your most powerful weapon, and you choose where it flows. Shape the forest and protect the Great Tree from lumber-hungry orcs.

Route a river across a grid, place tree structures and troops, and survive waves of escalating orc hordes. Every cell you connect, every terrain you activate, and every card you play shapes the battlefield.

The River Changes Everything. The path you carve determines which bonuses fire, which groves you awaken, and whether your Forest Core gets the power it needs to survive.

Seasons Shift and the Map Transforms. Every few waves, the season changes, and all terrain bonuses rotate. Adapt your strategy to survive.

Draft. Grow. Fight. Draw from a pool of 20+ cards - structures that auto-attack, troops that march into battle, and mutations that stack bonuses.

games.name: Tiny Wizard Tavern
games.summary: Run a cozy magical tavern on a moonlit road. Serve travelers, manage supplies, survive strange events, and grow your reputation in a charming fantasy world.

games.name: Train Your Fingers: Lab
games.summary: Unleash your speed, cast powerful spells! Master both spells and keyboard skills in a story-driven game where every word brings you closer to magical mastery.

games.name: Until They Burn
games.summary: First-person psychological horror, where nightmares have led you to the apartment of a woman who vanished after a fire. Things take a strange turn when you find yourself trapped inside, compelled to burn dolls in a fireplace to escape.

games.name: Vehicle No. 4
games.summary: Vehicle No. 4 is an exciting horde survival game: Build your own combat vehicle, freely place weapons, and upgrade them with modules. Every decision matters as you face waves of enemies. Tinkering meets action – create your ultimate survival vehicle!

games.name: Wax Heads
games.summary: A cosy-punk slice-of-life narrative sim about managing a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues – all to restore the groove!

games.name: Without A Hitch
games.summary: Without A Hitch is a co-op delivery game where you transport cargo across an apocalyptic landscape. Whether driving solo or in a convoy of 2 to 4 players, you must navigate chaotic hazards, scavenge vital parts, and escape from THEM. Can you survive Without A Hitch?

games.name: A Love Like Broken Glass
games.summary: You're an exorcist. Lorenn's a half-ghost. It's up to you to find out what's wrong with his soul and exorcise him once and for all... Just try not to fall in love in the process, would you?

games.name: Alter Evo
games.summary: A psychological horror indie game with third person exploration, driving, terrifying enemies, stressful escape sequences, and narrative focused character interaction.

games.name: Amberspire
games.summary: A science fantasy dice city builder. Construct buildings, manage resources, and build in harmony with an alien ecology. Beneath the glow of a gas giant, Amberspire will grow and prosper into a flourishing city atop the ruins of an abandoned moon.

games.name: Astra Space Defender
games.summary:
Astra Space Defender is an intense 2D top-down shooter where survival depends on your reflexes and skill.
Unlike traditional shooters with fixed patterns, every enemy ship in this game moves with its own individual intent, turning the battlefield into a chaotic arena that rewards quick thinking and precision.

games.name: Atomix
games.summary: Atomix is a single player Arcade style First Person Shooter where you get to pilot mechanical suits across a unique Sci-Fi world.

games.name: Bolmn
games.summary: Bolmn has been sucked into a magic mirror. Help him escape his twisted reflections through a variety of challenges including 3D platforming, stealth, bomb throwing and pinball.

games.name: Bumper Blitz TD
games.summary: Bumper Blitz TD redefines tower defense with gravity-powered physics and dynamic gameplay. Build, upgrade, and bounce enemies away in this thrilling fusion of strategy and action!

games.name: Coldsnap
games.summary: Pilot S.N.A.P. and wield his heat-powered hammer Thermon to fight through layers of the planet’s crust, and restart its dying core. Master momentum-driven movement, chain devastating attack combos, and collect powerful enhancements to survive as the mechanical horde grows ever stronger.

games.name: Currents of War
games.summary: A turn-based strategy merchant tycoon.

games.name: Cute Diana
games.summary: Cute Diana is a desktop companion game focusing on deep cultivation and interactive companionship. More than just a static decoration, Cute Diana is a virtual partner with an independent attribute system, a career path, and a life full of details.

games.name: Europa Universalis V: Fate of the Phoenix
Fake Roads
games.summary: Fake Roads is an observation-based exploration experience where the smallest changes can alter everything.

games.name: Farever
games.summary: Forge your legend in a forgotten realm! Farever is an online co-op action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world. Alone or with allies, explore wild landscapes and epic dungeons, build your own playstyle, craft powerful equipment and carve your path through dynamic combat and playful platforming.

games.name: Feed the Maw
games.summary: The Maw is hungry, and you are the island's chosen hero. Explore the deadly, mysterious island with your fellow islanders and loot for offerings to feed the beast before he gets angry!

games.name: Fireboy & Watergirl And Friends
games.summary: Fireboy & Watergirl are back with 3 new friends! In this platformer game you have to control multiple characters with your keyboard. Play alone or with a friend to solve the puzzles and get to the finish doors of each level.

games.name: Flippant
games.summary: An abstract incremental game about flipping a coin and maybe some other things too

games.name: Gin and Wall
games.summary: Gin and Wall is game about dodging many walls. Cotrols are jump and move. You can play basic mode and coin mode.

games.name: Go Forward Survivors
games.summary: "Go Forward Survivors" is a light ROGUE game that combines tower climbing and barrage shooting gameplay. By strengthening the attack model, the character becomes stronger and stronger, defeating hordes of enemies and liberating your homeland.

games.name: Gravity's Edge
games.summary: Begin an epic space journey filled with strange worlds, engaging puzzles, and a dense Afro-punk theme. Another challenge also awaits you in 'Survival'. There you will face off against oncoming hordes while searching for the Ability Anvils. Are you ready to become a Kassler?

games.name: Hypnos
games.summary: Hypnos is a first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a lovecraftian megastructure fever dream. Enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Embrace your destiny.

games.name: Idle Squire
games.summary: Idle Squire is a desktop idle RPG where every key you press is an attack. Type, browse, or work while your squire clears dungeons, finds loot, and grows stronger. Unlock talents, artifacts, and perks that bring speed, power, and even partial automation.

games.name: Jack's 510 Racing
games.summary: Jack's 510 Racing is an open world arcade driver set on nine connecting islands. Earn points by racing on the streets, surviving UFOs and police, or causing mayhem in death races inspired by the cult classic movie. Use points to upgrade, customize, and buy new cars.

games.name: MechDrachen
games.summary: Dive into non-stop action in a movement-based arena shooter, blending some of the most familiar gameplay elements of the genre into a completely new experience, build around the idea to have the most fun with your friends you could possibly have with a movement shooter.

games.name: Perfect Klondike Solitaire
games.summary: Prepare to test your strategic solitaire abilities!

games.name: Rainbow Legends
games.summary: A territory-control roguelike deck builder where the side with more tiles at round’s end deals damage. Seize ground, place structures, shield your core, and unlock builds with card shapes, factions, and relics

games.name: Royal Flux: The Astral Shadow Plague
games.summary:
A card system built for thinkers

Royal Flux is a turn-based card battle game where both sides place simultaneously — you never know exactly what your opponent is committing until combat resolves. Victory belongs to the player who reads the board, builds the better deck, and understands the kingdom triangle before the damage is done.

This is not a game of whoever draws the rarest card. There are no packs to purchase, no randomised loot, and no pay-to-win shortcuts. Every card in Royal Flux earns its place through strategic composition and the mechanics that govern how kingdoms clash.

games.name: Royal Wars: Farm TD
games.summary: Royal Wars: Farm TD is a free-to-play tower defense game where strategy meets luck. Place randomly selected towers, merge them to unlock higher tiers, and defend your kingdom through multiple levels. Plant crystals, manage resources, and prepare for epic battles.

games.name: Silverbrook: a Text-Based RPG
games.summary: A retro text-based RPG. The town of Silverbrook is in trouble. Goblins to the east. Undead to the north. A necromancer doing something unspeakable in the old dungeon. And somewhere beyond the mountain pass, something ancient is waking up — something that was sealed away for a reason.

games.name: Spellisimo
games.summary: Spellisimo: Magic Duel RPG is a mobile spellcasting RPG where every spell is drawn — not tapped — on a rounded rune grid. Trace the right pattern fast enough and you unleash fireballs, shields, healing waves, and arcane finishers in real-time magic duels against rival mages. Master a growing grimoire, climb through escalating opponents, and learn the craft through a guided tutorial that walks you from your first spark to full-fledged duelist.

games.name: Sputnik
games.summary: Sputnik is an indie arcade space game where player needs to repair old Soviet Union Space Settlements. It's a singleplayer game with cyberpunk style graphics and real retro feel. Gameplay is based on old school games from 1980's and 1990's with lives and permadeath.

games.name: Summa Expeditionis
games.summary: Summa Expeditionis is a survival and strategy game set in ancient Roman Empire. Follow the career of a Roman soldier from Legionnaire to Centurion. Build and manage your camp, recruit more soldiers and face the barbarians for the glory of Rome.

games.name: The First Spine - Arena
games.summary: The First Spine Arena is an exhilarating online competitive board and card game. In this game, players place their unique cards on a board with the goal of reaching their opponent's side. Each card is generated according to the player's level, ensuring a balanced and challenging experience for all.

games.name: Toad Turf
games.summary: A 3D Platformer Party Shooter inspired by early 2000s console games. No microtransactions, no live service! Free Updates Post Launch. Easy to learn, hard to master, controls are simple to understand for veterans and newcomers.

games.name: Tri6: Infinite 2
games.summary: Tri6: Infinite 2 is futuristic arcade racing without brakes: race across procedurally generated cyber tracks, dodge traps, use power-ups, and experience thrilling high-speed action. Every run is unique — how long can you last?

games.name: Turnbound
games.summary: Turnbound is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler. Will your design outlive your ghostly opponents… or join them?

games.name: Warped Universe
games.summary:
