A co-op meta-driven sci-fi looter shooter where every mission counts for all. Explore the unknown, defend facilities, upgrade your Echo, and empower the galaxy.

Choose your combat style before every mission: real-time action or turn-based tactics. Fight on the ground or in space, solo or with friends. Same mission, completely different experience depending on how you play.

Built by the team behind Jumpgate, Auto Assault, LEGO Universe, and Dragons & Titans.

games.name: Werewolf: The Inner Beast
games.summary: Werewolf: The Inner Beast is a 3D third person survival horror game with a female protagonist. Story driven linear gameplay in a dark, claustrophobic atmosphere.

games.name: 100 Archeology Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 1000 Hidden Snails
games.summary:
Hidden object game in a surreal style. Extremely hard!

1000 hidden snails is a hidden object game in a surreal setting.
Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style.

Can you find 1000 snails? Just click on the snail!
Good Luck!

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in New Delhi
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in New Delhi in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

games.name: Adventurer's Gambit: Dungeons of Fortune
games.summary:
Adventurer's Gambit: Dungeons of Fortune is a fantasy roguelite extraction RPG for PC in which players enter unstable portal dungeons, fight through third-person action encounters, build power during the run, and extract before losing what they found. Each session is built around high-stakes decisions: push deeper for better rewards, or leave early and secure the loot.

Players shape their build as the run unfolds through gear, abilities found during exploration, and stat upgrades discovered in the dungeon. Each player begins with a guaranteed starting ability choice on spawn, while additional abilities can drop from monsters, chests, and destructible objects. Stat upgrades are also found through dungeon interaction, including destructibles such as crates and barrels. The system supports 6 active abilities and 12 passive abilities, letting players assemble aggressive, defensive, utility, or hybrid playstyles from run to run. Up to three players can enter together, creating room for cooperation, tension, and shifting priorities around survival and extraction.

games.name: Akita: Legends Squad
games.summary: Strap on your jetpack and defy gravity! Master thrilling 3D platforming challenges and explore floating islands in this epic action adventure

games.name: Akuma Rise
games.summary: A story-driven fantasy JRPG set in the demon realm of Adribune. Follow Kaine, a memory-lost demon, as he joins three demon princesses to battle invading heroes, uncover his past, and save the Shadow Realm through classic turn-based RPG combat.

games.name: Alabaster Dawn
games.summary: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

games.name: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders
games.summary: The earth has been invaded by aliens, and even though they are still in training, a group of soldiers are trying to save their city while trying to understand why it happened so quickly.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Arkanoid
games.summary:
A port of Arkanoid, a brick breaker released by Taito in 1986.

Players take the helm of the spacecraft "Vaus" and bounce the Energy Ball to shatter the Space Walls.

The goal is to escape from the dimension of a warped labyrinth and return to the mothership Arkanoid. Players can collect power-up items that might give them the edge they need to conquer each stage.

games.name: Arcade Archives: Arkanoid
games.summary:
"Arkanoid" is a brick breaker released by Taito in 1986.
Take the helm of the spacecraft "Vaus" and bounce the Energy Ball to shatter the Space Walls.
Your goal is to escape from the dimension of a warped labyrinth and return to the mothership "Arkanoid." Collecting power-up items will give you the edge you need to conquer each stage!

games.name: Arsonate
games.summary: Outwit the HOST in a death game where fire spreads with each flip of a card. Be the last to burn. Do you fear death?

games.name: Ashes
games.summary: After witnessing a murder, 16-year-old skater Azar Warren seeks refuge with her estranged grandfather on his rural compound, only to suspect he may be more dangerous than her pursuers. Ashes blends graphic novel panels with interactive puzzles in a story of murder and unease.

games.name: Bear No Grudge
games.summary:
Take control of Bear and shoot, skate, race your way to justice across multiple locations in this action adventure game with a bite.

Bear no grudge is a grizzly action adventure game with bite.

In Bear No Grudge, players take control of a vengeful bear on a mission to take down the careless international delivery corporation, Forest Inc, that left his friend in a wheelchair. and destroying the planet This action-packed game features multiple locations, each with its own unique gameplay mechanics and challenges. Players will have to use their wits and quick reflexes to defeat enemies and bosses, while also navigating challenging environments on skateboards, hovercrafts and paws. As they progress, players can find hidden collectables to upgrade abilities to help them on their mission. With its diverse gameplay, Bear No Grudge offers a thrilling and satisfying gaming experience for anyone who enjoys fun. Set across 11 different levels you will pursue the evil CEO, Taking down hench men and a variety of baddies and leaving destruction in your path.

games.name: Bird Game III
games.summary: The sky isn’t big enough for all of us.

games.name: Blackspot: The Card Game
games.summary: One card. One choice. Dead men don't fold.

games.name: Blindfire
games.summary: Blindfire is the first FPS game set in complete darkness. Rely on your insincts to eliminate your opponents. It's either hunt or be hunted... Ready to light 'em up?

games.name: Blood: Refreshed Supply
games.summary: Things are about to get… bloody! Soak up 42 pulse-pounding levels dripping with Lovecraftian atmosphere as you battle your way through armies of sycophantic cultists, zombies, gargoyles, hell hounds, and other insatiable horrors, in your quest to defeat the loathsome Tchernobog.

games.name: Bodycamera FPS
games.summary: Warning: May cause sudden tactical overthinking.

games.name: Business Management
games.summary: Business Management is a 2D financial management game developed for the CoolMathGames.com Jam 2026. You have to manage your factory, farm, and house wisely so that you do not require a bank loan.

games.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
games.summary: A drifting simulator featuring an authentic competition format and a judging system inspired by modern drift championships. Enhanced and updated physics, developed in collaboration with the CarX Motorsport team.

games.name: Chorus of Carcosa
games.summary: Chorus of Carcosa is a psychological horror game inspired by the iconic book 'The King in Yellow' by R. W. Chambers. Test the limits of your mind and survive in the old, ever-changing building. Just don't get lost in the dark, twisted labyrinths... or in your own madness.

games.name: Console Archives: MagMax
games.summary:
"MagMax" was released by Nichibutsu in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
This is a shooting game where you pilot a transformable mecha (MagMax) as the chosen hero, to rescue humanity from the domination of an alien computer known as Babylon.
Travel between above ground and underground using warp holes, and defeat approaching enemies with energy beams.

games.name: Console Store Simulator
games.summary: Console Store Simulator — Run your own second-hand game shop! Buy and sell games, stock shelves, and grow your business. Watch out for thieves, and explore the black market and flea market — but be careful, some items might be broken!

games.name: Cozy Cat Cafe
games.summary:
Build the cutest cat café empire!
Serve happy customers, hire adorable staff,
and grow across 3 cozy locations!

games.name: Crepe Master!
games.summary: Crêpe Master! is a beat ‘em up VR adventure where you transform into a magical girl! Become the reincarnation of the Crêpe Goddess, defend your home against an alien invasion, and stop the ruthless tyrant threatening the Earth’s most beloved treat. Saving the world has never been tastier.

games.name: Doll Defenders
games.summary: You were teleported to Male Doll's multiverse with one goal: to save the heroes of our games. However, you may fall in love with them along the way and get the happy final ending you deserve. Are you looking to save the world, or the love of one hot man that’s everything you ever wanted? Don't lie!

games.name: Dread Neighbor
games.summary: "Dread Neighbor" is a 3D first-person horror game. You are a young woman who moves into a cheap, new apartment to save money. But something is wrong. From the closets, under the bed, through the cracks in the walls—you are being watched. Every corner feels alive with an unseen presence.

games.name: Drift & Stunt Mania
games.summary: Tune your dream car and take it to the limit — drift, race and pull off insane stunts across a stunning open world. Speed, style, and zero rules.

games.name: Driftcraft
games.summary: Build your perfect vehicle from endless combinations, tear through a vibrant open world, smash objects to gather resources, and craft a world that's entirely your own.

games.name: Duck Side of the Moon
games.summary: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

games.name: Eden Crafters
games.summary: Eden Crafters is a solo or co-op open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform a hostile planet into a habitable haven for humanity. Build, automate, and terraform. Control the climate, create a breathable atmosphere, and turn toxic lakes into water: shape a new world!

games.name: Eggconsole Deep Dungeon MSX
games.summary: A masterpiece of the MSX 3D RPG genre. To rescue Princess Etna, a nameless adventurer braves the depths of an underground labyrinth!

games.name: Escape Cataclysm
games.summary:
An escape room at the end of the world.

Explore, interact and solve puzzles to escape and survive an imminent cataclysm.

And once you have done that, give speed running a shot and enable the builtin timer.

games.name: Evil Inside VR
games.summary:
Evil Inside VR is not just a simple adaptation to Virtual Reality. It’s a complete reimagining of the original story, rebuilt to deliver a new, deeper, and more terrifying psychological horror experience. With significant changes in gameplay, lighting, sound, and puzzle design, this version completely transforms the way you experience Mark’s nightmare.

This is not the same Evil Inside you remember. It’s a new nightmare.

games.name: Farewell, We See Each Other for the Last Time.....
games.summary: A dramatic visual novel about the search for the meaning of life.

games.name: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity VR
games.summary: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity VR, where reckless driving has never been this much fun. Everything everyone has ever loved about FlatOut into one offering. Gamers will also be introduced to all new and exciting features, game modes, and vehicles which will soon become personal favorites.

games.name: Food And Hotel Simulator Bundle: Road Cafe & Motel Business & Street Food
games.summary: Start playing and gain business experience in various fields. Learn as you go, and don’t be afraid to make mistakes. It will help you in the future!

games.name: Froggy Hates Snow
games.summary: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door or defeat the final boss to survive.

games.name: Genesis: Voces de la Niebla
games.summary: Investigate a murder at a lake where something else is watching you. Explore, survive… and uncover the truth before it’s too late.

games.name: Get Rid Of Those Corners
games.summary: Clear all sides of the shapes inhabiting this geometric incremental game to trigger unpredictable physical chain reactions, powered by over 130 upgrades available in your skill tree.

games.name: Girls Who Are Totally Into Me
games.summary:
"Every single one of them is into you."
The choice is… yours.

games.name: Goth Obsession
games.summary: Romantic clicker with original voice acting and plenty of goth girls characters. Unlock game items for the accumulated points and pump up your touch!

games.name: Gridiron Masters '98
games.summary: Gridiron Masters '98 is an American Football presentation sim that places you in an alternate universe that encompasses college and pro football. Create your coach and see where their career takes them while looking through the lens of the late 90s.

games.name: Gun Glade
games.summary:
Round-Based Battle Royale.
Spawn into The Glade, loot unique weapons, and survive an ever-shrinking zone in classic last-man standing BR.

The first team to win 3 rounds wins the entire game.
Battle Royale.
Another Round.
Kill. Die. Repeat.

games.name: Haneda Girl
games.summary: Haneda Girl is an action-platformer game with brutal and frantic action. Clean stages swapping between two playable characters. Bullets or Slashes, your choice, but be creative. A wide variety of ways to solve each encounter are at your disposal. Dance the waltz of destruction, end the threat.

games.name: Hentai Shion
games.summary: Hentai Shion is an adult game in a mafia style, where the strict and sexy Shion leads you through a world of luxury, power, and temptation. Complete mini-games, unlock explicit illustrations, and dive into an atmosphere of danger and passion.

games.name: Hospital Romance: Anime Doctor Crush
games.summary:
The doctor will see you now.
Get close, earn his trust, and unlock exclusive images!

games.name: Huntdown: Overtime
games.summary: Corporations turned crime-infested streets into profit margins for bounty hunters and John Sawyer is going to make a killing. Hunt, die, upgrade, repeat in this explosive roguelite prequel where every strategic upgrade strips away more flesh and builds a cybernetic fighter one chrome limb at a time.

games.name: Idle Shelter: Dog Rescue Tycoon
games.summary: Tap to rescue stray dogs, rehab them, find them forever homes, and expand your kennel empire across 4 unique worlds.

games.name: In Trusted Hands
games.summary: Dive into the daily work of a cozy workshop in a big city, accompanied by relaxing atmospheric music. Manage client data, balance energy and stress, and make choices that shape the story and its outcome.

games.name: Infinity Sweeper
games.summary: Infinity Sweeper is similar to the classic Minesweeper, but turned into an endless rogue-lite adventure. Navigate through an ever-expanding grid filled with dangerous traps, enemies, and valuable treasures, trying to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Kessis and her Geeky Secret
games.summary: A bite-sized adult Visual Novel where you have intimate relations with Kessis every time you beat her in her most favorite geeky game.

games.name: Kill it with Fire 2
games.summary: Arachnophobia. The Game. The Sequel. Travel across the multiverse and exterminate every. last. spider. The world's funniest spider murdering is back with advancements in cutting-edge sci-fi tech to hunt down the arachnid menace once and for all.

games.name: Kobayashi Clash of Conquest
games.summary:
Kobayashi Clan of Conquest is a base-building and defense game set in a fantasy world populated by dragons.

Starting from a humble village, you develop your domain level by level to forge a true empire. Build gold mines, lumber mills, mystical laboratories, and defensive towers, all while strategically managing your resources.

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Tapjeong Lake
games.summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

games.name: Lost Twins 2
games.summary: A cute puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic of moving the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to help Ben & Abi navigate this mysterious world. Engage in clever puzzles & overcome obstacles to help them re-unite & find their way back home

games.name: Master Detective Reiji Takatori: Mystery Investigation
games.summary:
"Your choices reveal the truth."
Pick the evidence, expose the contradictions. A full-scale mystery investigation with Detective Reiji Takatori.

games.name: Meg's Monster
games.summary: Take control of the Underworld’s grumpiest ghoul to help a lost little girl find her way home in this creepy-cute indie adventure. Just be warned: if she cries, the whole world dies.

games.name: Mixtape
games.summary: Mixtape is a narrative adventure game developed by Beethoven & Dinosaur and published by Annapurna Interactive. Set during the last night of high school, it follows three friends as they revisit memories connected to music, youth and leaving home. The game combines story scenes with playable vignettes, including skating, parties, and other moments, all framed by a licensed soundtrack.

games.name: Mote: The Manuscript
games.summary: Step into a draft that refuses to stay still. MOTE: The Manuscript is the third entry in the MOTE series—a psychological walking simulator set within the crumbling mental landscape of a struggling writer. You play as a tiny wanderer navigating three eerie maze levels built from the pages themselves: Scribbles, Blank Pages, and Crumpled Paper. With minimal UI, unsettling sound design, and mind-bending post-process shifts, every corridor feels like a thought breaking apart mid-sentence. Discover short audio logs that hint at the writer’s unraveling story, and tackle a handful of small puzzles.

games.name: Olivia
games.summary: Once a family home, now stands silent. The past still whispers through every room. You are looking for inspiration for a film, but you will find much more than just a story. Whether the lights are on or off... it doesn't matter. Olivia will find you.

games.name: Pa!nt
games.summary:
Changing colors opens the way!
Enjoy 60 colorful puzzles with the adorable Muni.
Clear stages and freely decorate your own notebook world!

games.name: Paranormal Activity: Threshold
games.summary: Pierce the veil Play multiple timelines, communicate with entities, end the nightmare.

games.name: Pazleum
games.summary: Assemble 3D jigsaw puzzles of famous works of art, sculptures, artifacts (and more!) in a familiar puzzle format, framed in a visually stunning experience with immersive soundscapes and intuitive mechanics. Discover humanity's most prized artwork in a relaxing puzzle game, piece by piece.

games.name: Pharma Craft
games.summary: Pharma Craft: Build your lab from the ground up, research new recipes, optimize production chains, and craft valuable products. Produce in batches, improve quality, and sell your results to keep expanding.

games.name: Place: Weapon Workshop
games.summary: Place: Weapon Workshop is a casual 2D idle roguelite raising game. Unlock blueprints, forge weapons, gather resources, upgrade buildings, optimize stats and grow stronger to dominate the arena.

games.name: Pocket Ludo
games.summary: Classic board game, bringing simple dice-based strategy to your screen. Designed for up to four players, it offers quick, turn-based gameplay that’s easy to learn and fun for all ages.

games.name: Police Chief
games.summary: Police Chief is a casual mobile strategy and management game where players take control of a city's law enforcement forces. Players are tasked with expanding their precinct from a small station into a high-tech facility by building armories, managing inmates, training elite officers, and executing tactical operations.

games.name: Portal Guardians
games.summary: Incinerate, cut, gut everyone who wants to get into the portal. Use the full power of your arsenal and traps! Protect the portal by destroying crowds of enemies!

games.name: President of Steel
games.summary: President of Steel is a choice-driven political strategy game where every decision shapes the fate of your nation. Balance power, stability, and economy while navigating political intrigue, war threats, organized crime, and personal relationships.

games.name: Primal Dinosaur Shooter: Dino Killer
games.summary: Primal Dinosaur Shooter: Dino Killer throws you into an era where dinosaurs once again rule the land. In a hostile environment, you are the last hope to restore balance. Armed with modern weapons and unshakable determination, you face a relentless battle against prehistoric creatures that hunt without mercy. Every step could be your last, and survival depends solely on you.

games.name: Pétanque 2026
games.summary: PÉTANQUE 2026 is a modern and immersive pétanque experience. Play solo or with friends locally or via Steam Remote Play Together, and rediscover all the precision, strategy, and conviviality of this iconic sport.

games.name: Relic Arena
games.summary: Relic Arena is an 8-player free-to-play autobattler by Dota 2 personalities SUNSfan and Jenkins. Equip heroes with historical relics, that provide unique abilities and upgrades, under the command of legendary historical figures such as Cleopatra and Harambe.

games.name: Singularity
games.summary: Explore 4 Whole Chapters For Free In Singularity. In these chapters, you may explore many different paths, enjoy a soundtrack that is made up of 28 Original pieces (They Do Loop), retro inspired UI and art, in this single player dystopian novel in video game format. (:

games.name: Songs of Silence: Crownless King Expansion
games.summary:
A rogue and his ragtag family of troublemakers carve out a cozy life on the edge of the Silence-ridden Midlands. But comfort rarely lasts... When hungry kingdoms move to feast on what remains of the realm, sharp tongues, light fingers, and highly questionable honor unexpectedly become the Midlands’ last hope.

Join Thorn's lot in both campaign and skirmish, with this Songs of Silence expansion!

games.name: Soup: The Vibe Explorer
games.summary: A simple walking sim, explore rooms, ingest the vibes, and relax. Walk into walls to change the room. There are currently 25 rooms to explore.

games.name: Spin Royale
games.summary: Spin Royale is a bottom-of-screen idle game where your slot machine spins and earns money automatically. Collect rare symbols, upgrade powerful items, and climb the global leaderboard in this endless progression experience!

games.name: Spymaster
games.summary: In a world where privacy and trust are a luxury most can’t afford, the agents of NODE are the last line of defence. Combining action-packed sequences and puzzle-solving in immersive missions, command three elite agents with unique skills and manipulate time using the top secret C.A.S.S.E.T.T.E.

games.name: Star Freight
games.summary: Can you deliver the goods? Board your spaceship and go!

games.name: Stolen Realm Survivors
games.summary: Stolen Realm Survivors is an online co-op survivor-like auto-shooter. Battle hordes of fierce enemies, discover ancient artifacts, merge unique skill trees, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive. Wield the full power of the Stolen Realm. Play solo or with friends against relentless minions!

games.name: Sudoku Mania
games.summary: The concept of the game is to fill a grid with the numbers 1-9 ensuring no repetition across rows or columns.

games.name: Sunset Motel
games.summary: Ready for the transformation of neglected rooms? Ensure customer satisfaction, renovate interiors, design entertainment spaces! Manage your motel in your own style and provide travelers with unforgettable experiences!

games.name: TetherGeist
games.summary: TetherGeist is a 2D Precision Platformer about Mae, a young villager with a mysterious illness that has turned her right of passage into a treacherous journey. Join Mae in her struggle to prove herself as you make your way to a mystical temple using powers of astral projection.

games.name: That Time My School Was Invaded by Dimensional Snakes and Now I'm Bound to a Multiverse Protector!
games.summary: A browser-based survival horror and psychological visual novel where a school is suddenly attacked by giant dimensional snakes. As reality begins to collapse, hidden choices and long-term consequences shape character survival, uncovering a darker multiverse mystery beyond the initial disaster.

games.name: The Greenening
games.summary: The Greenening is a short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

games.name: The Last Nordic Tribe
games.summary: The Last Nordic Tribe is a RPG with survival elements set at the end of Little Ragnarök(536-539 AD), where 95% of Scandinavia's population perished. Survive the frost, battle hunger, foes, and adversity, exploring a brutal world inspired by the early Middle Ages. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Timber Fever
games.summary: Cut down an infinitely tall Tree and defeat its Protectors. Timber Fever is an action, incremental, roguelike where you create chaos by cutting down the Tree of Life using wacky tools.

games.name: Trapped in the Backrooms
games.summary: Trapped in the Backrooms is a psychological horror experience across unsettling, interconnected levels. Navigate shifting environments, uncover hidden truths, and survive entities that adapt to your movement. Each map brings new rules, new threats, and deeper descent into the unknown.

games.name: Trip to Europe 12: Romantic Tour - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Set off on an unforgettable journey through the most picturesque corners of Europe. This time, just the two of you!

games.name: Versebound
games.summary: Slay hordes of enemies and fight mythical bosses in this challenging action roguelike. In a desperate fight for survival you must perform rituals, buildcraft and learn from every misstep to become stronger. Use unique abilities and powerful artifacts to beat every trial in the world of Kalevala!

games.name: Wardrum
games.summary: Lead a tribal warband and time your attacks to the beat of the Wardrum in this tactical turn-based roguelite! Forge a path across a harsh fantasy world full of rhythm magic, face death and strengthen your warriors until you have the power to destroy the dark sorcery infecting the lands.

games.name: What Body?
games.summary: 'What Body?' is a short clicker game, where you clear your room and befriend Mr. Policeman! Made for 20 Second Game Jam 2023.

games.name: What Misaki holds in her hand is her deduction
Will: Follow the Light
games.summary: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?

games.name: Zumba World: The Marble Monster Adventure
games.summary: Match, blast, and survive marble mayhem!

games.name: 8 Ball 4
games.summary: 8 Ball is back with challenges and locations never before seen in the series!!! Come on in and find out why this ball is the most famous in the world.

games.name: Arcane Plunder
games.summary: Explore enchanted dungeons shrouded in magical fog. Reveal hidden paths, uncover treasures, and telekinetically loot artifacts from the shadows. Upgrade your magic, extend your reach and dive deeper into the unknown in this bite sized idle clicker adventure.

games.name: Between Stops
games.summary: Between Stops is a story-driven turn-based RPG with bullet-hell inspired combat. Dodge deadly boss patterns, shape character relationships, and unlock multiple routes where your choices permanently alter the story.

games.name: Bourbon Risky
games.summary: Bourbon Risky is a simple but deep boss rush action game with retro style graphics. Smash all enemies in your way with your eternal companion that blasting bullets and lasers!

games.name: Box Office Mayhem: Theatre Tycoon
games.summary: Box Office Mayhem is a business management game where you simulate running your own movie theatre. Navigate through signing movie deals, managing day to day operations, and struggle as movie goers have unpredictable behavior. Play solo against AI competitors or take it online against friends!

games.name: Chesst
games.summary: A fantasy chess variant. An enchanted board where pawns hide magical secrets. Hatch dragons, transform enemy pieces into unicorns. Outwit clever computer opponents: Jester, Bard, or Wizard —or pass and play. Beginner-friendly to deliciously strategic. Handcrafted pixel art. Local gameplay, so retro!

games.name: Clara Wraiths 2
games.summary: Clara Wraiths 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help out the spirits to move on or find peace.

games.name: Codename: Black Crow
games.summary: Aurora never had a choice. Raised on the battlefield as a child soldier, now the past is back. Codename: Black Crow combines the relentless pace of top-down arcade shooters with RPG progression and a personal, emotional story.

games.name: Corebreaker
games.summary: Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

games.name: Cosmonade
games.summary: Cosmonade is a real-time competitive PvP game — pilot a ship and destroy everything! Designed for players who enjoy gameplay that’s both simple and demanding... Face off against other players in matches where skill, team coordination, and reflexes make all the difference.

games.name: Cow Project 1986
games.summary: A game about an alien that has to abduct things to pay rent!

games.name: Decline's Drops
games.summary: Grab your punching gloves, put your clogs on and smash your way in the world of Decline's Drops, a fully hand-drawn platform-brawler full of weird frogs, bizarre chickens and odd hydras! Avenge your destroyed garden and defeat the 6 heads of the Eternal Corp.! If you can, that is.

games.name: Dentist Bling
games.summary:
Ready for the ultimate dental experience?
Dive into the world of tooth care and become a master dentist!

games.name: Despertar
games.summary: The pandemic continues the deployment curve, but when the people gather is when this virus spreads the most intensity. This is the story of one of the many people who was a victim of this virus from Bayamón, Puerto Rico.

games.name: Drone Simulator: Smash Zombies
games.summary: The world ended. You just didn’t get the memo.

games.name: Endless Maze
games.summary: This is a first-person 3D maze-themed casual game. The game features many different interesting mazes, each with its own characteristics. Each level is relatively short, focusing on the fun of the maze. Additionally, it also offers randomly generated traditional mazes of selectable sizes.

games.name: Epicurean
games.summary: Play a deadly food-themed card game with a criminal syndicate and uncover the stories of the two central characters.

games.name: Everything Is Crab
games.summary: The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: FNAF: The Flipside
games.summary: In the year 1972, just when you thought your working days were over, an unexpected call pulls you back in. The job is simple - help MCM run some tests on their latest prototypes for one of their biggest contractors. Watch their movements, report any malfunctions, and stay alert - you never know what secrets they're hiding

games.name: Flash Diving
games.summary: Short horror game where you survey the descent of a capsule through a hole in the middle of an ocean, with only 4 lights and your ears to ensure your surroundings remain clear.

games.name: For the Glory of Wilson
games.summary: For the Glory of Wilson is an action roguelite focused on ally-based combat and dungeon exploration. Players recruit companions with different combat roles while progressing through randomized runs featuring melee and ranged combat.

games.name: Hellbreak
games.summary: Fight to save your soul from damnation in a brutal arena where only the strongest survive. Entertain the Lords of Hell and earn their favor to unlock new weapons, spells, and blessings. Dive into this fast-paced roguelite arena shooter and achieve the highest score. Can you reclaim your soul?

games.name: Holy Grail for Dummies
games.summary: Holy Grail for Dummies is a colorful and absurd action-platformer about Buckethead, a hero past his prime, in a world that, let's be honest, has seen better days...

games.name: Hydroneer
games.summary: Hydroneer is a mining and base building sandbox. Dig for gold and other resources to turn a profit and enhance your mining operation. Build a base of operations, forge weapons, go fishing, and dig deep!

games.name: Intersectio
games.summary: Intersectio is a turn-based tactics game about the fragile balance between body, mind, and soul. It tells the story of a person caught between two abysses — to survive, they must maintain equilibrium.

games.name: Island Survive Simulator: Craft, Build, Grow
games.summary: Lost in the middle of nowhere. No rescue. No second chances.

games.name: Jackpot Crash Course
games.summary: In a game show starring only criminals, you must gamble against rival players to prove yourself worthy of being pardoned for your wrong deeds— But is the show really about proving your innocence? Jackpot Crash Course is a death game visual novel about crime, luck and spectacle.

games.name: Kids on Site: Hard Hat Edition
games.summary:
Originally developed by Digital Pictures and released in 1994, Kids On Site has been completely rebuilt from the ground up with HD video.

In Kids on Site: Hard Hat Edition, you will be able to take the controls of the excavator, bulldozer, steamroller, and the wrecking ball. Your goal is to complete all of the objectives at each construction site in order to earn your merit badge.

Let the colorful and zany cast of characters, Bertha, Dizzy, Nuts and the Coffee Break Gang guide your kids through the real thrills of operating heavy construction equipment. Kids on Site delivers 100% real video with instant interactive response. Your kid’s in charge, at the control of real monster machines in a real construction site and working with real people, not cartoon characters. With Kids On Site, they’ll be digging in the dirt, swinging that wrecking ball. Making new friends and most of all, having fun! (Hard hat not included.)

games.name: Kingdom Trails
games.summary: Step into a peaceful world where every path tells a story.

games.name: Kodoku
games.summary:
Kodoku is a single-player survival horror game.

Within an otherworld sealed inside a jar, players must gather “Souls” while hiding from relentless, nightmarish creatures.

games.name: Kuentame
games.summary: A bizarre, top-down, bullet hell platformer about someone who doesn't desire connection, in a world in which everything is connected.

games.name: Little Things
games.summary: A colorful story

games.name: Lost Little Things
games.summary: Embark on a whimsical hidden-object adventure with Lost Little Things! Hunt lost treasures, complete missions, explore ancient temples, and visit moonlit festivals. Alongside your wise cat sensei, meet quirky yokai, uncover hidden secrets, and immerse yourself in a relaxing, magical adventure!

games.name: Malware City
games.summary: A skilled hacker has unleashed a powerful trojan. What will happen to the computers it infects? Help Vundo navigate through Malware City, a 2D platformer inspired by the dawn of personal computers. Infect as many systems as you can and become the most feared trojan to ever exist.

games.name: Marshmallow Marvin: Greenwood
games.summary: Marshmallow Marvin on a sweet new adventure in Greenwood! Explore a magical forest full of vibrant mysteries, quirky creatures, and hidden secrets, where every corner holds a new challenge for our squishy hero!

games.name: Millionaire Obby
games.summary: Climb, jump, and conquer your way to millionaire status

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: Nocturne is a story focused RPG about facing your fears and self discovery with grid turn based combat.

games.name: Outlanders: Exiles of Veridion
games.summary: Outlanders is a sci-fi open-world survival game set on Veridion Prime. Build your base, fight hostile factions, explore alien biomes, craft advanced gear, and survive deadly environmental threats in a living world shaped by your choices.

games.name: Pairvo
games.summary: Pairvo is a satisfying roguelike card game where you memorize cards revealed at the start of each phase, discover rule cards that change the game's mechanics, and chase high scores with fluid combos, making every round and run feel unique.

games.name: Project Rod3nt
games.summary: Project Rod3nt is an action-adventure sandbox that mixes cute rod3nts with weapons of mass destruction to create the ultimate time-bending stealth-chaos experience. Play as cybernetic rodents and time travel to save the world. We want YOU for Project Rod3nt. Will you step up to join the cause?

games.name: Protocol: Umbra
games.summary: Protocol: Umbra is an unsettling, observation-driven psychological horror game inspired by I’m on Observation Duty and FNaF, built in Python with Pygame-CE and powered by my own UI framework, Tessella.

games.name: Random Coin
games.summary: Buy, sell, and grow your capital in this simple, fast, and addictive trading simulation. Earn Prestige Coins and climb the Steam leaderboard.

games.name: Red Door Yellow Door
games.summary:
Red Door Yellow Door is a procedurally generated horror game in which you explore an ever-changing labyrinth, complete tasks, and evade relentless creatures to escape. Each round offers new paths, new dangers, and no second chances.

Immerse yourself in an ever-changing labyrinth that consists not only of rooms—but of your own subconscious.

In Red Door, Yellow Door, you explore endless corridors, open doors to the unknown, and face a world that reshapes itself with every playthrough. No path remains the same. No decision is certain.

games.name: Rosa's Quest
games.summary:
An indie platformer game made as a final project by a group of high schoolers.

Steam description: The ocean attacks! Aquatic creatures have seized control of the planet. Cities are in ruins, suburbs are flooded, and humans have not been seen since. In ROSA's Quest, take control of a Rescue Operations and Safety Android, destroy the leaders of the oceanic army, and recover what was lost.

games.name: Rova
games.summary: Rova is a cozy space-rover photography game. Help a new space colony conduct research on large spherical planets, by documenting elements of alien worlds through photography. ROVA is a game about discovery and exploration.

games.name: Scary Game 2: The Mad Shepherd
games.summary: Your first day as the new shepherd in the village... and everything goes wrong. The animals are missing. The villagers are strange. The truth is even more terrifying.

games.name: Scorchie Adventures
games.summary: A platformer game in which you play as Scorchie, a friendly and hyperactive will-o'-wisp who's able to pass through a variety of obstacles using their dash ability and fire properties.

games.name: Scoundrel's Dungeon
games.summary: Scoundrel's Dungeon is a brutal roguelike card game built on the classic Scoundrel. Each dungeon floor is a deadly hand of cards. Fight monsters with dangerous modifiers, collect powerful items and upgrade your cards to survive. Every floor hits harder. Every decision matters. How deep can you go?

games.name: Silliards
games.summary: A 3D physics-based game where you must explore a variety of absurd levels through the mind’s eye of a budding billiards monk. Do you have what it takes to reach Billiards Nirvana?

games.name: Sky Abyss
games.summary: This is a high-difficulty jump action game where you overcome a variety of gimmicks using just three simple actions: forward jump, vertical jump, and movement! Through trial and error, aim to reach the top of the tower!

games.name: Spirit of the Dome
games.summary: Tower defense game where you defend against waves of enemies and dark forces across a decaying world.

games.name: Super Adventure Hand
games.summary: It’s the world’s most adventurous hand! You play as a hand on a gripping handventure, a quest, a calling, through a strange and dangerous world. And in the end figure out why your beloved arm has left you.

games.name: The Hidden Room: Pyramid
games.summary: Continue your adventure in The Hidden Room with The Hidden Room: Pyramid! After what happened in Tom Barkley's house, you think that it's not over yet. That something else might have been hidden. This is your chance to find it out...again

games.name: Top Shot Pool
games.summary: Step up to the table in Top Shot Pool - the ultimate cue-sport experience combining realistic physics with fun, competitive arcade action.

games.name: ¿Me verán?
games.summary: Will They See Me? is a visual novel where you play as a transgender woman who is worried about whether or not she is perceived as a woman. With the help of a magical website, she becomes a ghost and spies into the minds of others to find out what they think of her. There are three endings depending on the interactions she has with other people.

games.name: Above Eden
games.summary:
"As fog obscured the moon, I accepted those words, and she chose levitation."
Above Eden is a short visual novel about a girl.

games.name: Antique Backgammon
games.summary: Classic backgammon, simple and familiar

games.name: BanHown
games.summary: There was a widespread epidemic crisis, causing utilities and industry to halt, resulting in famine until the city became uninhabited. This forced people to rely on themselves for survival. However there is a family area coming and have decided to return to live in other provinces.

games.name: Barbarous: Survivor's Quest
games.summary: Battle the horde and survive the quest!

games.name: Duplicity Loop
games.summary: A dark magical girl VN that takes place in an Alice in Wonderland inspired world.

games.name: ECH8
games.summary: ECH8 is a single-player narrative puzzle game about uncovering the mystery behind the disappearance of an entire species. Communicate with their past to uncover the truth and decide the future of their species. Will you uncover the truth in time, or are you doomed to make the same mistakes?

games.name: Ecchi Crush
games.summary: One hot match leads to another.

games.summary: FNaF All-Stars is a bite-sized Fnaf experience that aims to be on the short-but-sweet side of things, featuring 5 main nights, 5 challenges, a custom night, an endless mode and a few achievements to get!

games.name: Farm to Table
games.summary: A farming & restaurant management sim with base building elements. Grow in backyard to cook & serve! Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island; gather, fish, raise animals & produce with machines. Manage resources, hire staff & grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!

games.name: Hand-me-downs
games.summary: A roguelike deck builder where you are your own worst enemy. Manage your deck as your opponents use your old hands against you. Use powerful trinkets to take full control of the table.

games.name: Ichika-chan Kanippatsu
games.summary:
A game of strip rock-paper-scissors!
If you win…Ichika will take off one piece of clothing at a time!
If you manage to get her completely naked…You’ll get a reward!

games.name: It's Too Late to Apologize
games.summary: A strange puzzle adventure in ancient ruins, defying worship and casting birthday cakes into the abyss.

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Around the World

games.summary: Escape together or die alone. In this intense co-op bodycam horror game, you and your team are hunted by a relentless creature. Communicate, stay quiet, and fight to survive. Every move counts. Every sound could be your last.

games.summary: Escape together - or die alone. In this intense co-op bodycam horror game, you and your team are hunted by a relentless creature. Communicate, stay quiet, and fight to survive. Every move counts. Every sound could be your last.

games.name: Orpheus: Echo of Hades
games.summary: Eurydice died on an ordinary autumn day — in a garden, among flowers, while Orpheus sat beneath an apple tree finishing his melody. Now the greatest musician of his time packs a bag and heads somewhere the living aren't usually allowed to go.

games.name: Periodic Lottery
games.summary: “Periodic Table Lottery” combines lottery-style gameplay with the periodic table. Place bets, earn rewards, complete level objectives, and see how far you can go!

games.name: Pixelarium: Free Lands
games.summary: Pixelarium is an open-world roguelike RPG with deep character building, fluid turn-based combat, rich lore, and ASCII-inspired art. Collect unique items, master powerful spells, and embark on quests as you uncover secrets in the Free Lands.

games.name: Sakura Drift
games.summary: Unleash high-octane chaos in Sakura Drift! Experience a stunning 3D anime open world where racing has no limits. Switch between ultra-fast cars, bikes, and jetskis in high-fidelity environments. Explore, compete, and dominate land and sea in the ultimate next-gen racing adventure.

games.name: Sopwith
games.summary:
Originally created by David L. Clark in 1984, Sopwith became one of the most beloved shareware games of the DOS era. This Unity remake preserves the tight, responsive gameplay of the original while bringing it to modern systems with Steam multiplayer support.

Easy to pick up, tough to master. Can you clear all eight levels?

Make choices that will drastically shape the outcome of their stories in this exciting visual novel. Live through their experiences as you read through their stories and follow the ladies to the thrilling conclusion.

games.name: 100 Marshmallow Cats

games.name: Aquanore

games.name: Beach Ball Bounce Back

Ward Off Evil Spirits by Wielding Saint Brigid's Cross!

Bounce your crosses off the environment to kill the Evil Puca and Defend Ireland.
Every level has multiple solutions.
Can you beat them all in the least amount of throws?

Made for the Diagra 2026 Ireland Convention
