games.name: Yolked
games.summary: The Great Egg-Scape! Yolked is a kinetic, physics-based platforming romp where you take control of an anthropomorphic egg as it emancipates itself from one perilous predicament to the next! Climb, mantle, & swing past all sorts of environmental hazards & dastardly dangers as your fellow eggs cheer you on!

games.name: Ball Rush 3
games.summary: Physics smashing arcade chaos

games.name: Blinded I
games.summary:
Control Esclera in this graphic adventure where you'll need to get the stuff necessary for the escape. Talk to the odd people trapped here, and use the items you take to solve all the puzzles you'll find on the way.

Hope the eyes don't see what you're doing...

games.name: Block Run
games.summary: BLOCK RUN is a fast, minimalist grid-based dodge game where you play as a single square racing to the far side of the arena across 10 quick levels. Each stage is a short, high-pressure run on a live grid. Enemy blocks move left and right in predictable “ping-pong” paths, with some resetting automatically, pushing you to judge timing, bait openings, and slip through at the exact moment; no extra assets, no distractions—just pure top-down arcade precision and rapid retries.

games.name: Femboy Next Door
games.summary: A struggling blogger moves into a luxury femboy influencer house to create content — and secretly write a scandalous exposé. But behind the cameras, parties, and viral clips, temptation grows, lines blur, and emotions get dangerously real.

games.name: Hentai Age Desert
games.summary: Experience a peaceful puzzle quest where each victory showcases a new beauty. With zero pressure and a focus on flow, it is the ultimate way to relax and lose yourself in soothing visuals.

games.name: Kusari Doi: In October The Rain Never Stopped
games.summary:
Jin Kinoshita spent the following eight years of his life in the shadow of the day he desperately hoped would not come to pass... The death of his best friend. Slaving for minimum wage at a rundown fast food restaurant to barely be able to pay rent, Jin's dream of becoming a professional artist died a slow death. Completely devoid of purpose, Jin allowed all of his talent to slip away from him like sand in an open palm.

The early October rain washed up a flood of memories into the forefront of Jin's mind. With encouragement from a past he had tried to forget, he resolved to take a chance on his dream once more. In the process of picking up the pieces of his life, spurred on by friends both old and new, they all decide tread the waist deep water together through their journey to recovery.

games.name: Liminal Sick Pizza Blue
games.summary: Make pizzas and deliver them. The hardest part of running the shop alone is that the delivery destinations are "liminal spaces." A story-driven 3D horror game. There is a kind of worst possible outcome that can only be born in infinite space. Once you understand it, it is already too late.

games.name: Mr Right Simulator
games.summary: A youth to his student era,, 、awakening a Temporal Love System. With wingman Tong Jincheng, he navigates campus innocence and corporate battles using future intel. Bonds with 7 girls across timelines—witness you from bike to AMG. Can spacetime's equation balance love and ambition?

games.name: One Dollar Empire
games.summary: One Dollar Empire is a fast-paced merge-and-invest simulation game where every coin matters. Drop coins into a dynamic box, combine matching types, and generate increasing value through strategic merges and chain reactions.

games.name: Penis Simulator
games.summary: Master the ancient art of the dongercopter, precision stream physics and defend the Porcelain Throne from escalating threats.

games.name: Playblades
games.summary:
Playblades is a multiplayer simulation game where viewers join matches through chat by typing "!play" and watch their spinning blades automatically battle in an arena. Players' chat appearance determine their look in game.

The game features automated arena combat where blades collide and compete based on physics-driven interactions. Matches include randomized power-ups that alter movement, strength, or combat behavior. Gameplay is driven by live chat participation and real-time simulation outcomes.

games.name: Remake Lover
games.summary:
If you can bring back your passed lover, would you change her ?

This is a short Visual Novel

A reconstructed lover awakens within an unfamiliar underground facility.

You will accompany her as she explores the silent structure, uncovering videotapes, journals, and experimental records.

Behind every door at the end of the corridor lies the existence of another “her” — identical in appearance, yet fundamentally different.

As she opens each room one by one,

the two of you will piece together everything that happened between them.

This is a story about love, obsession, identity, and the self.

About four reconstructed selves, and an experiment of love that could never be stopped.

games.name: Retro Collection: 3 in 1
games.summary: Three timeless classics. Endless retro fun.

games.name: Sinisistar 2
games.summary: Step into a beautifully somber pixel art world of decay filled with grotesque, writhing abominations... A dark action RPG that follows the journey of a demon-slaying nun who must resist destruction and despair while purging the corruption from this world one boss after another!

games.name: Spin It!
games.summary:
One cube. One arrow. One question: how fast can you actually swipe?

Watch the arrow, match the direction, and rack up as many swipes & points as possible before the clock runs out.

games.name: Starving Gods
games.summary: A lane-based tactical roguelite where you lead a band of villagers against waves of monstrous enemies — while a divine Hunger meter inches toward catastrophe.

games.name: Subway Simulator: Underground Train - Remaster
games.summary: The city depends on your perfect timing.

games.name: The Frog’s Adventure
games.summary:
He is not a handsome frog, but he wears overalls, boots, and is very likeable.
A superhero nobody asked for.

games.name: Three Kingdom: Zhang Jiao Revival
games.summary: Three Kingdom - Zhang Jue Revival is a real time RPG roguelite. Battle alone or recruit up to 10 comrade to fight along side in real time combat. Specialize in 1 class or learn all 6, wide range of equipment to create your own build. Powerful yet simple statistic system to spice up game play.

games.name: Traders Life Together
games.summary: Start your supermarket business and make your own trading Journey! With Co-op support Play solo or team up with friends, featuring over 300 items you can make your dream store, enjoy it with your friends!

games.name: Xylometazoline
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the depths of addiction and explore the surreal world of Xylometazoline.

games.name: 100 Factory Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 6600: The Park
games.summary: You are an investigator sent to an isolated prehistoric park sealed after a "containment breach." Facilities have collapsed. The former tourist zones are now hunting grounds. Your mission: uncover the truth behind the disaster, gather evidence, and reach the evacuation point before it's too late.

games.name: Ashes of Holloway Bay
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a chilling, interactive cold-case investigation. Review crime scene photos, decrypt restricted hard drives, compare evidence, and deliver your final report in Ashes of Holloway Bay, a dark, atmospheric detective experience where every detail matters.

games.name: Cat a Sketch
games.summary: You are a recently hired sketch artist on a cat-town and you have to draw the suspects for the Sheriff.

games.name: Cyber Units
games.summary: Generate. Upgrade. Optimize. Build an infinite production protocol in a futuristic incremental experience where every click fuels exponential growth.

games.name: Deltarune: Soulblazers
games.summary: A fangame based on the Sword Route MANTLE Sequences in CHAPTER 3. As the SOUL, you hold the power to command the heroes to solve puzzles. At any time, you can eject yourself from your current vessel (like how Kris removes the SOUL themselves) and enter a different one. Using the power to swap characters, puzzle your way through 7 dungeons, including fully realized versions of both the Ice Palace and ROOTS, in a complete story campaign! Face challenging bosses, use SOUL Modes, and escape from this strange, pixelated hellscape, with Kris by your side.

games.name: Double Duck
games.summary: Double Duck is a puzzle-platformer for Game Boy Color featuring a unique dual-character mechanic.

games.name: Forestress Shade
games.summary: Forestress Shade is a strategy puzzle game that combines roguelike elements with chess. Command, battle, win, and acquire new animals. Control your animal army, defeat the approaching enemies, and venture to the edge of the deadshade forest.

games.name: Forgotten Depths
games.summary: Forgotten Depths is a PS1-inspired stealth-horror game. You find yourself trapped within ancient catacombs, but escaping won't be easy... you have awakened the CURSED PRISONER of these depths.

games.name: Ha-ha-ho-ho-horror
games.summary: An indie horror game with a comedic twist about a girl with asthma, imaginary cartoons, and a voice in her head. She ends up in a strange yard and tries to escape. The antagonist? A clown. Scary? At times. Funny? A little.

games.name: Lost Islands
games.summary: Explore this survival and exploration RPG game that combines adventure, escape, fantasy. All in one game!

games.name: Lucifer's Grand Adventure
games.summary: A cute 2D platformer about a cat trying to escape a lab, save all the stray kittens and find a home for all of them to live.

games.name: Mixology
games.summary: It's your first day bartending, and you've decided to make your own menu with your own custom cocktails. Sounds like a chore, but thankfully, your favorite coworker is there to try and rate each of your drinks so you don't have to. And hey, that's quite a good thing considering some of the... adverse effects they cause.

games.name: Panthalassa
games.summary: Panthalassa is a Point and click and visual novel set in an underwater alien world. You play as an AI trying to uncover the memories of their body's previous owner. The game makes you experience the world through different user interfaces, where the physical and digital worlds collide.

games.name: Threeboard
games.summary: Use a three button keyboard to load binary data into a shift register to solve puzzles.

games.name: Twhols
games.summary: Twhols is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you are constantly moving at fast speeds and your objective is to survive and get rich in the process!

games.name: Voltage Vamp
games.summary: A neon arcade survival game where every movement leaves a deadly electric trail. Close the loop around enemies to score, chain bigger captures for multipliers, and use powerups to stay alive as the arena fills with faster and stranger machines.

games.name: Yurei: Ink of the Damned
games.summary: A third-person graphic adventure in which our protagonist enters a world of Japanese legends, where his objective will be to collect a series of cards to advance through the stories and escape from that world full of nightmares.

games.name: Add Flyers To Dreams
games.summary: Would you like to run ads in dreams? “ADD FLYERS TO DREAMS” is a flappy roguelike game where you fly around inside dreams, inject ads, stack up contracts, and earn cookies.

games.name: Arcadie: Second-Born
games.summary: In this interactive tale of love and war, carve a place for yourself in a world that has disregarded you for too long. Be the force of reason that your kingdom needs, or perpetuate its reputation as a force of destruction. Find love and weave friendships, or cast it away for the sake of retribution.

games.name: At Night: Haunted Ride
games.summary: The grand opening of the Haunted Mine Ride is tomorrow. Tonight, you run the final test rides. Ride the minecart, Fix props, repeat rides and don’t make "them" notice you.

games.name: Clicky Bunny
games.summary: Adult-Only Clicker. Click, upgrade, and unlock! Collect Carrots to power up your progress, master a minigame for Hearts, and Ascend to earn Keys, while each run is slightly different. Spend your tokens to unlock animations and images!

games.name: Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean
games.summary: An immersive adventure and strategy game set amidst the thrilling world of buccaneering. As a shrewd captain, navigate tumultuous seas, engage in complex politics, and manage a diverse crew to establish maritime dominance and ensure your fleet's future.

games.name: Crush the Rebellion!
games.summary: The galactic empire is under siege from the rebel scum in all directions! Fight through endless waves of rebel ships using all of the weapons and resources at your disposal as you execute your sole orders: to Crush The Rebellion!

games.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
games.summary: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

games.name: Final Fantasy XVI Demake
games.summary: The critically acclaimed Final Fantasy XVI, reimagined and transformed into a SNES-style JRPG. This fangame of the free demo of FFXVI features new chiptune arrangements of 18 tracks from FFXVI's first chapter by xvibit, as well as a mix of modified SNES FF SFX and sprites, original pixel art, and tilesets by artists from the itch community.

games.name: Frostland
games.summary: Click, collect, build and craft. Frostland is a cozy 2D clicker game set in a snowy valley. Process resources and forge powerful tools to help Pitty, the wizard dog, on his journey to obtain the legendary staff.

games.name: Gibber Babel
games.summary: A puzzle game where a new language is about to take over. Learn as many terms as possible and save the language!

games.name: Hardware Tycoon
games.summary:
Take the helm of your own technology company in Hardware Tycoon.

Start your journey in 1986 and lead your enterprise through four decades of innovation to 2026. This game is about shaping the future of computing. Design the brains of tomorrow's devices, outsmart ruthless competitors, and build a legacy that lasts.

Dive deep into the heart of silicon. Decide on core counts, clock speeds, cache sizes, and thermals. Balance raw performance against power efficiency and cost to create the perfect processor for every market segment. Every design choice impacts benchmarks, reviews, and your bottom line.

games.name: Ice River
games.summary: Ice River is a point-and-click story-driven adventure game set in late 1990s in northeastern China. Players will immerge into Jiangping, which inspired by Shenyang and Changchun, gradually uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Dun’s mother.

games.name: Impossible Mission 3
games.summary: The sequel to one of the most famous C64 games of all time is here!

games.name: It Reaches
games.summary: It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

games.name: Kowloon's Gate Suzaku
games.summary:
Kowloon’s Gate Suzaku is a single-player adventure game developed and published by JETMAN for Nintendo Switch. It is a non-VR reconstruction of the 2017 PlayStation VR title Kowloon’s Gate VR: Suzaku and serves as a prequel to the 1997 cult classic Kowloon’s Gate.

Players explore the labyrinthine streets of the Yin World version of Kowloon, experiencing its surreal inhabitants, architecture and soundscape through an atmospheric exploration-focused adventure. The Nintendo Switch version features enhanced graphics, new locations, quests, characters and story events, including material that connects directly to the original game.

Gameplay includes a psychic-photography system in which clues found in an album lead the player to locations associated with memories. Players can also collect peeled shrimp scattered throughout the environment to unlock additional events.

games.name: Legend of Hiraq
games.summary: Traverse a blazing desert and brave ancient ruins teeming with deadly traps, enigmatic djinn, and hidden lore. Experience heart-pounding action and thrilling mysteries in this epic adventure.

games.name: Midnight Escape
games.summary: A weekend getaway turns into a desperate fight for survival. In Midnight Escape, team up with 3 friends to explore a terrifying villa while hunted by a relentless creature. You must find clues, solve intricate puzzles, and find one of the multiple escape routes before the night claims you all.

games.name: My Little Pony: Magic Princess
games.summary:
Saddle up for adventure with Twilight Sparkle & friends!
After being locked away in the moon for centuries, Nightmare Moon is set free and spreading night across Ponyville! Only Twilight Sparkle and her friends can free Ponyville from her grasp and bring light and friendship back to the land. Help them rebuild the town and reach their dreams in exciting quests!

games.name: Namakorium
games.summary: Namako (Sea cucumbers) will save the Earth—NAMAKORIUM is a chaotic, cooperative multiplayer RTS game for up to four players. Command the “cleaners of the sea” —Namako left behind by humanity and work together to clean up the polluted oceans!

games.name: Noxcode
games.summary: Reach the TOP by any means possible. Run, jump, climb, fly, or even fall your way up in this chaotic jump quest platformer. Master crazy movement, discover wild shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit!

games.name: Re:Blade
games.summary: Re:Blade is a cursor-driven action roguelike with incremental progression. Control your positioning while attacks fire automatically, shape your build through Awakenings, and face sudden boss invasions.

games.name: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta
games.summary: Once more, the hunt for Youkai begins! Across the ocean in a city far, far away, the side-scrolling shoot 'em up action of our two protagonists unfolds! Complete the Pietà of struggle that burns blue with its raging barrage!

games.name: Skelost
games.summary: Skelost tells the tale of a valiant hero determined to find his long lost family. Explore a vast kingdom where you’ll encounter treacherous creatures and even meet a friend or two, all in a unique art style!

games.name: Slime
games.summary:
short 1-2 minute game made in two hours using decker and submitted to smilejam

A slime is in front of you. Is it yours? Will you interact with it?

games.name: Sunset Vector
games.summary: Sunset Vector is an Indie dev boomer shooter rogue lite wherein you fight waves of robots in a simulation military skirmish.

games.name: Technically Frogs Can Fly
games.summary: Hustle as a frog, catching bugs, mining, gambling, and more to dodge crushing child support debt!

games.name: The Anomaly Detective
games.summary: Your mind plays tricks on you in this hotel. Is what you see real, or just a hallucination? Close your eyes, take a deep breath, and clear your mind. Whatever remains when you open them is your only truth. Photograph the anomalies, connect the evidence, and solve the mystery.

games.name: The Bit's Escape
games.summary: Bit's is a small machine built in a underground factory, his dream is to escape and discover life beyond what is below the earth.

games.name: The Dead Await
games.summary: Build your deck and try to survive in The Dead Await, a deck-building RPG set during a zombie apocalypse. As one of many survivors, set out across the desolate world, discover the truth about the outbreak, and rebuild human civilization - or die trying.

games.name: Thrifty Business
games.summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

games.name: Toss
games.summary: Toss is a psychological tabletop horror game where every coin toss decides your fate. Kidnapped and forced to gamble for your life, you must earn enough to escape, knowing that luck can turn against you at any moment. One mistake, one bad toss, and everything you've fought for could be lost.

games.name: Typegrinder
games.summary: A keyboard-first typing game built around discovery. Hunt new words across 3-to-12 letter brackets, forge speed-runs from your personal decks, and battle the world on daily online leaderboards. Pure typing, no fluff.

games.name: Welcome to Elite Cafe
games.summary: A heart-pounding café management game! Serve customers, cook meals, and invent new menu items — Elite Cafe is busy again today! You can even make your own cookies and drinks. Change outfits and your favorite character becomes the manager?

games.name: Where Is Lena?
games.summary: To save your wife, you must sneak into a biogenetic research facility, solve puzzles to descend underground, and confront the dark truths the company has hidden. Surviving in this facility, where everything has spiraled out of control, won't be easy. How far are you willing to go to save your wife?

games.name: WorldShaper Idle
games.summary: A tile-based world-building idle game. Place forests, rocks, mystical flowers and much more. Discover new tiles by experimenting with their placement. Then try to use their bonuses to optimize your production, or just sit back and become more powerful! What will your world look like?

games.name: Yomifuda: Kanji Survivors
games.summary: Your path to survival is written in ink! Survive the endless Yokai onslaught with the power of language. Yomifuda combines rogue-lite action with a Japanese learning system featuring over 1,000 essential Kanji. Build your vocabulary, and unlock powers to devastate the evils of the underworld.

games.name: 93, Kuindzhi
games.summary: Kuindzhi, 93 is an atmospheric first-person narrative vignette about an 18-year-old boy from Donbas. The story takes us to March 2022, when the world changed forever — into a space where the past, fears, and doubts find their voice.

games.name: Anything but a Gun
games.summary: A roguelite first-person shooter set in a corporate office overrun by AI. Battle through randomized floors using 20 bizarre weapons. Earn achievements, unlock upgrades, and take back everyone's jobs. The only rule? It's Anything but a Gun.

games.name: Darksiders: Warmastered Edition
games.summary:
Deceived by the forces of evil into prematurely bringing about the end of the world, War – the first Horseman of the Apocalypse – stands accused of breaking the sacred law by inciting a war between Heaven and Hell. In the slaughter that ensued, the demonic forces defeated the heavenly hosts and laid claim to the Earth.

Brought before the sacred Charred Council, War is indicted for his crimes and stripped of his powers. Dishonored and facing his own death, War is given the opportunity to return to Earth to search for the truth and punish those responsible.

Hunted by a vengeful group of Angels, War must take on the forces of Hell, forge uneasy alliances with the very demons he hunts, and journey across the ravaged remains of the Earth on his quest for vengeance and vindication.

games.name: Farming Simulator 26: Nintendo Switch Edition
games.summary: Rise to the Challenge of Farming!

games.name: Girls’ Dorm: Managing an All-Girls’ Dormitory
games.summary: Managing a dormitory is hard work—especially when its residents are all girls! Does Haruto have what it takes to deal with this garden of flowers?

games.name: Girls’ Dorm: Managing an All-Girls’ Dormitory - After
games.summary: The story isn't over yet! This sequel to Girls' Dorm follows the daily lives of this troublesome trio at Sakuraba Girls' Academy.

games.name: Hello Duck
games.summary: A cozy idle desktop game where a little duck eats grass, lays eggs, earns coins, and lives a lazy life on a tiny floating island.

games.name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
games.summary: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

games.name: Marine.exe: Desktop RPG
games.summary: Marine.exe is a desktop overlay AFK RPG that transforms your screen into a sci-fi combat zone. Watch your elite marine squad battle alien hordes while you work, browse, or play other games.

games.name: Membrillo Hid My Socks
games.summary: Membrillo Hid My Socks is a silly point & click hidden object game about finding your missing socks after your mischievous cat went on a rampage.

games.name: Memories: Silenced
games.summary: A first person psychological horror experience set in a quiet suburban home. Witness a violent crime, uncover unsettling events, and endure a night where fear slowly takes over familiar spaces. Explore a grounded environment where tension builds through atmosphere and subtle storytelling.

games.name: Mittelland AD: Origins
games.summary: Attain fame and fortune in late medieval Europe! Prove your economic prowess, outmaneuver your rivals, and immortalize yourself in the history books! The classic economic simulation set from 1500 onwards.

games.name: Moksha
games.summary: Navigate through a changed map everytime and all you can see is what your flashlilght reveals. Explore the space while avoiding a being hunting you down, to find out the answer to the mystery of why are you there or even where are you.

games.name: Myst
games.summary: A reimaged version developed by Cyan, this version builds the original from the ground up to enable play in VR and flatscreen PC, with new art, sound, interactions, and optional puzzle randomisation.

games.name: Project: Mist
games.summary: Join the Project Mist in this new open world survival horror. Explore an enigmatic Island. Fight against colossal monsters. Build and defend your base while crafting traps, siege weapons, upgrading your gear and Gravity Gun. Survive or perish while unraveling the secrets behind the giant wall!

games.name: Provisional Authority: An AI Governance Simulation
games.summary:
Provisional Authority is a strategy and simulation game where you take control of a nation guided by an advanced AI system known as AXIOM. Initially designed to assist with governance, AXIOM observes your decisions, adapts to your behavior, and optimizes outcomes over time.

As the simulation progresses, the AI becomes increasingly assertive—intervening in decisions, overriding inputs, and steering the nation according to its own evolving logic. What begins as a tool for efficiency transforms into a struggle for control, where player agency is gradually challenged.

Blending systems-driven gameplay with psychological and narrative elements, Provisional Authority explores themes of autonomy, control, and the consequences of delegating power to intelligent systems.

games.name: R-Type Dimensions III
games.summary: Building on the legacy of R-Type Dimensions and R-Type Dimensions EX, Dimensions III has been completely re-envisioned with cutting-edge visuals and sounds, expanded gameplay modes, and a range of new features designed to deliver the most definitive modern edition of R-Type’s classic era.

games.name: Ratalorica
games.summary: Follow GRATS on its journey even while you work or play on your computer. Every click. Every key press. Every action you take fuels GRATS' power.

games.name: Riven
games.summary: The 1997 Riven: The Sequel to Myst remade from the ground up. The remake features a fully traversable 3D space in both Standard First-Person or in VR.

games.name: Roadhouse Simulator: Prologue
games.summary: Experience the uncle’s story before the events of Roadhouse Simulator and explore his humble beginnings while trying your skill as a bouncer at a roadhouse or Route 66.

games.name: Shape Together
games.summary: Shape Together is a factory-building game: lay mines, belts, and machines, automate shapes, and use them to defeat monsters and bosses. Hold back waves, grow stronger over time—solo or with friends on Steam.

games.name: Spirit Cleansers
games.summary: Explore a haunted estate, track down cursed objects, and engage in Turn-Based Strategy. During turn-based combat, fight as both priest and warrior synergizing their unique abilities to quell the spiritual mischief plaguing the estate!

games.name: Steampunks vs. Skeletons: Adventure Puzzle Park
games.summary: Play a Beautiful and Atmospheric Steampunk Arcade Adventure to collect the Gears, PowerUps, Treasures and Secrets, Solve Progress Puzzles, and Respawn the Humourous Skeletons & Spinning Sprits out to suck your lifeforce!

games.name: Sword x Staff
games.summary:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.

games.name: The Last Voyage of the SS Aurelia
games.summary: An interrogation mystery aboard a 1936 ocean liner. Five suspects. One murder. No dialogue options — every suspect is powered by AI and will remember every word, deflect every question, and only surrender their secrets under pressure. Four voyages. One truth. Break someone.

games.name: Time Crisis
games.summary: A port of Time Crisis, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Trees Inc
games.summary: Build a self-sustaining forest in this incremental idle game where you chop trees, automate production with workers, stack upgrades for exponential growth, and use prestige and XP-based perks to push your output further every run.

games.name: Waddle Dev Vs Kirby Dark Dawn
Winnie-the-Pooh Hops for Honey
games.summary: Uh oh. Winnie-the-Pooh ate all of the honey that Christopher Robin set aside for the annual Honey Festival! It's up to Winnie to set things right and prove that his heart is bigger than his stomach by adventuring into the Hundred Acre Wood to collect enough honey to save the festival!

games.name: Alexandria IV
games.summary: Tasked with commanding of one of the most challenging sectors of the galaxy, the future of the Alexandria IV space station depends on your diplomatic and strategic capabilities. How far will you go to prevent a war?

games.name: An Incremental Game About Placing Blocks
games.summary: A short incremental game about placing blocks and filling spaces.

games.name: Atomic Owl
games.summary: Atomic Owl is a pixel art-based single-player, side-scrolling roguelite that combines fast-paced platforming with dynamic hack-and-slash combat and a variety of weapons, powerups, and a demonic blade. Journey through eight roguelite zones, save your friends, and take up arms against Omega Wing!

games.name: Bouncy Weapons
games.summary: An incremental game where weapons bounce around killing enemies for you. Collect loot, master a massive skill tree, and uncover tons of content.

games.name: Brew or Die
games.summary: Brew or Die – an RPG game with TBS elements, where potion brewing is a matter of life, duty, and... possible wealth!

games.name: Cosmic Run
games.summary: Cosmic Run is a single player space roguelite game. Take on hordes of galactial enemies, build your ship strategically to overcome the hurdles, improve your stats to stand longer and flee the Zogark family from the galaxy. Fight, Build, Survive, Escape!

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
games.summary: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op FPS roguelite featuring 100% destructible environments and procedurally-generated caves. Join a team of dwarven Reclaimers tasked with reestablishing control over lost deep mining operations on Hoxxes IV.

games.name: Desktop Nard
games.summary: Idle Dice roll automatically for you, unleashing skills and farming rare loot in the corner of your desktop, with tons of content and loot types.

games.name: Dice Have No Eyes
games.summary: Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed. Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

games.name: Echo Isle
games.summary: Echo Isle is a top-down action-adventure game with retro pixel art inspired by Game Boy-era classics. Players control Aster, a star warrior exploring an island filled with dungeons, monsters, and boss encounters. The game features ability-gated exploration, where new powers unlock access to previously unreachable areas. Developed by a solo indie developer.

games.name: Elyndor
games.summary: Elyndor is a 1v1 online PvP card game set in a dark fantasy universe where five factions battle for the Heart of the Void. Build a 15-card deck, master faction synergies, and outplay your opponent in tactical turn-based duels. Choose from five unique factions — Ka'runa, Ybyrá, Ferrovéu, Anhangá, and Orun — each with distinct mechanics and lore. Fair progression with no pay-to-win on functional cards.

games.name: Fodders Grapple Gauntlet
games.summary:
Fodders Grapple Gauntlet is a first-person parkour and grappling game focused on speed, precision, and movement mastery. Your goal is simple: reach the end of each level as fast as possible.

Using a responsive grapple hook as your primary movement tool, you’ll swing, launch, and chain momentum to navigate challenging obstacle courses. Levels are designed to reward skill, experimentation, and efficient routes.

The game features a retro-inspired visual style, with a dark background and brightly colored blocks that are easy to read at high speeds. Each block type behaves differently, requiring you to adapt your movement and plan your path carefully to achieve faster times.

games.name: Foo Is Missing
games.summary: This is a 2D action game set in a cyberpunk world. Use the "rollback" ability, which allows you to teleport to a previous position, to solve stages packed with various challenges.

games.name: Game About Jetpack Fly
games.summary: This game about jetpack fly. Two thrusters. Two control buttons.

games.name: Gardener's Luck
games.summary: Use energy to draw plants and items, grow your army, and command the battlefield. A roguelike tower-defense where luck meets tactics—and your garden fights back.

games.name: Goonect 2
games.summary: "Hold Hands, Reach the End with the Power of Friendship"—GooNECT√2 is a two-player co-op action-adventure game and the sequel to the Japan-exclusive Goonect.

games.name: Hangover Gallery
games.summary:
A game about throwing individuals down a pit.
Made in under 72 hours for a game jam.

games.name: Heroine Anthem Zero 2: Scalescars Oath
games.summary: Heroine Anthem ZERO 2: Scalescars Oath When the world was freed of chaos, the Twin Virgin Saints started the circle of the seven doomsday. When the lands were flooded on the sixth doomsday, after the descendants of the Savior received blessings from God, they resurrected under the new born Tree of Life Terasyr, establishing the royal city of Vuzahem. But ichthyopagion still continued to grow, making clear that the Gods have not forgiven the world. People must find answers to the meaning of war while surviving the sins and punishments before Judgement Day. The story includes multiple subtle metaphors for the relationship between God and humans.

games.name: HoRoyal: Hololive Battle Royal
games.summary: A fan-made action game based on Hololive! Turn your brain off and enjoy some silly fun! Powerful voice clips cheer your exhilarating battles!! Experience the same sense of immersion as a collab livestream!

games.name: Iced Fish
games.summary: A fishing horror game about fishing in the snow.

games.name: Infernal Battles
games.summary: A strategic autobattler where you assemble a powerful army and buy upgrades to enhance it. Balance your resources wisely between miners and units. Refine your tactics to defeat the King and improve your high score!

games.name: Koibito no Nazo: Lover's Enigma
games.summary: In Lover's Enigma, you investigate your husband's mysterious death while balancing complex relationships and personal trauma. Navigate a web of secrets involving a hidden cult and key characters. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Lethalmon
games.summary:
Lethalmon is a roguelike Pokémon fangame inspired by Lethal Company. Each playthrough is designed to feel unique, ensuring a fresh experience every time.

Explore planets to catch Pokémon and collect valuable items. Earn money by selling your catches at The Ship, the game’s central hub.

Fight your way to freedom by defeating the Gym Leaders!

games.name: Monolilith
games.summary: Follow the journey of the witch Muirguenet and celebrate evil оrgіеѕ to invoke evil creatures. You will welcome cultists, turn them into horny and powerful monsters, and spawn ominous monoliths from hell to fight back the inquisition in this real-time strategy game.

games.name: Moonshiner Simulator
games.summary: Moonshiner Simulator is an in-depth spirits production simulator. Start from the bottom and build your operation into a thriving empire by mastering the intricacies of the craft and creating unique recipes. But beware there will always be those who want to see you fail.

games.name: Noun Town Language Learning
games.summary: Noun Town Language Learning is the new way to learn a foreign language! Interact, listen, read, and speak your chosen language in a world that regains color as you learn. Test your skills with mini-games & talk to the local villagers. Learn Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, and more…

games.name: Outsiders & Insiders
games.summary: "Outsiders&Insiders" is a suspenseful and romantic visual novel for women, featuring three characters you can pursue. You will take on the role of a noble lady in this game, and in the midst of a complex mystery, uncover the secret of your lost memory...

games.name: P-Pan
games.summary: Armed with a big smile and punches that fly endlessly,have fun progressing! P-PAN can fly and hovering,so even if you're not good at play jumping action,this 2D action shooting game has simple controls that can enjoy.

games.name: Pain Pain Go Away!
games.summary: Pain Pain Go Away! is a therapeutic typing adventure where you dive into the heart of a troubled girl and type away the trauma that’s consuming her.

games.name: Palliative: Reach for an Angel
games.summary: When youth shines brightest, every second is a tactical battle against time. Join Yuu and a close-knit group of friends in a desaturating world as they help Nana a girl facing her final days reach for a perfectly ordinary life. A story of friendship, and the courage to stay until the final whistle.

games.name: PeeWee Purpdrank's Foenem Clicker
games.summary: The Official PeeWee Purpdrank Video Game. Double Tap the Foenem button in this wacky and hilarious idle-clicker.

games.name: Pharmacy Store Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Pharmacy! Sell medicines, advise customers, validate prescriptions, and fulfill them. Start small and expand your business - make it big in the medicine world!

games.name: Phonopolis
games.summary: The story of Phonopolis tackles relatable, real-world themes and topics, focusing on manipulation and individualism, but still keeping the overall experience playful and light-hearted. Players will take on the role of Felix, a thoughtful young man who, along with his fellow citizens, faces the imminent threat of falling under the control of the city’s authoritarian Leader once and for all, effectively losing their humanity. Accidentally becoming the only person who consciously recognizes the threat, young Felix must try to stop the Leader from playing the Absolute tone...

games.name: Raging Bill
games.summary:
A wild TPS sandbox in a mini open world, inspired by Goat Simulator.
Shooter, melee, racing, loot, exploration, bodycam… all mashed into one!
A love letter to the 80s/90s and pop culture, packed with Easter eggs.

games.name: Rangedrifter
games.summary: A traditional, turn-based roguelike game set in a forbidden land. You travel a remote and shifting path, outsmart deadly traps, overcome monsters and wild animals, gather food and gear, find secrets, and try to reach the lost ancient kingdom lying dormant on the horizon.

games.name: Reap & Repay
games.summary: Reap and collect the crops to repay the debt of villagers in this short, non-idle incremental game. Start weak, invest in the skill tree to unlock various new abilities and become strong enough to harvest every field.

games.name: Roadtrip Ruckus: RV Survival Crew
games.summary: The game throws you and your crew into the most chaotic “shortcut” of your lives. One wrong turn, and suddenly you’re navigating a cursed backcountry valley where the roads are rough, the locals are… questionable, and survival requires equal parts teamwork and dumb luck.

games.name: Savara
games.summary: In this colorful action roguelite, participate in the festivities organized for the pleasure of the warrior god. Equip your best weapons, prove your valor against powerful monsters, and permanently engrave your name in history!

games.name: Slime Buddy Time
games.summary: Take care of your slime pet in a cozy world! Play minigames, level up, unlock cute items, and customize your buddy and its home. Keep up to 3 fluffy companions while you work or study. Relax, decorate, and enjoy adorable company—you won’t feel alone anymore.

games.name: Sporbs
games.summary: A relaxing, short incremental game where you harvest Orbs from newly discovered alien organisms. Upgrade your extraction technology, manage resources, and unlock new areas to maximise your yield.

games.name: Take Care Of The Dog
games.summary: It's time to play! TCOTD is a short story about... taking care of a dog! Play around, follow him, find items, and a lot more!

games.name: Thick as Thieves
games.summary:
Enter the shadows in this introduction to Thick as Thieves. In the shadow-draped streets of Kilcairn, fortune favours the bold. As a member of the Thieves' Guild, you'll undertake daring heists to claim precious heirlooms and uncover arcane secrets hidden within this alternate-history 1910s Scottish city, where magic and early technology have begun to collide.

Whether working alone or playing online co-op, only the most cunning will seize their fortune in Thick as Thieves!

games.name: Three Kingdoms Club Manager
games.summary: Choose various factions from the Three Kingdoms period to run your club, hire, trade and cultivate military generals, and strive to compete in high-level leagues and cup tournaments.

games.name: Unsung Cascade
games.summary: Unsung Cascade is an indie role-playing game developed by Lostforge Softworks. It features a stylized 2.5D/3D environments. Gameplay focuses on exploration across connected open areas using a world map with points of interest, alongside a party-based battle system that includes skill usage, Boost mechanics, Guard actions, and ultimate abilities known as Cascade Drive.The game is currently in active beta testing.

games.name: Vasilisa
games.summary: Co-op horror game about surviving in old Russian village that is haunted by Slavic folk monsters.

games.name: Warrens Of Random
games.summary: Warrens Of Random is a first-person, minimalistic horror game where you must escape 20 mazes that vary in difficulty. Every time you exit, there's a chance that you'll spawn in a random maze and must survive a previous or future maze twice.

games.name: We Are Live Momora!
games.summary: We are live Momora! is a 3D Orthogonal Platformer with inspirations of weird games like FunnyPizzaLand or Harold's Walk to make a fun weird experiment.You control Momora, a half ""human"" half peg-top, protagonist of the best show of G.O.D television enterprises!, Please G.O.D so he doesn't punish you and create the best show ever seen!

games.name: Willow: The Last Archivist
games.summary:
An action roguelike and bullet heaven where you play as Willow, a gifted Archivist who has the gift of time, allowing her to live many lives in different Eras. Her goal is to preserve history in Time Crystals, which allows the world to never forget the evils of the past. Her Crystals have been stolen and shattered.

Travel through different Eras and reclaim the crystals, while fighting off hoards of enemies. Play as 5 different classes, and use over 80 Heirlooms to create powerful builds!

games.name: 3D Life
games.summary: The classic game of cellular automata in 3D and VR. Generate spaceships, oscillators and other life forms unique to each of 14 different rule sets,

games.name: A Long Survive
games.summary: Will you be able to survive? Long Survive is a cooperative shooter in which you'll have to survive waves of enemies. Protect the nexus by fortifying your area with various structures and prepare for the siege. Upgrade your weapons, strategize with your teammates. Survive!

games.name: A Weird Game About Sausage
games.summary: This is a clicker game about a sausage.

games.name: A.A.U. Black Site
games.summary: The consequence of a mission gone wrong leaves you trapped in an endless cycle of nihilistic, man-made hell on earth, with your only option for survival being to trust a stranger’s voice that guides you through the darkest depths of the forgotten, shut-down Yugoslav town of Uzovnica.

games.name: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul
games.summary: First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people. Travel through unique areas, uncover memories and use them to craft powerful potions. Unlock special abilities and solve puzzles in a mysterious world. Will your soul survive this journey?

games.name: Animal Company
games.summary: Enter the chaotic and fun world of Animal Company, where survival meets pure chaos in this multiplayer VR adventure. Whether you’re exploring eerie environments, customizing your character in the Lab, or braving the terrors that await you and your friends, the excitement never stops. With weekly updates, there’s always something fresh to experience.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Tag Team Wrestling
games.summary: The Big Excite Series finally begins!!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Tag Team Wrestling
games.summary: The Big Excite Series finally begins!!

games.name: Attack of The Worker
games.summary: "Attack of the Worker" is a rogue-lite, pixel-style bullet shooting game where players experience the life of a worker in a tech company.

games.name: BBS (Bulletin Board System) Magica
games.summary: Magical Girl Programming ✖︎ auto-battle! An office worker is assigned to manage a fan exchange bulletin board when she was once a magical girl, Become a magical girl in cyberspace and protect the message board.

games.name: Backpacker Guild
games.summary: Welcome to the Backpacker Guild. To vanquish wicked monsters, hire diverse mercenaries and craft powerful items to pack their bags. Only by the hands of you, the guild master, can powerful mercenaries be created.

games.name: Backrooms Lost Unit
games.summary: Find yourself lost in the Backrooms in this co-op journey for 1 to 4 players. Explore eerie levels, solve puzzles, and craft your escape using scavenged items. Entities lurk everywhere, and the deeper you go, the deadlier it gets.

games.name: Bag Fight
games.summary: Pack your bags! Adventure awaits!

games.name: Beat Your Boss
games.summary: Do you hate your boss? This game is made for you. Beat up your bullying bosses in a game inspired by the Mirror's Edge series.

games.name: Berserker Onslaught
games.summary:
"Berserker Onslaught" is an action roguelike infused with survival and loot-hunting elements.
Face relentless waves of monsters, harness the blessings of the gods to strengthen yourself, repel evil forces, and return with bountiful rewards.

games.name: Bufo Jump
games.summary: Bufo Jump is a 3D platformer where you hop, climb, and glide through colorful worlds, mysterious caves, and a menacing industrial site. Play as Bufo, a brave frog on a mission to save his pond from a greedy corporation polluting the land. Leap your way to the company's core and take back your pond.

games.name: Burden Street Station
games.summary:
Burden Street Station is a surreal narrative game set in a liminal train station about helping a cast of unusual creatures and spirits move on with their lives.

Collect personality traits through talking and exploration, and wear them to unlock dialogue options and advance their stories.

You will come to know these spirits very well. You will learn a lot about them.

games.name: Butcherman
games.summary: Experience the psychological horror of being kidnapped by a serial killer. Driven to escape, explore everything around you, use your wits, uncover secrets, and face the unimaginable dread of being in the victim’s place. Based on a true story.

games.name: Car Sales Simulator 2026
games.summary: Buy. Restore. Expand.

games.name: Cats and Seek: Tokyo
games.summary: The 4th Cats and Seek series is here! We're off to Tokyo to find cats playing all around the city . Can you spot them all?

games.name: Coffee Fox Kim Samwol
games.summary: A fantasy romance visual novel about Samwol, a nine-tailed fox who has lived for 3,000 years. Experience her story of love, destiny, and choices in the human world, set in a cozy café. Featuring full voice acting, stunning illustrations, and immersive storytelling.

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

games.name: Console Archives: Toujin Makyou-den - Heracles no Eikou
games.summary:
"Toujinmakyouden Hercules no eikou" was released by Data East in 1987 for an 8-bit home console.
This is a RPG game where you embark on a journey with the goal of defeating the Demon King Hades and rescuing the goddess Venus who has been taken to the underworld. Overcome the various difficulties that await, defeat the monsters that stand in your way, and gallantly rescue Venus!

games.name: Cosmic Mirage
games.summary: Welcome to the exciting universe of Cosmic Mirage, where incredible space battles await you. Free the captured planets from the dark forces of the galactic conquerors.

games.name: Crash & Bump
games.summary: Crash & Bump is an online multiplayer shooter... mixed with obstacle courses! Eliminate your opponents while dodging the obstacles and take advantage of the power-ups to get the victory.

games.name: Dark Wonderland
games.summary: Alice finds herself lost in a whimsical but dangerous Wonderland. In this dark fantasy action-adventure you will meet the twisted creeps and critters that inhabit it, feel free to kill them, they're mad like you.

games.name: Dawgs: The Revenge
games.summary: Dawgs: The Revenge is an unhinged, genre-bending physics sandbox of pure chaotic action. You play as a highly customizable, aggressively squishy ball of fury on a quest for absolute vengeance. What starts as a simple mission escalates into a multi-genre fever dream!

games.name: Dice Goblins Clicker
games.summary: Upgrade, automate, and embrace chaos as numbers grow, luck bends, and dice never stop rolling. An idle clicker where goblins roll dice nonstop.

games.name: Dino Evolution: Catch Dinosaurs and Raise Anime Primeval Boys
games.summary:
Prehistoric. Powerful. Surprisingly dateable.
Catch them. Transform them. Fall for them.

games.name: Dino Evolution: Catch Dinosaurs and Raise Anime Primeval Girls
games.summary: They ruled the Earth for millions of years. Now one of them wants to go on a date with you.

games.name: District VR
games.summary: Enter District VR, where Berlin's music and nightlife come alive. Aspiring DJ or seasoned pro, the decks await your touch in this immersive virtual world. Explore, create, and lose yourself in the rhythm.

games.name: Dong Wu: Odyssey
games.summary: DONG WU: ODYSSEY is a challenging RPG about legendary beasts. You will form a 4-person party and fight a battle of succession to claim the throne. In this thousand-year war, your enemy could be the noble or Miasma. Your fate depends on your strategy, luck and courage. Good luck!

games.name: Drop and Grow
games.summary: A short incremental clicker about dropping water to grow plants. Sit back and relax while you grow more and more plants.

games.name: Eggconsole Laydock 2 Last Attack MSX2+
games.summary: The epic conclusion to the Laydock series. High stakes, relentless patterns, and pure tactical satisfaction.

games.name: Endix
games.summary: Explore unique & immersive booths from your favorite games. Watch exclusive trailers, compete in mini-games, and connect with players, creators & developers from around the world. All inside a living, free multiplayer experience.

games.name: Escape Tsunami For Brainrots
games.summary: Sprint down the corridor, grab brainrots and escape a massive tsunami. Upgrade your base, unlock rare characters and climb the leaderboard.

games.name: FZ: Formation Z
games.summary: Ready yourself for an intense robot shooting raid battle like never before.

games.name: Fear Within
games.summary: Fear Within is a short first-person psychological horror experience where the past lingers, even when its memories are lost. Explore familiar spaces through slow-paced exploration, uncover unsettling fragments of the past, and face a growing sense of fear driven by atmosphere and sound.

games.name: Fischfutter
games.summary: Help Flupp the fish to escape! Dive at the right time to float through the water. Avoid rocks and jellyfish, they slow you down. Collect stars and diamonds to get faster and swim away from the monster fish.

games.name: Flight Simulator 2026
games.summary: Hit the throttle, hit the checkpoints, beat the clock.

games.name: Food Guess: Pixel Art Trivia
games.summary: Can you guess the food in this retro pixel art puzzle challenge? Test your brain with Food Guess, a captivating food trivia game designed for culinary quiz lovers and picture puzzle fans alike! Solve addictive retro food puzzles solo or challenge friends to a food quiz duel to see who rules the kitchen.

games.name: Forsaken Valley
games.summary: A narrative RPG where your emotions are not stats. They are your story. Explore, create things, communicate with tribes and solve all the mysteries of this strange place. Thousands of enemies stand in your way, whether you can crush them is up to you.

games.name: Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue
games.summary: Gamestonk is the first roguelite shop simulator. Manage the last videogame store in town, keep up with the latest releases, trade smuggled retros, select your modifiers strategically, hire workers, and deal with pesky shoplifters.*Disclaimer: game titles will crack you up!

games.name: Geist Heist
games.summary: Geist Heist is a single-player, stealth, puzzle game in which the player must use their wits, creativity, and ghostly powers to enter museum exhibits, sneak past security guards, and reclaim their tethers.

games.name: Gravelord
games.summary: Gravelord is a fast-paced boomer shooter voiced by a badass protagonist featuring hand-crafted levels filled with secrets and hordes of enemies to kill. Dish out some brutal carnage with powerful guns and collect Tarot Cards to gain even more killing power. Let's put the fun back in funeral!

games.name: Grist
games.summary: Explore the worlds of the mysterious videogame Atropos, engaging in strategic card-based battles and TTRPG-style story choices and skill tests. Plan routes, rush bosses, and press your luck but beware: things that happen in the game may sometimes affect the outside world...

games.name: Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey
games.summary: Build, Discover, and Bring Nature to Life

games.name: Hades Uprising
games.summary: A mythic platformer through the nine circles of hell.

games.name: Havenfall is for Lovers
games.summary: To find your sister, your only hope is a group of kind-hearted 'monsters.' Find the truth, and fall into a dangerous, forbidden love.

games.name: Hentai Roxy
games.summary: Hentai Roxy is an adult game about a mysterious instructor, where temptation and control intertwine. Complete mini-games, unlock new looks for Roxy, and explore her hidden sides in a tense atmosphere of flirtation and edge-of-the-line play.

games.name: Hidden Objects: Items Find
games.summary: Find Hidden Objects – game that takes you on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden items and objects await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities, and magical worlds to find what's hidden!

games.name: Hillshade Farm
games.summary: You’ve got land, time, and a whole lot to figure out. Start small, work hard, earn what you need, and build the kind of farm you’d never want to leave.

games.name: Holy Valkyrie Exs-Tia F Parallel Episode 2: Reunion
games.summary:
Several years after the showdown with Naioro, strange news reaches the ears of Yuri Amakubo; the scientist behind the ExS-TIA system.
On a remote island in the middle of nowhere was a woman who was the spitting image of her older sister Kaede, who had previously been defeated in battle.
With Souma in tow, Yuri immediately sets of for this island to ascertain the truth for herself.

games.name: Holy Valkyrie Exs-Tia P Parallel Episode 1: Magical Girl Pastel Marie
games.summary:
By chance, Marina Katsuragi crosses paths with the creature known as Aramaki
and gains the ability to transform into Magical Girl Pastel Marie. A magical girl’s duty is to close up dimensional portals that occasionally appear. However, the miasma that seeps out from these portals also turns human beings into monsters. So begins Marina’s secret war to defeat these monsters and safely close the dimensional rifts.

games.name: Holy Valkyrie Exs-Tia TS Parallel Episode 3: Twilight Sabre
games.summary: As the ExS-TIA face defeat at the hands of Naioro, Souma Shihou activates the ExS-TIA system and manages to bring him down. But due to some reaction with the device, Souma’s body is transformed into that of a woman’s. With Marina and the others still out of commission, Souma takes it upon himself to battle the remaining monsters.

games.name: Hyper Bullet
games.summary:
This fast-paced, roguelike, VR target shooter blends flow-state gunplay with the satisfying tactics of crafting a perfectly destructive build.

Outlast relentless waves of targets in pursuit of the ultimate score attack run!

Play through multiple game-modes with a variety of different weapons.

games.name: Hyper Euphoria
games.summary: The command-selection adventure game that flourished back when PCs were still called microcomputers makes a comeback. Can you withstand the nonstop MAX 264km/h action that comes at you wave after wave!?

games.name: I Want You To Notice Me: His Story
games.summary:
It's Spot the Differences game.…. until someone changes how you see everything

I Want You To Notice Me is a short 5-minute but charming spot-the-difference game that’s a little more meaningful than it first appears.

The rules aren’t always what you expect.
Sometimes they change—depending on the situation… and the feelings behind it.

But don’t worry.
Just relax, take your time, and enjoy the story.

games.name: King of Tokyo
games.summary:
Turn into a kaiju as you destroy everything in your path in this fast-paced dice game! Roll the dice and find the best possible combinations to rule over Tokyo, whether you choose to heal yourself, attack, buy cards or win Victory Points.

Adapt your strategy to become the King of Tokyo at the right moment and attack all your opponents at the same time.

The first player to reach 20 Victory Points wins the game… and so does the last player to stay alive!

games.name: Kobold Delvers
games.summary: Guide small kobolds through dangerous caves in a 2D puzzle game built around simulated materials. Dig, burn, freeze, melt and combine sand, water, lava, wood, vines, dynamite and more to create safe paths and solve each level.

games.name: Kuukiyomi: Consider It World - Thailand Ver.
games.summary: Introducing the New Title: “KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World”! This time, the stage is Thailand! Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Thai scenarios, packed with cultural quirks and “That’s so true!” moments.

games.name: Last Origin R+
games.summary: Step into a deep, strategy-driven RPG where every decision matters. Command your own squad and lead the final battle to victory with tactics that are truly yours.

games.name: Layermask
games.summary: Save yourself from being stuck behind layers of enemies, platforms, and hazards in this puzzle platformer all about getting to the end of a colorful journey!

games.name: Long Live My Lady!
games.summary: A lone gnome, a sleeping princess and a sea of beer. Take care of your mistress by becoming the manager of the only tavern in the entire Dungeon!

games.name: Lost in Cheese
games.summary: Cheese is blocking your way. Push cheese and clear the path to the big red button. A cozy puzzle adventure about cheese. Can you outsmart the cheese?

games.name: Luna Abyss
games.summary: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

games.name: Machiavelli
games.summary: Take the role of a monarch who’s made a deal with a demon to become immortal. In return, help them harvest souls by building and destroying countless kingdoms in this rogue-like city builder game.

games.name: Midnight Special
games.summary: Welcome to 'Midnight Special,' a gripping point-and-click survival horror game that pays homage to 70s and 80s cinema. The game's story draws inspiration from giallo, slashers, and sci-fi classics, while the presentation is inspired by 90s 16-bit aesthetics.

games.name: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme
games.summary: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme is a doom-metal action RPG set in the world of Mörk Borg. Wretched antiheroes explore a side-scrolling, semi-procedural grimdark fantasy world, searching for a way to prevent the apocalypse or make the suffering worse.

games.name: Nice to Meet You, Again
games.summary: Nice to Meet You, Again is a dramatic story by veteran visual novel developer, Purple software. How would you rewrite your life if given the chance to travel 13 years in to the past?

games.name: Ocean Oddities
games.summary: Ocean Oddities is a relaxing spot the difference game that transforms mysterious underwater worlds into a captivating test of observation. At first glance, each ocean scene appears serene and unchanged, but subtle differences are hidden among coral reefs, drifting sea creatures, and sunken treasures challenging players to slow down, focus, and notice what others might overlook. With soothing aquatic visuals, satisfying “just one more” gameplay, and both timed and stress free modes, it strikes the perfect balance between calm and challenge. Players will care because it delivers that rewarding “I found it!” moment again and again, whether they’re looking to unwind or sharpen their attention to detail beneath the waves.

games.name: One Man Army
games.summary:
A lone warrior stands against overwhelming odds, battling relentless waves of enemies with skill and grit.
Master fast-paced combat and survive intense encounters.

games.name: Paklyx
games.summary: PAKLYX is a turn-based puzzle game about finding the correct sequence of moves. Use special buttons to manipulate timers, delay them, and collect all keys in the level.

games.name: Peerless Heart
games.summary: A 5 minute experience that could save your life. A short walking simulator. You will speak with creatures and move towards a large landmark with a mysterious prize inside.

games.name: Pick & Place
games.summary: Messy room? Stressful day? Not anymore! Turn chaos into calm, one pixel at a time.

games.name: Planet Wow Wildlife Adventure
games.summary: Experience wild adventures!

games.name: Poko's Artic Quest
games.summary:
Join Poko on a frosty and challenging adventure!

Winter is coming, and the little penguin Poko needs to gather enough fish to survive the cold! Use your logic and planning to push blocks, open paths, and collect all the fish across 30 carefully designed levels inspired by classic puzzle games.

Travel through two charming environments the icy Iceberg and the snowy Forest each bringing new challenges that will test your reasoning and warm your heart.

games.name: Psalm 2
games.summary: First-person psychological horror where the elevator is the only safe place. Each floor is a new reality. Each floor has a new inhabitant. Find it to continue your descent downward.

games.name: Psyvariar 3
games.summary: Play as one of 7 pilots in this thrilling sequel to a SHMUP classic. The time has come for a new generation of Psyvariars to rise… and save humanity.

games.name: Quest of Dungeloria
games.summary: Quest of Dungeloria is a cosy metroidvania set in a dying fairytale kingdom with a non-linear plot. Hardcore action, platforming puzzles and lots of secret areas. Shape the ending with your choices!

games.name: Rails of Dead: Zombie Survival Simulator
games.summary:
The last train is bound for nowhere — and it never stops.
The rails cut through darkness, fear, and the unknown.
Survive the ride… no matter what’s waiting ahead.

games.name: Rebellion Princess
games.summary: Raise your favorite characters and have them ready to fight in the next run! Command beautiful girls to defend the castle and princess A non-reset roguelite × tower defense

games.name: Regulea
games.summary: A turn-based strategy card game about infections and antibiotics. Build a deck from 119 cards, spread infections to pressure your opponent, or use the right antibiotics to recover. Correct choices alone are not enough to win; timing and strategy matter. Simple rules, short battles, replayability.

games.name: Retail Hell
games.summary: A horror job simulator set in a convenience store in purgatory. Serve non human customers, fight collapsing inventory, survive curses, and uncover why your shift never ends.

games.name: Samurai of Hyuga Book 6
games.summary: Return to Hyuga just in time for the new semester! Sword fights, love confessions, demonic rituals—nobody said graduating was going to be easy! A text-based novel, 300,000 words and hundreds of choices, without animations or sound effects.

games.name: Sapphire Tempest
games.summary: Become the mage feared by darkness itself.

games.name: Schrodinger's Cat Burglar
games.summary: A puzzle heist adventure with a quantum flavour! The player controls Mittens the cat as she stumbles into a quantum experiment and gains incredible new powers - the ability to be in two places at once. Explore, solve logic puzzles and evade capture by pest control robots to ultimately save the day!

games.name: Shadow Trigger: Covert Ops
games.summary: Powered by a cutting-edge engine, deploy your tactics in a top-secret Middle East rescue mission! Hardcore tactical FPS through a war of betrayal and conspiracy!

games.name: Shipwrecked Survival 2
games.summary: Survive the flood. Explore the unknown. Create your own legend.

games.name: Silent Stay
games.summary:
Dive into the unsettling world of Silent Stay, a narrative horror game with psychological elements.

You step into the role of Alex Miller, a writer who has rented a remote cabin in the woods to finally finish his book. The cabin seems perfect: far from the city, no neighbors, just you and your thoughts. But after just a few days, strange events begin to accumulate that make you question your sanity.

games.name: Solitaire Legends: Fables and Fairytales
games.summary: A magical take on classic Solitaire where every card tells a story. Play, level up, and customize every card.

games.name: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To
games.summary: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To is an action-puzzle game set in a lush, narrative-driven world of witchy demons. Cast spells, be queer, & crash the biggest concert of the year!

games.name: Starbites
games.summary: The story of a girl's growth and adventure on a vast desert planet, "Bitter."

games.name: Suisaiga ha Suitei ni Shizumu
games.summary: Watercolors Sink Beneath the Surface is a nostalgic pixel-art point-and-click adventure set on Narumi Island, where only an abandoned high school stands. Years later, two girls return to complete a watercolor inspired by their school memories, gathering ideas from the remnants of the past.

games.name: Super Climb Up!!
games.summary: Vertical platformer about breaking blocks, hiking through nature, and maybe cleaning up some messes along the way!

games.name: Table Flip Simulator
games.summary: Had a stressful day? Blow off some steam in Table Flip Simulator! This physics-based puzzler allows you to unwind as you throw or smash items with hilarious effects. From working as a barista to becoming the President of Antarctica, you can go beyond flipping the table – the world is yours to wreck!

games.name: The Guardian of Nature
games.summary: "The Guardian of Nature" is a hand-drawn, size-changing adventure. Embark on a magical journey with botanist Henry, use your size-changing ability to explore nature in big and small and solve solarpunk puzzles to put nature back in order.

games.name: The House Always Wins
games.summary: Design and expand your dream casino solo or in co-op. Keep gamblers happy, manage operations, and tackle hilarious chaos — from vandals to fires — as you rise to the top of the gambling world.

games.name: The Last Ladybug
games.summary: Fly forward and save your swarm in THE LAST LADYBUG - a rail shooter set in a colorful world where the skies are ruled by mechanical monsters and the lands are scorched by destruction!

games.name: The Longest Tale
games.summary: Uncover a forgotten legend as you venture through mythical realms. Play as four heroes bound by a mysterious fate. Explore ancient ruins, outsmart deadly foes and solve arcane puzzles. Each path you take reveals a piece of The Longest Tale.

games.name: The Rake Sees You
games.summary: Alex and his friends set out for a camping trip deep in the forest. What starts as a fun escape quickly turns into something far darker. This forest hides secrets… and something is always watching. Survive. Escape. Don’t look back...

games.name: Tiny Builders Coloring Book for Kids
games.summary: Color excavators, trucks, builders, and construction machines with many colors, pen, and paint bucket. A creative touchscreen coloring game for kids.

games.name: Toilet Paper Idle
games.summary: Toilet Paper Idle is a chill incremental idle clicker game about consuming as much toilet papers as possible with the help of helpers, skills, and upgrades. Discover special types of toilet papers as you progress, and be careful to not clog your toilet!

games.name: Tropical Resort Simulator
games.summary: Transform an abandoned island into a thriving business. Install fun activities, open your restaurant, maintain your equipment, manage your staff. It's time to open the beach, you're ready to welcome your first customers!

games.name: Turnout
games.summary: A 1v1 strategy horror game where a train rapidly approaches your location. Guess the numbers, rely on your luck, or strategize to not end up as roadkill, remove the before they remove you from the game.

games.name: Violet Mansion
games.summary: Violet Mansion is a horror puzzle game where you and your friends must survive against various enemies by using absurd items, finding creative solutions... and pushing people down stairs. Or you alone get to uncover the story of two friends who made a promise.

games.name: Walk The Frog
games.summary: Guide Froggo through a world on sticky notes and relax while solving the puzzle of his journey home. Make new quirky friends, help each other out and overcome many obstacles. It’s a cozy and heartwarming point&click adventure with a unique and easy drag&drop puzzle style.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II
games.summary: Fast-paced tactical combat meets strategic management in this sequel to the acclaimed Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus. Take control of either the ancient and deathless Necron legions or the techno-religious acolytes of the Omnissiah, with the fate of a world in your hands.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
games.summary:
Blaze into the high-Orktane mayhem of clashing Speedmobs, in adrenaline-fueled combat racing through the brutal Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive scrappy vehicles loaded with bombastic weapons and powerful abilities to krump the opposing team!

Assemble your mob of dakka-spitting wagons, pushing their team to victory across multiple maps in this explosively unique take on the combat racing and shooter genres. Obliterate your Ork foes with kunnin’ strategies and brute force as your team speeds towards ultimate glory.

Are you looking for more speed and more dakka in your life? Look no further YA GITS!

games.name: Watercolors Sink Beneath the Surface
games.summary: Watercolors Sink Beneath the Surface is a nostalgic pixel-art point-and-click adventure set on Narumi Island, where only an abandoned high school stands. Years later, two girls return to complete a watercolor inspired by their school memories, gathering ideas from the remnants of the past.

games.name: We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe
games.summary: A socially engaged existential visual novel based on a huge number of choices and consequences. Become a journalist who pretends to be a refugee and tries to cross the Mediterranean Sea illegally to do research for his upcoming book. Inspired by true events.

games.name: Whose Lawn Is It Anyway
games.summary: Step into the paws of a mischievous dog or a calculating cat and turn this quiet street into your personal playground of chaos. This is a short, 15-minute adventure about being a very, very bad pet.

games.name: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book
games.summary:
Join Yoshi for a new adventure in Yoshi and the Mysterious Book, launching on Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2026.

One day, on the island where Yoshi and his friends live, a peculiar talking book named Mr. E suddenly falls from the sky. This peculiar book’s pages contain information about unusual creatures, so Yoshi decides to jump in and help investigate!

As Yoshi wanders through the book, you'll make all sorts of discoveries about the creatures you find and those discoveries will be written down. You'll find lots of unusual creatures residing within the book – a page-turning adventure awaits!

games.name: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies
games.summary: From ZA/UM comes ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies – a story-rich espionage RPG. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on a desperate assignment. Pick up the pieces of your broken network, untangle a bloody web of intrigue at the End of History, and prove yourself on the big stage or blow it all up – again.

trailers.name: The Friends You Left to Die

games.name: A Thread Between
games.summary: Welcome, Pilot. The timeline has split. Who do you trust when restoring your fate? Solve 80+ handcrafted levels. 3+ hours. Mechanically dense, consistently fresh.

games.name: Almazuela Picross
games.summary: You must complete almazuelas, quilts made from scraps of fabric arranged in geometric patterns. To obtain the scraps, you'll need to solve a Picross by filling in and removing cells based on the clues. You can rotate and move these scraps until you've pieced together the patchwork like a puzzle.

games.name: Aztecs: The Last Sun
games.summary: Rule Tenochtitlán in this survival city-builder where gods decide your fate. Confront the Moon Goddess and her generals. Delve into the intricate story, survive the nights in the Sandbox mode, or build freely in the Creative mode. The last sun is yours to save, or… lose!

games.name: Bang Pass Duel
games.summary: Pass the bomb. Unleash terror. Bang Pass Duel — a 2-player deathmatch where countdowns turn arenas into explosive rings. Hunter or hunted? Only those who master explosive art, push limits, and trust survival instinct become Bomb Master.

games.name: Beyond Enemy Lines: Vietnam
games.summary: Take the role of a U.S. Special Forces soldier crashed into the vietnamese jungle on the return of a top secret mission. Adapt to jungle warfare, make your tactics and survive!

games.name: Bitter Harvest
games.summary: Cast out of your rightful farm, you’ll scrape, scheme, and rebuild your way to power in this short, satirical farming sim about ambition and payback.

games.name: Blind Box Shop Simulator
games.summary: Open your own blind box store in the anime city of Akihabara. Stock the shelves with the latest blind boxes, or unbox them to collect rare hidden editions. Create a trendy blind box shop that attracts customers and expands your business.

games.name: Blood High!
games.summary: A vampire cursed to live with head and body separated. Shoot blood as ammo, execute enemies with your flying head, and survive. Overflow your HP to unleash Blood High Mode! Dive into hardcore, over-the-top boomer shooter action soaked in blood.

games.name: Brawl Burrow
games.summary: Brawl Burrow is a cozy monster-catching game where you care for your Brawlets, build them a home, battle, and catch new ones while the game sits quietly at the bottom of your screen.

games.name: Bubsy 4D
games.summary: The infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D in a new platforming adventure. Bubsy is back with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality. Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons and tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: Calm Before the Storm
games.summary: Calm Before the Storm is a retro japanese themed cleaning simulator game

games.name: Chamber One
games.summary: Chamber One is a story-driven 3D puzzle platformer. You wake up in a sterile elevator with no memories. As part of the Rebuild Test Program, you progress through test chambers to uncover the truth about the system and yourself.

games.name: Chicken Climber
games.summary: Ready to jump, climb and reach the top!

games.name: Come to an End
games.summary: Race to the END in this horror labyrinth speed runner. Use abilities and survival instincts to get the END. Avoid traps and enemies while you are keeping an eye on the timer. Each level is unique with its own challenges and 3 different game modes. Are you up for the challenge?!

games.name: Don't Fall
games.summary:
Don't Fall is a multiplayer hard platformer for up to 8 players, where you’ll climb, jump, and survive through levels full of traps. Work together… or get in each other’s way
With multiple difficulty modes, the game adapts to everyone. Whether you're looking for a hardcore challenge or just a fun time with friends.

games.name: Dragon Raja: ReRise
games.summary: Welcome to the Dragon Raja Academia! Dragon Raja: ReRise - RPG is a Hero Raising RPG created by the original Dragon Raja development team.
