The title offers a modern fantasy world where players build hero squads, enjoy streamlined daily gameplay, and embark on an accessible, stress-free adventure.

games.name: Duel in the Town of Water
games.summary: A fast-paced Western reaction duel game where players draw at the exact moment the bell rings to defeat opponents, competing against other players’ recorded duels with live stats, high scores, win streaks, and quick draw bests high-stakes showdowns.

games.name: Encore
games.summary: Score-attack platformer-shooter elevator-action game about climbing a building and defuse bombs before time runs out.

games.name: Entropy Archive
games.summary: Uncover a collapsing machine of endless growth, hidden systems, and recursive resets. Generate energy, unlock expansions, recover corrupted records, and descend deeper into the Archive.

games.name: Escape Her
games.summary: I'm a high school student who borrowed money from my senpai. We agreed I'd pay her back in the clubroom this afternoon, but I was late due to an unexpected situation. Now, a furious senpai is hunting me down to give me a serious beating. I must find a way to escape this building — fast!

games.name: Evil Girls Party!
games.summary: Evil Girls Party is a dark fantasy dungeon-exploration RPG. In the world of Filtwiz, humans and demons are locked in relentless conflict— yet a new, threatening third force quietly rises: the Erosion, In the vast labyrinth, the feast of evil girls opens wide… the adventure begins!

games.name: F.A.R.M.S.: Chill Factory
games.summary: F.A.R.M.S.: Chill Factory is a relaxed automation sim where you build at your own pace. Design complex lines with the intuitive Link System and Relays. Unlock new tech via the Tech Tree, boost production with your clicks, and manufacture everything from iron to sushi in your ultimate factory!

games.name: First Sino-Japanese War
games.summary: Free and open source game for First Sino-Japanese War, featuring a tactical naval combat system combined with a turn based hex WEGO strategic layer.

games.name: Halfmoon
games.summary: halfmoon is a short adventure game set in a reception office for the deceased, the final stop before the afterlife.

games.name: House Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: Clean it. Fix it. Perfect it.

games.name: HoverGrease 2
games.summary:
Mixing the traditional elements of a team-based game with the arcade thrill of a twin-stick shooter. A super fast-paced game, where both your reflexes and your team’s positioning play a crucial role. Play the Singleplayer Story or join the 5v5 Online Multiplayer.

Dive into the vibrant, bio-cyberpunk world of Diamond Core Metropolis, where chaos reigns in every arena. Take control of a powerful mutant, master unique abilities, and fight for survival in an electrifying dystopian future.

games.name: How to Train Your Bro's Girlfriend
games.summary: Don’t call it an inferiority complex but it’s such a pain always trailing one step behind your buddy in life, in work, and in relationships. Well, sorry bro, but this time we’ll be one step ahead by fucking your girlfriend first!

games.name: I Am Coin
games.summary: Life is tough when you're small change. Make every Cent count in this physics-based challenge and Become Savings!

games.name: Isle Vacation
games.summary: Pack light. There's nowhere to be, and all the time in the world to get there.

games.name: Knights
games.summary: A free PvP multiplayer game featuring brave knights who must wander deep into dangerous dungeons and pursue various goals. Explore the randomly generated maps, fight zombies, vampire bats and other knights, and race to be first to complete your Quest.

games.name: Last $50
games.summary: Build a drug empire with your last $50. Buy production, upgrade it, and hire workers to automate.

games.name: Lost Hope: Backrooms
games.summary: Lost Hope, a chilling singleplayer horror game set in the eerie Backrooms universe, challenges players to delve into enigmatic locations teeming with bizarre and inexplicable phenomena.

games.name: Lost in Hieroglyphs: A Hidden Objects Expedition
games.summary: Hidden Object Discovery: Find hidden objects in ancient locations and reveal lost treasures. There are a total of 180 hidden objects in 6 chapters.

games.name: Lovers’ Fun!
games.summary: Play as Souta in this heart-warming simulation game where you live with your boss that suddenly proposed to you. You accept the marriage, even though you’ve spent zero seconds dating each other, but everything actually turns out well. All that’s left to do is get to know her better and enjoy life.

games.name: MITH: Make It To Heaven
games.summary: MITH: Make It To Heaven is an NSFW visual novel set in an fantasy university. You are the first human to be accepted in the prestigious Arcane Academy university a long time, this will bring you a lot of attention from your peers, who you can date in MITH!

games.name: Mafia Online
games.summary:
Mafia Online Game by MafiaInLT is the first entertainment Mafia platform built for emotions, intuition, and the thrill of the bluff — playable by anyone, from first-timers to seasoned players.

Up to 10 players join a session and are secretly assigned roles: Mafia, Doctor, Sheriff, Lawyer, or Civilian. Every game plays out in real time — live video and audio for every participant, directly in the browser via WebRTC. Players vote, target, and interact by clicking on live video feeds. Faces, reactions, and hesitation are part of the game.

The platform is visually illustrated with crafted art and atmosphere designed to make each session feel like an event. The experience is built around entertainment, social connection, and the raw human dynamics of trust and deception.

games.name: Maui Pong
games.summary: Dodge obstacles, defeat bosses & collect power-ups in this arcade classic!

games.name: Mei Paranormies 2
games.summary: Mei Paranormies 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted guesthouse to investigate it for proof of the paranormal.

games.name: Paskahousu
games.summary: A traditional Finnish folk card game, brought to Steam. Shed your cards, nuke the pile, bluff your friends — don't be the last one holding.

games.name: Possible One: Lunar Industries
games.summary: Possible One is the ultimate colony management game set in space, and the only space-related RTS game based on proven or very feasible technologies, avoiding sci-fi.

games.name: Rotfront
games.summary: Rotfront is a singleplayer FPS set out in the state of Washington in the year 2034. Infiltrate as a lone Operator, purge infected areas, kill as many Rots as possible and unlock weapons as you level up and grow stronger.

games.name: ScreenCade
games.summary: Turn your wallpaper into a living neon arcade. Watch smart AI master high-energy originals like Void Ball while you work, or jump in and take control at any time. Active play, idle vibes, and global leaderboards—all running seamlessly behind your desktop icons.

games.name: Sheep in Love
games.summary: Sheep in Love is a unique puzzle game with addictive gameplay. It's easy to pick-up and learn, but it will give your brain a workout as you advance to the more difficult levels. Guide your hero to his love by sliding the tiles!

games.name: Spherebuddie 64
games.summary: Embark on an adventure through vibrant 3D environments crafted with nostalgic pixel art, blending classic aesthetics with modern gameplay mechanics. Maneuver your spherical hero through challenging platforming with precise jumps and dash.

games.name: String Mace
games.summary: Smash through swarms of enemies by swinging a huge spiked ball on a string! Build absurd combos, crush towering bosses, and chase the highest score you can reach!

games.name: The Art of Tortoise Walking
games.summary: A walking simulator with a deep sense of zen. Embody a tortoise on a desolate island, independently controlling each of its four limbs with a controller. In every clumsy step, rediscover the instinct of walking.

games.name: The Endless Backgate
games.summary: The ENDLESS BACKGATE is a survival horror game where you face anomalous phenomena unfolding behind three doors. You begin your job as a 'Field Maintenance Supervisor' for our company. Identify the patterns of various phenomena, respond accordingly, and remove all missing posters.

games.name: The Last Portrait
games.summary: Dark legends surround the abandoned mansion Ashwood Manor: Once, an art collector lived here, and his most valuable piece is said to still be hidden in the villa. Break into the house, solve the puzzles of Ashwood Manor, steal the cursed painting – and escape. Are you brave enough?

games.name: The Meter is Running
games.summary: You inherited a taxi dispatch business but it came with debt attached. Hire drivers, dispatch fares, navigate Istanbul’s chaos, deal with bad customers and worse luck. You have 15 days to pay it off or lose everything. The meter is running.

games.name: The Rebirth Tale of Broken Horn Demon Lord Alice
games.summary: To exact revenge on the Brave, the reckless Demon Lord Alice, after her rebirth, decides to proceed cautiously, step by step. To weaken the brave's forces, she must defeat the Four Sages and expand her territory.

games.name: Thornkin
games.summary: Into the thorns, through the dark.

games.name: Toward The Ice
games.summary: Toward The Ice is a classic first-person party-based dungeon crawler RPG with grid-based movement and turn-based combat. Venture into the frozen north and help a fair princess rescue her idiot brother from Troll kidnappers.

games.name: Towerslam
games.summary: Slam your towers down and conquer endless maps of enemies in this roguelike tower defense game. Level up, earn loot, unlock powerful upgrades and create unstoppable towers!

games.name: Tung Tung Together: Online Deathrun Party
games.summary: A multiplayer deathrun party game where you activate traps as Tung Tung, and if someone clears the course, the role switches. Cute characters, online competition, chaos, and fun-filled maps—collect the highest score and dominate the mayhem!

games.name: Turbozod
games.summary: You are an engineered martial arts weapon with no memories and physics defying speed. Escape the lab, explore the galaxy, and hunt your creator in this fast paced, loot heavy RPG. Bend time itself to become the ultimate fighting machine!

games.name: Virtual Driving School
games.summary: Learn to drive at home. Master real‑world road rules in bite‑size lessons, pass your driving test, then take on taxi, delivery, and bus routes across living cities and motorways. Realistic handling, dynamic weather, Left Hand/Right Hand drive, full wheel support.

games.name: Voidline
games.summary: Survive relentless machine swarms in the collapsing Voidline. Loot upgrades, evolve your ship, and stack game-breaking builds as each run grows faster, harder, and more chaotic. Unlock new ships and become unstoppable.

games.name: Vospetka Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to the dorm! Vospetka is a chaotic multiplayer simulation game where you play as a dorm supervisor. Your mission is to keep a crowd of restless students under control, maintain order, meet management's quotas, and sometimes... let off some steam.

games.name: Witchfall
games.summary: A cursed leap through shadow and thorn.

games.name: Word Quest: Horror
games.summary: Step into the shadows with Word Quest: Horror, a chilling word search journey through haunted mansions, dark forests, and forgotten crypts. Connect letters to reveal hidden words lurking in the mist and solve eerie puzzles that grow more spine-tingling with every level. Strange whispers guide your path as you uncover secrets buried deep in the darkness. Can you keep your nerve and conquer every haunting challenge?

games.name: Afternoon Affairs & Helpless Housewives
games.summary: Takumi Nakama is out of luck. He failed his college entrance exams and doesn't have the motivation to look for a job. After his parents give him an old, run-down apartment building to manage, he meets two ladies living there, both with troubles of their own...

games.name: Bubu Battle Royale
games.summary: Every step could be your last—move or be hunted.

games.name: Candy Box U
games.summary: The remake of the classic 2013 Incremental game Candy Box 2. Enter the world of Candy Box U, collect different kinds of confectioneries, find secrets, slay monsters, and maybe, just maybe, become the Candiest Person In The WORLD? A mix of Point n' Click, 3D Autobattler, and 2D platforming.

games.name: Crown Chaos
games.summary: Crown Chaos is a multiplayer party game where you try to gain points by being the only one in the zone while everyone else is trying to shove you off. Every time the zone moves, the game slows down and you pick an upgrade that changes how you play.

games.name: HolyBattle
games.summary: Bible trivia for twitch chat browser based game.

games.name: Jumppass 2
games.summary: A casual 2D game where you descend while collecting mandarins and avoiding obstacles. Faster and more challenging than the first game.

games.name: Kami: The Great Guardian
games.summary: In this short, compact 2D Metroidvania, join Kami on their quest to save their homeland from a calamity wrought from the stars. Use the abilities you discover to explore deeper into the source of this corruption and restore nature.

games.name: Laser Harp VR
games.summary: You too can be a stealth major You will be the organizer and make the live show a success! Please note that the instrument to be handled is the “Laser Harp”.

games.name: Parkour Obby: Toxic Escape
games.summary: Leap, sprint, and survive

games.name: Saturday Night at Freddy's
games.summary:
After what went down at Freddy’s in the 90s, you refuse to return, but bills are tight, so you reluctantly accept the gig. Once inside, you find out something’s seriously wrong, unable to leave, locked inside with the recycled remains of a once pristine gang of animatronics, now old and stained with time. Will you survive 'til the cleanup crew arrives at 6? Or will you find yourself another victim of a horror story old as time…
In this FNAF-inspired horror-game, you must protect yourself from the animatronics of Freddy Fazbar's.

games.name: Tactris
games.summary: A tactical game of slotting soldiers. Arrange formations of different units and attempt to break through the enemy's ranks.

games.name: The Lost Lunch
games.summary: In this First-Squirrel perspective Environmental Puzzle Game, your son has forgotten his lunch! The only problem: he's climbing the Great Tree today! As a caring squirrel mother you are determined to solve your way up the fantastical Great Tree to reunite lunch with an empty belly.

games.name: The Pinkman Files
games.summary: The Pinkman Files is a mini-game rich, fast paced, turn based combat game with a side of visual novel, that will challenge your detective skills and allow you to uncover the secrets of a peculiar town.

games.name: Warrior Survivor
games.summary: Master the chaos. Evolve nonstop!

games.name: Winter Survivor Protocol
games.summary: A multiplayer survival game. Players take on the role of survivors in a dire situation, searching for resources, crafting weapons, surviving amidst zombies and unknown dangers, and uncovering the secrets of the catastrophe.

games.name: Xenia is Online
games.summary:
A horror visual novel of a chronically online depressed individual.

One day they recieve a message from a stranger - will this be the end of their dismal routine... or will they push them away?

games.name: Another Zombie Shooter
games.summary: Every shot counts. A real-time accuracy tracker keeps you honest, rewarding precision over panic. Bullet spray, shell casings, muzzle flash, and tracer rounds bring every firefight to life. Headshots are rewarded. Missed shots are punished. Clear every wave to win. How long can you last?

games.name: Arai-san Mansion Exploration Game: Incarnation
games.summary: “Arai-san's Apartment Exploration Game” is an indie game released on Steam on May 24, 2026.

games.name: Despierta
games.summary: A short game where you explore a world inside a dream and you must wake up.

games.name: Don’t Sleep with the Fishes
games.summary:
How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.

Don't Sleep With The Fishes is a point-and-click survival horror game focused on rapid salvaging, resource management, and surviving day by day at sea.

games.name: Dungeon Twist
games.summary: Dungeon Twist is a turn-based tactical game focused on free-for-all multiplayer matches.Join a gang of filthy rogues and manipulate the Shifting Dungeon, an ever-changing maze full of loot and hazards.Trick your opponents, grab the Treasure… and get out alive!

games.name: Figure of Eight
games.summary: The Space War IV rages on! You thought this was going to be just another normal skirmish, but seems like fate has another plan for you, and now your ship navigation controls have gone completely crazy!

games.name: Mycelium Conquest
games.summary: A deep biological network automation game where you grow a living mycelial network across an alien planet. Consume the local flora and creatures, build biological production chains, and evolve from a tiny spore into a cosmic entity that consumes worlds.

games.name: Once Upon
games.summary: An AI-driven narrative RPG that grows alongside your focus sessions. Set a real-life task, start a 25-minute Pomodoro, and return to a fresh chapter written while you worked. Choose a fantasy cooking journey or a sci-fi survival mystery. Free AI built in.

games.name: Outplay
games.summary: Outplay is an online co-op game for 4–8 players where social pressure and risky challenges decide everything. Communication is limited to phone calls, and victory goes to those who can adapt and outplay others.

games.name: Pyramid Quest 2
games.summary:
Pyramid Quest 2 is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games. The goal is to find the three parts of an artefact and open the gate to the next level while collecting diamonds and coins.
In this adventure, the player finds himself in a pyramid in the jungle surrounded by dense vegetation.
Traps, obstacles, and enemies from old days make the quest very dangerous and challenging.3D graphics packed in a nice graphics style, great 2.5D levels and proven gameplay gives you hours of fun.

games.name: Ravenshade Asylum
games.summary:
Ravenshade Asylum is a psychological horror experience inspired by classic Silent Hill atmosphere and analog horror storytelling. Explore the abandoned halls of Ravenshade Asylum, uncover hidden records, disturbing experiments, and the truth behind a secret cult that turned treatment into something far more terrifying.

As you descend deeper into the asylum, reality begins to distort. Strange whispers echo through empty corridors, shadows linger in forgotten rooms, and the line between hallucination and reality slowly disappears. The patients were never meant to be cured. They were part of something far darker.

games.name: Reditus: Ashes of Heremus
games.summary: Condemned by the Reditus remnant to a vast desert prison, a father and son journey into the corrupted Heremus. Recruit robots, harness their cores, upgrade your gear, and fight to survive against relentless Reditus drones and twisted beasts in this story-driven 2.5D JRPG.

games.name: Running Train
games.summary: New realistic 3DCG Train Game is here! Step into the crew's cabin and immerse yourself as train operator. Navigate 40km+ across Japanese Rural Railway with breathtakingly detailed scenery through the seaside and heart of countryside.

games.name: Wordslop
games.summary: Casual game about endlessly entering unknown words into unknown categories.

games.name: Auto Derby Casino
games.summary: 1-4 players gamble on robot horse races at this casino without rules. Sabotage the horses, manipulate bets, or even blow up the track. Outplay your friends, or at the very least make sure they lose too. All that matters is the payout.

games.name: Bird Game 3
games.summary: Bird Game 3 is an immersive Multiplayer BvB (Bird vs. Bird) game, now finally coming to Steam! Select your favorite bird and fight other birds for domination over the bird realm!

games.name: Budgie's Bug Shop
games.summary: A short incremental game about catching bugs and running a shop. Upgrade equipment, purchase game-breaking abilities, and maximize the profits of your Budgie-powered empire!

games.name: BunnyFly: Season of Summer
games.summary:
On a little mysterious island in the middle of an isolated unknown lake, strange creatures exist. Bunnyflies! Little bunny-like creatures with wings like a butterfly.
They fly and collect pollen to chew and bring back to their different hives as honey or wax, where one queen exists to help them all.

Explore this island as Princess Honeybun, the queen's daughter who's now old enough to make her own hive and start her own colony! Help the residents, collect Royal Jelly, and become the next bunny matriarch!

This game was originally created for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam, and has been expanded to have better visuals, performance, more mechanics, a much larger and complex world, higher variety of flowers, characters, a few mini-biomes, and a lot more lore to try and find.

games.name: Castella
games.summary: Castella is a Tower Defense Rogue-like, where you will build a fortress to defend yourself from hordes of monsters besieging your castle. During the game you will unlock and upgrade towers and buildings. You will build walls to block the path and defend your resources and town hall.

games.name: City Cleaning 2
games.summary: City Cleaning 2 is a sequel to the first part of this meditative adventure, offering you a unique opportunity to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in an atmosphere of peace and harmony.

games.name: Consorts of the Emperor
games.summary: Win the heart of the Emperor by presenting the best gifts and outplaying your rivals in this digital version of the boardgame Consorts of the Emperor!

games.name: Crucible United Between Eons
games.summary: Enter the Crucible United Between Eons and unearth impossible strands of future.

games.name: Demonic Gauntlet
games.summary: I am a solo developer that has worked in the games industry for decades. I had the idea of making this game. It is just a christian demonology treaty converted into a game. There is the famous Ars Goetia, part of the Lemegeton that catalogs 72 demons with their names, ranks, seals and powers.

games.name: Emuurom
games.summary: Emuurom ("eh-moo rom") is a nonviolent creature-scanning exploration platformer, where you document an ancient paradise before it's lost forever. Emuurom is a rule-discovery game ("metroidbrainia") in the vein of Animal Well, Void Stranger and Tunic: knowledge opens new paths. Equipped with a unique scanner beam, you reveal hidden pathways and study the Emuurom creatures to gain knowledge and create new paths forward. The environmental puzzles range from obvious to obscure, with a plethora of secrets hidden in plain sight: this creates a multi-layered experience for many kinds of players. As you gain a better understanding on the world around you, the machinations of the Emuurom creatures begin to unfold...

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Enthrallor
games.summary: Enthrallor is a 2D top-down action-adventure puzzle game set in a world scarred by forgotten mage wars. You play as Roland, a young mage trapped inside a sentient, decaying armor called an Enthrallor that refuses to let him go.

games.name: Farmnana Defence
games.summary: Defend your farm with magical bananas! Collect and enhance 20+ bananas across 5 tiers, build your farm by day, and survive monster waves by night. Face 5 epic bosses in 25 waves and endless Infinite Mode.

games.name: Feed The Queen
games.summary:
FEED THE QUEEN is an active incremental game with a focus on strategic play and synergy-building.

Gather food to grow and evolve your colony. Hatch and upgrade different worker types. Discover new synergies. Optimize your production, customize your build, and feed the Queen ever-increasing amounts of food.

games.name: Ikun vs. Xhz
games.summary: Play as an Aikun, armed with basketballs and chicken claws, reclaim the stolen eggs, and stand against endless waves of Black Fans across 250 levels. The unique death penalty and True Love Ranking system make every battle full of challenge and fun.

games.name: Internal Incident
games.summary: Internal Incident – a top-down survival horror extraction shooter. Explore the hidden corners of a vast facility in search of resources while fighting off terrifying creatures lurking in the dark. Unveil the secrets of the abandoned complex and do everything you can to make it out alive.

games.name: Kanji Cats
games.summary: Tired of Anki or Duolingo? Always get confused by look-alike kanji or mix up on/kun readings? Kanji Cats is an edutainment game that teaches Japanese through cat-and-sushi-themed mini-games. Match, type, and sort kanji while learning in a cozy pixel-art sushi bar with cats!

games.name: Kipi Oppi
games.summary: kipi oppi is a tiny first-person shooter where you juggle a ball in the air with rockets.

games.name: Leon&Suharto
games.summary: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Kapella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.

games.name: Neon Fantasy: Dinosaurs
games.summary: Neon Fantasy: Dinosaurs is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

games.name: No More Demon
games.summary: Fight relentlessly in a fast-paced FPS roguelite against relentless yokai hordes. Choose your elite anime heroines, unlock powerful weapons, craft unique builds, and descend into the deepest realms to face the Yokai Lord.

games.name: No.13813
games.summary:
A time manipulation escape room game.
Piece together the truth behind a viral outbreak
through causality puzzles spanning across different timelines.

games.name: Overgeared Hero
games.summary: Overgeared Hero: Merge RPG is a clever pixel art roguelike auto-battler where your inventory layout determines your victory.

games.name: Paralives
games.summary: Paralives is a life simulation game about building homes, lives and bonds. Through both hardship and success, where will your story take you?

games.name: Patched
games.summary: Patched is about a lonely, abandoned doll who awakens in an empty, decrepit factory. In search of answers, they begin to explore the factory and piece themselves back together, encountering other dolls along the way.

games.name: Plague Alchemist
games.summary: Plague Alchemist is a singleplayer adventure RPG with a deep focus on alchemy. Explore a world where the mundane intertwines with the magical and the corrupt. Harvest and loot your way to uncover the truth behind the world's mysterious decay. Perhaps there is more to it than meets the eye.

games.name: Planted!
games.summary: What do you get when you combine gardening and extreme sports? A head-to-head ‘horticultural combat’ game for 1-4 players, where gardens are arenas and players battle for resources to Sow, Grow and Throw as much produce as they can at goals (and each other!!).

games.name: Precrna Rupa
games.summary:
Precrna Rupa ("Too Black of a Hole" in English) is a short narrative adventure game with a metroidbrainia twist, set in the streets of Zagreb, Croatia. Inspired by POYY, the punk album by Croatian artist IDEM, the game adapts the record's themes, stories, and music into an interactive experience. Players explore the city, talk to its inhabitants, gather information, and connect seemingly unrelated details to progress through the story.

Developed for the Nintendo Game Boy, Precrna Rupa can be played on original hardware, compatible devices, emulators, and directly in a web browser through its Itch.io page. Available in both Croatian and English, it is the first Game Boy game ever released in the Croatian language.

games.name: Rogue Quest
games.summary:
RogueQuest is a roguelike deck-building card game set in a dark fantasy world. Players build poker hands — pairs, straights, flushes, and more — to deal damage to enemies across procedurally generated dungeon floors. Each run features card drafting, loot rewards, and a branching map with combat, shop, rest, and event nodes.

Choose from five character classes (Warrior, Rogue, Wizard, Paladin, Warlock), each with a unique starter deck and playstyle. Collect and equip up to five passive power cards that trigger special effects during combat. Enhance your deck at the Forge between floors, and invest in persistent town upgrades that carry across runs.

games.name: SkyShard
games.summary:
Build your island kingdom and battle other wizards in a war for the throne! A PvP auto battler taking inspiration from city builders and puzzle games.

Your island starts empty, and as you progress through the game you can spend your Mana resource to travel to distant skyshards for resources. Build up your little kingdom and fight other players with asynchronous PVP matchmaking. Can you figure out which units combine best together, and how to manage the space on your little skyshard?

games.name: Slashing Knight
games.summary:
A mysterious portal has appeared right in the middle of the dungeon,
and of course there is a way to escape from it, but our Knight is not a coward
and will accept this deadly battle against the vile creatures rushing at him from
this portal!

games.name: Slot or Not
games.summary: Deck-building turn-based slot machine battling adventure. Fight evil fruits aside your battle buddy slot machine to save your village. Spin your destiny and grab the precious loot in a fast paced colorful adventure.

games.name: Steam & Clicks
games.summary: Build, upgrade, and fight! In a steampunk world overrun by the undead, Rose Mary uses her workshop to craft weapons and armor in this strategic clicker. Forge powerful gear and face turn-based battles to save her city!

games.name: The Dream of Jacob
games.summary: Travel as Jacob through the most transcendent astral dream ever told. Discover heaven and hell, overcoming unexpected challenges and fighting your inner demons. Will you reach the top of the ladder?

games.name: This Short Indie Game Made Me Miss My Friends: Rainy Plays Lonely Game Livestream
games.summary: Tidy up after a sleepover birthday party by finding a home for each decoration and belonging in this story-rich, fully narrated, block-fitting puzzle game. Play alongside a commentating vtuber as you delve into their experience with loneliness evoked by this cleaning indie game.

games.name: Tomb Busters
games.summary: The horror extraction genre finally comes to your phone, and it's finally fun for everyone. No hardcore grind. No steep learning curve. Just you, your friends, and a cursed ancient ruin full of things that want to eat you. Drop in with up to 4 players, loot cursed tombs, and extract before ancient horrors end your run. Go deeper for rarer relics, but push too far and you lose everything.

games.name: Transpawt Train
games.summary: Real-time strategy simulation where you become the first railroad designer in the Paw-City! Draw railroad lines between towns and start running your trains. Design railroads for your cute animal residents and grow your Paw_City with efficient routes.

games.name: Unbound Drift
games.summary: A momentum based precision physics game about swinging around and chasing the high of perfect flow

games.name: Vortica
games.summary: Vortica is a 2D action roguelite set in a solar system overrun by hostile aliens. Suit up, loot up, and shoot up as you battle against enemy hordes, explore derelict outposts, and hunt giant bosses. Each mission gets you one step closer to reaching Earth and saving the human race.

games.name: Wild Horse Racing
games.summary: Wild Horse Racing is a fast-paced arcade horse racing game where timing is everything! Master the rhythm-based controls, leap over big jumps, and race through hand-crafted tracks around the world. Climb the leagues, manage your horse, and gallop from bronze to gold!

games.name: 101 Cats in Toronto
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Toronto landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ⏱️

games.name: Anjail!
games.summary: This is the interactive continuation of the Indie pilot ANJAIL CHAPTER 1!

games.name: Astrobuilder
games.summary: The world’s first dynamic world AI RPG. Play as any NPC in a galaxy that evolves in real time. Every quest, dialogue, and fate is generated on the fly — no reruns, just infinite stories shaped by your choices.

games.name: Barbarian
games.summary: Low poly survival game, with a souls like combat system, where you can dodge, block, and parry attacks. Craft items, build homes, level up, and gear your character to get ready to defeat bosses.

games.name: Birushana: Winds of Fate
games.summary: A new wind, carrying a future yet unknown...

games.name: Bouquet for You in the Dark
Brewed and Battered
games.summary: Brew your own weapons from scratch and unleash them on hordes of homunculi! In this survival roguelite, every ingredient combination creates a potion that splashes, moves, and reacts in a unique way. Discover absurd synergies and rescue fellow alchemists in your quest for the Philosopher’s Stone.

games.name: Cards from the West
games.summary: Make your way through the dangers of the Wild West with your revolver and your deck of cards

games.name: Dark Room
games.summary: This is Dark Room, an indie game made by an 11-year-old in which a ball traverses a procedurally generated maze with a flashlight in hand and attempts to escape. This game is great for people who like surprises around every corner.

games.name: Decay
games.summary: Decay is an incremental game in which you are tasked with using your trusty particle launcher to create ever-larger and more unstable atomic nuclei, witnessing longer and more complex atomic decay chains and aiming to discover all the isotopes!

games.name: Deep Corp
games.summary: Dig mines, extract resources, and produce goods to restore order to the state. Become a successful businessman and an effective state governor in the late Wild West era!

games.name: Eggbert's Bird Bath
games.summary: Uh oh! Eggbert used too much soap! And now Bubbles are everywhere! Pop the bubbles and restore Eggbert's precious rubber ducky collection!

games.name: Escape Simulator
games.summary: Escape Simulator is a next-gen escape room experience: pick up and examine everything, move furniture, smash pots and melt locks! Play solo or with a friend to solve cryptic puzzles and riddles.

games.name: Escria
games.summary: ESCRIA is a dark fantasy 2D adventure where players explore the final moments of a dying world. Players take control of Astro, a silent boy who awakens in a tree house and journeys through forests, ruins, caves, castles, and cursed lands. The game features exploration, challenging enemies, boss encounters, hidden secrets, multiple equipments, relic collection, armor upgrades, and multiple weapon types with unique abilities. ESCRIA focuses on atmospheric exploration, dark fantasy environments, and build variety.

games.name: FearPark Chapter 1
games.summary: FearPark is a horror experience set in an abandoned amusement park. The current version represents the full core experience, with potential improvements and updates planned after release. FearPark is currently in active development. Some features and content may change before the final release.

games.name: Field of Polarity
games.summary: A physics-based puzzle game where you control forces, not objects. Shift global fields to move everything at once. Positive and negative charges behave differently, and through transfer, neutralization, and field interactions, small changes trigger chain reactions that reshape the system.

games.name: Frog Up!
games.summary: A retro pixel arcade-style collection game for those who appreciate FROGS! Complete your Frog Log by clicking on the frogs hopping across the screen; unlock different habitat ecosystems with their own unique kinds of frogs & rarities; and get those sweet, sweet Frogbucks!

games.name: Funfair Tycoon
games.summary:
Funfair Tycoon is a long-term economic simulation about running your own travelling fairground company. Build a fleet of rides, stalls, and equipment, hire staff, and travel from event to event as you grow your fairground empire.

Manage logistics, vehicles, employees, and finances while deciding which attractions to operate and which events to attend. Each decision affects the long-term development of your businesses as you expand step by step from small operations into a larger fairground company.

Set on a real map with changing seasons, weather, and well-known events, Funfair Tycoon focuses on strategic planning over days, weeks, and months of gameplay. With more than 100 attractions, the game offers a persistent fairground simulation designed to be played and expanded over the long term.

games.name: Gas N Cars
games.summary: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

games.name: God’s Blessing on That Desire World!
games.summary: "God's Blessing on that Desire World!" is a 3D character interaction and casual battle card game. In this game, you will transcend to another world as a hero and meet three girls with distinct personalities. Embark on various adventures with them and enjoy sweet moments!

games.name: High and Dry
games.summary: High and Dry is a swash-buckling strategy rogue like where you race against time to save your soul from Davey Jones! You will fight against pirates, pillage ships, take your chances with dodgy treasure maps, and whatever else you must do to gain strength before the time comes for your final battle!

games.name: I Hate Snake
games.summary: Hardcore retro snake game with 80 high-difficulty levels. Features escalating speed, shrinking space, and an algorithm that reacts to player mistakes. Includes a classic high-score mode and customizable 2000s-style phone shells with authentic monochromatic LCD aesthetics.

games.name: Illegal Alien Tower Defense
games.summary:
Shapeshifting Alien Trespassers have invaded Earth!

Their vile species, known as "Third-Worlders", hails from the third planet of a nearby star system, and have now unleashed their rampaging hordes, consuming everything in their path, seeking to turn all of Earth into a dumpy Third-World Hellscape!

You play as Johnny Righteous, a mild-mannered computer programmer working at the Department of Defense on a top-secret Defensive AI, known as Sentinel, before it was mysteriously cancelled. Now, using the last copy of Sentinel's code, it is up to you to turn back the tides of the invasion.

Can you save civilization from the brink of collapse, and restore our High-Trust society?

Or will evil Alien Shapeshifters win World War 3 by waging a Third-World War?

games.name: Infiltrating Roudille
games.summary: A retro-style JRPG dungeon crawler. Play as an elite knight and confront a perilous mission where success is the only option. Alone and deep in enemy territory, you must succeed at all costs.

games.name: Is Guilty
games.summary: A psychological horror job simulator. Serve coffee at a lonely drive-thru. But when a mysterious email arrives, your shift changes. Watch the cars. Check the plates. Someone in line is hiding a dark secret, and something else is watching you from the dark.

games.name: Jump King Quest
games.summary: Plunge into high-stakes punishment platforming in JUMP KING QUEST! Explore alone or fall together in dynamic online climbing action as you fight your way upwards on an unhinged quest to The Smoking Hot Babe at The Top. In this world, every ledge is a battlefield…

games.name: Just Eat Sushi!
games.summary: "Just Eat Sushi!" is a simulator where you can enjoy the world of revolving sushi as much as you like. Relax and watch the plates go by, eat until you're stuffed, or just hang out and chat with friends. Try your luck with the familiar "Plate Gacha," use your own images to customize your face for a hilarious dining experience, and challenge or compete with others in various modes!

games.name: Life Below
games.summary: Life Below is a refreshing twist on the city-building genre, set beneath the waves. Shape thriving coral reefs, revive collapsing ecosystems, and grow a living seascape in a heartfelt narrative by Rhianna Pratchett. You are the ocean's final hope.

games.name: Lost in the Backrooms: Day 100
games.summary: Lost in the backrooms day 100 is a co-op horror game based on the concept of the backrooms with different levels and entities , a sanity system and unreal engine 5 graphics for the best immersive experience.

games.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.summary: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a Monster Collector RPG set in the wonderful land of Talea. Trey, who has mysteriously lost his memories, decides to set on a journey after a particular event. His only guiding light will be a mysterious desire... but will that be true?

games.name: MLB The Show Mobile
games.summary: MLB The Show Mobile lets you collect player cards featuring today’s superstars and legendary Hall of Famers. Build your ultimate squad, upgrade your lineup, and battle other players using officially licensed MLB and MLBPI teams and athletes! Play Ball!

games.name: Mesoké
games.summary: Mesoké is a poetic and introspective flying game. Glide freely through an ever-shifting inner world, where every movement brushes against memory, emotion, and beauty. Explore, take risks, and collect the vital energy that brings your inner sanctuary back to life.

games.name: Modern Naval Warfare
games.summary: Modern Naval Warfare is the next generation naval combat simulator, which will immerse you in the dark and unforgiving world of the modern high-tech naval battlefield.

games.name: Mystery Phantoms: Ghostly Secrets - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Investigate haunted locations, find hidden objects, solve eerie puzzles, and uncover ghostly secrets as reality begins to crack around you.

games.name: Ninja Cats: Tactics
games.summary: Build the ultimate ninja squad with your voice! NINJA CATS: Tactics is a battle RPG where communicating with your ninja cats builds trust. Train and nurture them through voice commands, shaping their skills and abilities. Enjoy chatting with them or streaming your adventure—it's up to you!

games.name: Peek
games.summary: Peek is an audio-driven horror puzzle game where you track the spirit using spatial sound and deduction. In this ritual-based survival experience, a restless presence stalks the room in tense rounds, leaving audio clues on specific, chosen squares as she walks around you. Close your eyes, listen carefully, and track the direction, distance, and nature of each sound to piece together the ritual and end her pain in this game of audio-pattern deduction.

games.name: Picronix
games.summary: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

games.name: Prettiest Morgue
games.summary: A deckbuilding dress-up game where you run your own morgue fueled beauty agency that uses corpses as models.

games.name: Realm of Ink
games.summary: Realm of Ink is an Ink-style action Roguelite game. You, the heroine, unexpectedly discover that you are just a fictional character within the short story collection Realm of Ink when hunting the Fox. Only by defeating the mysterious Book Spirit can you be liberated from the realm.

games.name: Revline Online
games.summary: Open world car simulation with realistic graphics and true to life car physics

games.name: Romestead
games.summary: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight, build towns and earn favor with the Roman gods! ...or just farm your crops.

games.name: Ropeman
games.summary: A two dimensional platformer where you throw a knife into a wall, attach your rope to it, and swing like a pendulum. With only your rope swing skill, you must keep climbing upward until you finally reach the moon.

games.name: Rose and Locket
games.summary: Rose, a retired outlaw, wanders through the spirit realm of the Underwest. Take up the once-forgotten skills of the gunslinger, and journey along the breathtaking, cinematic hand-painted landscapes on a quest to rescue your daughter’s spirit.

games.name: Rule No. 3: Downpour
games.summary: An arcade arena-shooter FPS about slipping into the flow-state and getting directly to the action as fast as humanly possible. Get overwhelmed by enemies and compete with your friends for hi-scores

games.name: Serpent's Gaze
games.summary: Serpent’s Gaze is a punishing 1-4 player co-op third-person action game where you fight tough enemies and relentless bosses, all while uncovering the secrets of an ancient desert.

games.name: Statecraft: Corrupted Democracy
games.summary: Statecraft is a game that adds humor to political party management. In the atmosphere of the 70s and 80s, shape your country, defeat your opponents, come to power. Fight, stage a coup, make allies. Statecraft invites you to the exciting and corrupt world of politics.

games.name: Stonemachia
games.summary: Stonemachia is an adventure in which you can fight and explore a world distorted by the Plague of angels, taking on the role of Zefiro, a pawn capable of transforming into other chess pieces. Venture into the lands of Medhelan and prepare to face armies of angels transformed into statues and objects inspired by Italian art, architecture, and folklore! Fight with a variety of abilities and precise timing in a parry-centric game, where the shield can truly change the outcome of every encounter! Discover the various transformations and their unique abilities to experience a Dantesque epic and uncover the secret of the chess pieces...

games.name: Teamfight Manager 2
games.summary: Teamfight Manager is back with more detailed tactics, management, and a new MOBA-style gameplay. Take charge of a virtual e-sports team, build the ultimate roster, and become the greatest manager!

games.name: That Time I Was Reincarnated as a Box that can Draw Various Lines that Interact with the Environment
games.summary:
That Time I Was Reincarnated as a Box that can Draw Various Lines that Interact with the Environment is a very normal game about being reincarnated as a box with line-drawing powers.

You draw different types of lines to move through levels and mess with the environment. Use ink to create platforms, interact with physics, spread fire, and other questionable tools to solve puzzles or accidentally create new problems.

games.name: The Henchmen
games.summary: The Henchmen is a pulp-inspired, 90s fueled top-down, action retro open-world game set in the fictional city of New Queens during 1979 and 1991.

games.name: They Left Us Here
games.summary: A Sci-Fi First Person Horror Game where you explore an abandoned Space Station

games.name: Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos
games.summary: Battle hordes of monsters, acquire new skills, and upgrade your abilities. Customize your build with hundreds of item combinations and reach the top to fulfill your deepest desires. Conquer the tower in this thrilling roguelite hack and slash survivors game!

games.name: Town to City
games.summary: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

games.name: Veil
games.summary: VEIL is a first-person psychological horror game set on a remote island, where a peaceful weekend trip slowly turns into fear. Explore unsettling places, uncover hidden truths, and survive a nightmare that grows from obsession, dread, and the unknown.

games.name: Veil of Torment
games.summary: Enter the abandoned Black Water Asylum in search of a missing girl. Veil of Torment is a psychological horror game where reality twists, shadows whisper, and every step drags you deeper into madness.

games.name: World of Tanks: Heat
games.summary: World of Tanks: HEAT is a free-to-play PvP vehicle shooter with powerful abilities and explosive team combat. Pilot customizable tanks and unleash Agent skills in 10v10 online battles, where tactical warfare meets FPS-style intensity. Take control. Rewrite the rules.

games.name: Yerba Buena
games.summary: Dive into a surreal 1970s gameworld and save San Francisco from a sinister threat. Play as Barb, and use the Oscillator to capture and reapply the physical traits of objects to solve mind-bending environmental platforming puzzles.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: 100 Nature Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: BarrelBots
games.summary: A multilayered grid-based puzzle game featuring small robots that carry and stack Barrels of nuclear waste.

games.name: Bay: Zero
games.summary: With many, many bossfights, this FPS PvE is extremely fast paced, and could be a great distraction from reality when you finish it!

games.name: Birdwatching Notebook
games.summary: Build cozy birdwatching spots on balconies, docks, cliffs, rainforests, or deserts, and wait for lovely birds to visit. A gentle desktop idle game—like tiny postcards on your screen, where beautiful scenes and cute birds accompany your quiet moments.

games.name: Bravo
games.summary: A 20‑minute playable thriller that will blow your mind.

games.name: Chasing Whiskers
games.summary: Catch cats in this cozy adventure game! After falling into Catworld through an interdimensional portal, you must find your missing cat by completing errands for Ponpon, the local Cat Café owner. Chase, catch and collect until you can find your way home! This game is made by students.

games.name: Coreward
games.summary: Coreward is an incremental game where you use shields to protect yourself from incoming enemies and use their remains to become more powerful.

games.name: Dragon Village 3
games.summary: Dragon Village 3 is a mobile collectible RPG centered on collecting, breeding, hatching, and raising dragons. Players can build and customize their own dragon village, develop a roster of dragons with different attributes, and take part in strategic battles based on elemental matchups and team composition. The game features real-time PvP, guild-based content, boss raids, and cooperative challenges, combining dragon-raising simulation elements with RPG progression and battle systems.

games.name: Dreadmarch
games.summary: From the Celestial Bastion, send heroes across a Might & Magic–style world map and survive endless waves of infernal enemies in brutal combat grounds. Grow stronger between runs and hold the line against the Dreadmarch.

games.name: Echo Generation 2
games.summary: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Gather your crew, craft powerful decks, and battle across the stars to find your way home. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure.

games.name: Enigmatic Worlds
games.summary: Explore strange and abstract worlds filled with equally unusual but deadly beings of many types. Enigmatic Worlds is an FPS inspired by obscure retro-styled FPS games and Amiga games.

games.name: Ex Libris
games.summary:
Ex Libris is a library-crawling RPG adventure set in a 16th century monastery, inspired by the writings of Umberto Eco, Francois Rabelais, and Clark Ashton Smith.

Built using FromSoft's Sword of Moonlight RPG toolkit (based on the King's Field engine), Ex Libris is a unique retro literary adventure. Explore the monastery and its ruins, learn ancient tongues, uncover lost texts, and unravel the strange threads that bind the obscure history of Theleme and its inhabitants, including yourself.

games.name: Fix and Clerk
games.summary: You work for a device company and your job is to verify paperwork of customers before handing their repaired device to them. Check, interrogate and confirm their identity. Beware of scammers in disguise coming to claim devices that are not theirs.

games.name: Fleshcancer
games.summary: FLESHCANCER is a Fast-paced Boomer Shooter with surreal environments and old-school violence. Fight cannibal cultists, terrorists, grotesque aberrations and more. MAKE IT RAIN FLESH, ORGANS, AND BLOOD LIKE NEVER BEFORE.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Namco Chronicle
games.summary:
This is an original tactical RPG created exclusively for mobile devices, featuring heroes and heroines from a variety of classic Namco games.

Popular characters such as Valkyrie from The Adventure of Valkyrie, Gil and Ki from The Tower of Druaga, and Momo from Wonder Momo make an appearance.

games.name: Grumpy Jack
games.summary: A bullethell adventure awaits! Join Jack, a reluctant hero, as he battles bizarre enemies, uncovers secrets, meets quirky characters—and hunts down Death’s missing coffee mug.

games.name: Hamster Talk
games.summary: Hamster Talk is an idle social game that fits naturally into your day. Interact with lively hamsters on your screen, enjoy their cute reactions with a touch, visit friends’ towns, and have light chats with players around the world—all while your hamsters keep you company.

games.name: Hop Hop! Donut
games.summary: Strap on balloons and soar through the skies as Donut the corgi in this adorable 2D platformer! Battle evil cats, dodge deadly obstacles, and rescue your kidnapped owner in a whimsical adventure inspired by Balloon Fight.

games.name: Iron & Ivory
games.summary: Iron & Ivory is an asymmetric head-to-head VR showdown; you either take command of the submersible as the VR captain or use the desktop and play as the Sea Beast. Battle alone or against your friends and use strategy, reflexes, and stealth to destroy your opponent.

games.name: LookFoorMe
games.summary: On an ordinary night, I met “her”… “LookFoorMe” is a modern-day horror game.

games.name: MoSimulator
games.summary: MoSimulator is a robotics simulation game with an arcade feel that lets players mod in their own robots. Experience the excitement of competitive student robotics in a fun, accessible format where you can bring your own robot designs to life and compete in simulated matches.

games.name: My Music Label
games.summary: My Music Label is a music management and simulation game where you take full control of your label. Discover young talents, manage legendary artists, and shape the evolution of the music industry. Every decision influences careers and music history.

games.name: Nitro City Racing
games.summary: Dodge traffic and maintain top speed on your mission to become the ultimate street racer!

games.name: Nocturne for Cyl-Hestia
games.summary: Play as a memorialist and investigate a dystopian city in this 3D adventure game. Collect memories, unlock visions, hack encrypted data, and expose the truth in the face of a regime that manipulates memory.

games.name: Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition
games.summary: In Néro & Sci, players explore a poetic world inspired by mathematics, where shapes, colors, and symbols form the backdrop of a unique adventure. Through the original “White Dimension” mechanic, they uncover a simplified version of the world that reveals new solutions to puzzles.

games.name: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 5 - Broken Things
games.summary:
Face off against the deadly puppetmaster behind the horrifying events of Playtime Co.

In the latest terrifying chapter of the Poppy Playtime saga, you are propelled further into the gruesome depths of the factory, with Playtime’s security system Huggy Wuggy in hot pursuit.

Abandoned by your only allies, your fight for survival gets all the more challenging as you race further into the abyss that is His domain.

Here, shadows whisper, and the puppet master who lords over this realm pulls the strings of madness. Can you stand against evil and finally put an end to this nightmare? Every bloody move forward will test your resolve as you uncover secrets years in the making.

games.name: Red Tears: Angola
games.summary: Red Tears is a dynamic Stealth-Action FPS set in a hostile, open-world warzone. Find your own path in brutal, nonlinear faction warfare. Employ guerrilla tactics, strike from the bushes, and endure violent gunfights to survive. Gather intel, loot resources, and fight to turn the tide.

games.name: Rica Mode
games.summary: A visual novel with AMSR starring the VTuber Rica Hanamiya.

games.name: Rough Night at Home
games.summary:
Rough Night at Home is a psychological First-Person horror game where you play as 25-year-old Jacob Sagespark.
For generations, the Sagespark family made a dark pact with a demon sacrificing one of their own every 20 years in exchange for unimaginable wealth, luck, and power. But the price was far greater than they ever imagined.

The curse won't end until the entire bloodline is wiped out.

Jacob, the last surviving Sagespark, is determined to break the sinister cycle and end the family’s deadly legacy once and for all. But can he escape the fate that’s claimed so many before him?

This First-Person game blends immersive storytelling, challenging puzzles, and nostalgic mechanics for a unique thrilling experience. Your ultimate goal is to break a long-standing family curse, with the story and solutions unfolding as you explore and uncover secrets throughout the gameplay.

games.name: Sail the Seas
games.summary: Sail the Seas is a sailing, trading simulator set in 18th century, spanning whole world

games.name: Schrödinger's Call
games.summary: I am Mary. The last person in the world you'll ever talk to. Schrodinger's Call" is an adventure game that uses a mysterious phone to connect with souls who cannot die. The main character, Mary, wakes up in a strange room with no memory. The player, along with the bewildered Mary, will save souls.

games.name: Solarflare
games.summary: SOLARFLARE is a byte-sized roguelike auto-battler in a sci-fi dystopia. Fight (and die) to unlock Upgrades, experiment to find broken builds, and obliterate the megacorp's bots.

games.name: Starminer
games.summary:
Design and build an interstellar mining fleet to strip space of its invaluable minerals, and sell them for a tidy profit. But beware. Your greed will attract the alien. Use warships and defense platforms to protect your fleet at all costs - in real space, in real time.

Starminer is a space industry and logistics simulation that strives to be at the forefront of space strategy gaming, blending cutting-edge rendering technologies with deep tactical and creative gameplay. It's set against backdrops of fully-realized 3D environments, where the beauty of space becomes an integral part of player immersion, setting Starminer apart as a visually stunning and technologically advanced space base-building game. Starminer is built with realism and immersion as core design pillars through the incorporation of Newtonian physics for propulsion and movement. This not only adds a layer of authenticity and complexity to the gameplay but also introduces a rewarding learning curve for players seeking a genuinely advanced spacefaring experience.

In Starminer, the universe is more than just a pretty backdrop for exploration and conquest—it's a playground for players to explore their creativity and long-term ambitions for their fleets. Central to the game's creative ethos is the ability to design a variety of space stations that bring them toward their goals; whether it's to mine resources, be a defensive power, colonization, energy production, or something else entirely. The dynamic and customizable nature of these different types of stations means that the player doesn’t only decide what their cosmic empire will be; it will become a unique reflection of their strategic prowess and imaginative flair.

games.name: Stickforge
games.summary: Stickforge is a fun, physics-based 2D sandbox moddable stickman game. Create your own maps, items, and skins; challenge and build with other players.

games.name: Super Firefighter
games.summary: Run into hell and spray it down in this couch coop twin stick shooter. Team up with 1 to 3 friends and save victims, houses and trees from the flames and those who ignite them. Enhance your firepower waterpower with special upgrades designed to beat the heat from the unique fires you'll encounter.

games.name: Sydless
games.summary: Sydless is an ultra-fast movement shooter where your weapon is a chaotic ball that grows deadlier the more you move.

games.name: System Overload
games.summary: SYSTEM STATUS: UNSTABLE> System Overload is a resource management sim disguised as a Win95/98 Task Manager. Balance CPU, RAM, and heat while fighting malware across 8 unique endings. Push your hardware to the limit—just don't trigger a meltdown. >DO_NOT_CRASH.

games.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
games.summary: The taskbar is now the stage for our heroes! Support their small but epic adventures. Earn chests through their journeys and unlock powerful gear to strengthen your heroes!

games.name: Tootum
games.summary: Tootum is a charming pixel art metroidvania game that immerses players in a magical world full of mysteries. With magic-based combat, a wide variety of items, and an engaging narrative, Tootum offers a rich experience in exploration and discovery.

games.name: War Robots
games.summary: War Robots is an action-packed multiplayer game with 6 vs. 6 team battles in real-time! Join the ranks of the Mighty Warriors!

games.name: XF Extreme Formula
games.summary: Race at the speed of sound and beyond in the great XF Extreme Formula championship!

games.name: You All Know! Arm Tank Volley
games.summary: The legendary “You All Know! Arm Tank Volley” is back! Just drop the ball in the opponent’s court—yet it’s deep and addictive. Punch the net for a rocket jump, stand on it, and laugh at physics miracles. Looks dumb, plays god-tier. Can you resist?

games.name: Your Weight
games.summary: Your Weight is a simulation game that turns weight loss into a series of decision-based scenarios. Players manage their character's journey through weight loss by making lifestyle choices, with game mechanics centered around health and fitness decisions that affect the character's progress toward their goal.

games.name: 100 Cats Lost In World 2 Find & Color
games.summary: Discover 900+ hidden cats across 9 unique hand-drawn country maps. Relax with guided color-by-numbers or free pastel coloring. Play solo or online co-op, while Meow FM sets the mood.

games.name: 868-Back
games.summary:
The Hacker was known as the best of the best, delving into dark servers no one else could penetrate and returning with glittering data to sell on the black market.

Nobody knows why they quit. Some say their will was broken by the dark secrets at the heart of the Mainframe. Some say they simply retired to a penthouse suite in Low Earth Orbit.

But when you leave the world of high-stakes cybercrime, it's hard to stay gone. With a call from an old enemy in need of help..

868-HACK is 868-BACK.

games.name: Aethelgard: Galactic Guardian
games.summary: Command your ship, harvest precious resources, and upgrade your arsenal in a relentless sci-fi universe. Aethelgard: Galactic Guardian is an action-packed space shooter where you must build the ultimate vessel to survive epic battles against elite alien fleets.

games.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition celebrates the 20th anniversary of one of the most popular strategy games ever with stunning 4K Ultra HD graphics, a new and fully remastered soundtrack, and brand-new content, “The Last Khans” with 3 new campaigns and 4 new civilizations.

games.name: Aim/Flash Trainer
games.summary: Aim/Flash Trainer is a minimal Team Finder aim trainer for Valorant players.

games.name: Airport Baggage Simulator
games.summary: Inspect and sort baggage at the airport! Check suitcases for illegal contents, weight, and destination. Build your own fully automated baggage handling and optimize your terminal's efficiency for maximum profit!

games.name: Airship Climber
games.summary: Become king... if your friends let you. Scramble through chaotic airships and floating debris to claim the crown, then survive one minute of bombs, panic, and betrayal before returning as an angel or devil spectator.

games.name: Alien Cat Story
games.summary: Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies in the game Alien Cat Story. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.

games.name: Amanda the Adventurer 3
games.summary: In the thrilling conclusion of the Amanda the Adventurer trilogy, follow Riley as they uncover the ultimate secrets behind Amanda, Hameln, and mysteries that have plagued Kensdale for decades.

games.name: Andrej Sundic's: The Deep
games.summary: Andrej Sundic's: The Deep is a psychological cosmic horror game set at the absolute bottom of the world.

games.name: Animal Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers: Unicorns
games.summary: Color magical unicorns, cute fantasy animals, rainbows, and enchanted scenes. A creative touchscreen coloring game for kids.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Ace Driver
games.summary:
"Ace Driver" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.

Experience the essence of racing with breathtaking race tracks and authentic handling.
Choose a class based on your player level and charge through the game! Who is the true Ace Driver!?

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Tatakae! Big Fighter
games.summary:
"Tatakae! Big Fighter" is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1989.
In this game, you can switch between fighter jet and robot form during battle.
The key to clearing a stage is to strengthen your ship with power-up items that appear along the way and change its shape to suit the situation.

games.name: Arcade Archives: Ace Driver
games.summary:
"Ace Driver" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.

Experience the essence of racing with breathtaking race tracks and authentic handling.
Choose a class based on your player level and charge through the game! Who is the true Ace Driver!?

games.name: Backrooms: Escape The Brainrot
games.summary: A grotesque horror born from a rotten internet. Decayed memes, laughing entities, rooms where everything feels wrong. Scream, laugh, and escape the backrooms.

games.name: Balkan Shop Simulator
games.summary: “Balkan Shop Simulator” lets you manage your own store in the Balkans – stock shelves, serve customers, and grow your businesses. From a small local shop to a thriving retail chain, success depends on your skills!

games.name: Bamorota Defense
games.summary: Defend the sealstones in a fantasy world! Place towers and cast spells to stop endless waves of monsters in this casual tower defense game.

games.name: Bargoer
games.summary:
Head to the bar, get a drink, make some friends, have interesting conversations, meet someone special.

Exit at the door when you are ready to leave.

Announced as part of the 5/28/2026 Shovel Direct.

games.name: Baspetball
games.summary: When the tutors leave, the house turns into a basketball court, and the ultimate showdown begins: Cats vs. Dogs. Take control of basketball-playing cats, move, pass, and shoot a yarn ball to score baskets while outsmarting dog opponents. Explore creative strategies and make that swish!

games.name: Beat the Champions
games.summary: Beat the Champions is a fast-paced arcade football game where legendary players clash in explosive matches powered by special abilities. No realism — just speed, skill, and pure competitive chaos.

games.name: Beavertale
games.summary: Help Gus, a brave beaver fighting to reclaim his forest from an evil corp. Build useful constructs, chop trees, destroy machines, and execute precise movements to overcome obstacles in this puzzle-platforming adventure. And remember, managing your resources is almost as important as using them.

games.name: Belts of Iron
games.summary:
Belts of Iron is an open world, third-person, factory building game. As a solo developer your support and feedback is crucial to the continued development of the game.
Explore vast procedurally generated worlds where every playthrough offers something new. Venture off in search of rich resource deposits, uncover unique landscapes, and share your favorite world seeds with friends. But beware, exploration comes at a cost, native hostile creatures roam the planet so you'll need to be prepared!

Build sprawling factories that stretch across the terrain, connected with miles of conveyor belts. Merge and split belts of items to optimize production lines and keep your factory running at peak efficiency. From simple smelters to complex oil refineries, every machine pushes your automation further as you expand your industrial empire!

games.name: Bestial Reception
games.summary: In the game "Bestial Reception" the strongest survives, grab a weapon and start running towards the enemy. Shoot and destroy everyone who happens to be near you. Get new more powerful weapons with the help of earned gold.

games.name: Blueberry
games.summary: Go on a journey through a woman’s mind from birth to death in this emotional story platformer. Climb the Tower of Life and gather the pieces of Blueberry's shattered memories, find the missing ones and unravel the mystery of her trauma.

games.name: Bluey's Quest for the Gold Pen
games.summary: Join Bluey on a fun-filled quest for the Gold Pen in an original story by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm. A joyful experience for the whole family.

games.name: Bootleg Alchemist
games.summary: It's prohibition , time to bootleg like never before. As an exiled Alchemist on your path to redemption.Negotiate contracts from taverns to produce liquor and earn coin. Use your alchemy skills to evade guards , bandits and boost production, Help civilians and regain your status.

games.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
games.summary: Welcome to Hunter Haven! Bounty Brawl is a top-down action roguelite shooter for 1-4 players. Here, the hunt is fierce, and betrayal is inevitable. Will you form a fragile alliance with other hunters under the galaxy's most notorious bounties, or go it alone? Who will emerge as the ultimate victor?

games.name: BreakLoop
games.summary: The first brickbreaker deckbuilder! Start off with just a puny ball and build yourself an arsenal of weapons to mow down the endless waves of bricks barreling towards you. Discover powerful items and synergies as you evolve into the ultimate brick-killing machine.

games.name: Cardburners
games.summary: CardBurners is a chaotic fast-paced solo or online versus card game. You must play you cards quickly before they burn in your hand! Mix and match completely different sets of cards and rules to create unique action packed games,

games.name: Carnivore!
games.summary:
Carnivore! is a fully-animated Horror Comedy adventure!

Featuring cute animal characters as they work, run and KILL to avoid gruesome fates.

Meet cute, mean, stupid 'n' scary characters on your quest. Lovers, Rivals & Monsters that will reap your woolly flesh.
Explore a grim world from the deep foggy fields to the terrifying restaurant industry.
Featuring Fully-Animated in-game cutscenes of cartoon animals living the worst nightmare of their lives.
Can you uncover all of the secrets and achievements?
A story-driven narrative where you control the Sheep's fate... as well as the fate of others.

games.name: Cat & Rabbit Magic Farming
games.summary: Stir Up Some Magic in Your Very Own Potion Empire!

games.name: Cheap Car Repair
games.summary: Cheap Car Repair - go back in time to Poland of the 90's. Run your own Cheap Car Repair shop. Look for savings wherever you can. Make lots of money and avoid angry customers!

games.name: Clown Is Hungry
games.summary: Clown Is Hungry is a comedy horror game about delivering a pizza to a hungry clown.

games.name: Compass
games.summary:
Compass is an open-world VR flying adventure set among otherworldly skies.
You are a scout flying ahead of a wandering Caravan, charting safe routes through unknown skies.

Pilot your ship across shifting landscapes, navigate hazardous environments, solve physical puzzles with grapples, upgrade your vessel, and uncover the secrets of a sky where something stirs within the clouds.

games.name: Console Archives: Geki-Oh ShienRyu
games.summary:
"Geki-Oh ShienRyu" was released by Warashi in 1999 for a 32-bit home console.
In this shooting game, you must take down waves of enemy forces and colossal war machines attacking with relentless fury.

games.name: Cozy Valley Life
games.summary: Farm. Decorate. Befriend. Belong. A heartwarming life sim where you build a peaceful valley, raise adorable animals, and find your forever home.

games.name: Crashout Crew
games.summary: Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the worlds most efficient warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfill orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern just try not to crash out!

games.name: Criminal Profile Who’s the Culprit?!
games.summary:
Can you uncover the truth?
A brain-teasing mystery quiz that tests your observation skills!

games.name: Ctrl+Alt+Defeat Zero Humanity
games.summary: A 2D roguelike survivor where robots face absurd human leaders at the end of the world. Waves, builds, epic bosses, and an infinite mode for those who conquer Antarctica. Chaos never felt this good.

games.name: Cutie Squad: Crime War
games.summary: The cutest, toughest girls' TPS is here! A smoke grenade lights up a neon-drenched city, and the Cutie Squad charges in to save the day!

games.name: Demon Kill Demon: Yomi 1984
games.summary:
Five years have passed since the underground explorer was imprisoned. The darkness that lurks in the underworld bares its fangs once again.

The targets were the students of Yomi High School.

The only way to survive in the hell they are transported to along with their classroom is
to revive the corpses of their friends and use them as fighting forces.

It's not a choice, it's something you have to do to survive.

games.name: Do You Even Forklift?
games.summary: Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Ghibli and Japan car culture! Use your forklift skills in logic puzzles with many unexpected outcomes!

games.name: Dramatour
games.summary:
In this local split-screen multiplayer game, 2-8 players compete to build the tallest tower by stacking randomly selected 3D objects.

Inspired by a low poly universe with circus, theater and carnival influences, the game combines strategic construction and dynamic confrontation: players can either place their objects to stabilize their tower, or throw them at their opponent's to destabilize it.

Based on a realistic physics system, the game does not artificially detect collapses, letting gravity and tower stability determine the outcome of each game. With no time limit, it offers a competitive and immersive experience, promoting strategy and skill in a unique visual and audio environment.

games.name: Dread Fields
games.summary: You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground. A slow-burn rural horror.

games.name: Dream Domain
games.summary:
Dream Domain is a retro inspired action adventure where you explore surreal, procedurally generated dream worlds in order to gain your freedom and unravel the game’s mysteries. Your adventure begins locked in a mysterious bedroom. The door will not budge. Trapped with little else but a bed, sleep holds the key to your salvation.
In your dreams you will collect items, traverse strange environments, solve puzzles, and defend yourself against horrific nightmares. Surface level dreams can be safe and comforting, but the deeper you travel into the dream world, the more dangerous and unstable they become. What’s the worst that can happen? When you get too frightened, you just wake up in your bedroom, right? Your dream world is personalized and procedurally generated with thousands of possible combinations, ensuring your experiences will be unique. If you conquer your dream world, a new one will be seamlessly generated, and your adventure will continue. You could stay in your dreams forever…

games.name: Dung Battles
games.summary: An action puzzle game where you play as a dung beetle, battling against your beetle peers to create the biggest dung ball. Battle online to test your ball rolling skills, strategically roll up items to win in challenge mode, or follow a young beetle's journey home in story mode.

games.name: E9uations
games.summary: You are the equal sign(=). Rearrange the numbers and operators to form equation and solve the puzzle.

games.name: Eggconsole Hercules PC-8801mkIISR
games.summary: Driven by Lord Deus’s jealousy, young Hercules must face a gauntlet of trials. Use your dash as a weapon and tackle those monsters head-on!

games.name: Escape From Crimson Manor: Trapped Together
games.summary: "Escape From Crimson Manor - Trapped Together" is a co-op Escape the room puzzle adventure set in a Victorian manor, where you and a partner must work together to solve challenging puzzles and evade the relentless pursuit of the mansion's sinister owner, Can you uncover the dark secrets and escape?

games.name: Escape game R00m13
games.summary: Explore 3D space and escape

games.name: Escape the Backrooms
games.summary: Explore the seemingly infinite expanse of eerily familiar levels in the backrooms based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level features different ways to escape with danger along the way.

games.name: Even Native Japanese Struggle Japanese Kanji Fill-in Quiz
games.summary: Think you know kanji? Put your skills to the test with tricky fill-in-the-blank puzzles!

games.name: Exodus: Creepy Time
games.summary: Join the battle in the dark world of the Middle Ages, shrouded in evil and magic, as brave knights, each of whom fights to save their native lands from mystical threats.
