"Exodus: Creepy Time" is an exciting shoot 'em up with a top view, combining elements of roguelike and arcade games.

games.name: FPBI Test Program
games.summary: A personality test. As seen on Shovel Direct 2026. By keV.

games.name: Facettes
games.summary: Explore the story of Facettes as you play as a woman discovering her homosexuality and overcoming her identity crisis. This self-questioning protagonist channels her introspection in her RPG inspired fantasy world: Facettes.

games.name: Feywood Wanderers
games.summary: Explore the Feywood as you defeat enemies in tactical, turn-based battles. Find loot, abilities, secrets and meet helpful denizens of the forest as you delve deeper, customize your character with a great variety of classes, races, and equipment in this highly replayable extraction roguelike.

games.name: Forensic: M.E. Protocol
games.summary: Put on your gloves and enter the crime scene. In this investigation simulator, you will have to solve 9 unique and independent cases full of plot twists. Use drones, robots, and chemical analysis to discover what really happened. Here, you don't shoot the bad guys; you catch them with science.

games.name: Fragmentary
games.summary: Master your cards and find the ideal strategy to solve puzzles and defeat enemies. Your knowledge and memories unlock new paths forward. Gather items, uncover clues, engage in turn-based combat, solve puzzles and most importantly, learn by making mistakes.

games.name: Frogblock
games.summary: A Perspective Puzzle Game where you move blocks around as a tiny Frog to collect Ancient Artifacts to solve puzzles.

games.name: Gabha
games.summary: The town is under siege and it's up to this little smith to keep the guards armed!

games.name: Gaelic Football Laochra
games.summary: Feel the intensity of Gaelic Football Laochra! From heated county showdowns to the pinnacle of the Irish Championship, every game delivers authentic gameplay, strategic depth, and electrifying action. Every clash is a test of skill, and every triumph brings you closer to glory!

games.name: Gelli Fields
games.summary: Gelli Fields is a casual farming roguelike where you farm to save the world from corruption with the help of magical slimes all at your own pace.

games.name: Ghost of Tokyo
games.summary: Ghost of Tokyo — a choice-driven visual novel about identity, temptation, and unseen power in the heart of the world’s most electrifying city.

games.name: Heatwave: Sam’s Stay
games.summary: Step into Sam’s shoes and guide him through a summer of self-discovery, complicated relationships, and unexpected desires that will change everything.

games.name: Heavy Metal Death Can
games.summary: Heavy Metal Death Can is a Retro-Inspired Survival-Horror game set on a submarine in an alternate late-70s Swedish setting. Trapped beneath the ocean, you must fight against the terrifying Sludge which has turned your crew into Zombies. Look for survivors and uncover the truth behind the madness.

games.name: Hentai Akira
games.summary: Hentai Akira is a fast-paced puzzle game where you follow a determined sprinter on her road to victory. Complete memory and puzzle challenges to unlock new illustrations, as the intensity and rewards grow with each level.

games.name: Heroes of Magic and Steel
games.summary: Build a team of 3 heroes, prepare your deck and dominate tactical battles on a hex grid. Every run demands a different strategy and each card played matters, only going back to your deck on the next run.

games.name: How Much for the Body in the Freezer
games.summary: Short visual novel. An all-too-familiar story, born from an all-too-familiar motive, on an all-too-familiar street.

games.name: Inkwellers
games.summary: Online 2 player co-op puzzle adventure game, you and your friend become the Inkwellers! Dwellers of stories who venture into journals to uncover their true meaning. With your friend, you'll explore hidden worlds, solve tricky puzzles, and uncover secrets.

games.name: Inu to Neko, Tokidoki Panda
games.summary: The rules are simple, but it is challenging once you play! Connect four or more pieces with the same features in a straight line!

games.name: Island Robot Farm
games.summary: Build a super large island with robots in this relaxing idle farm simulation game. Assign tasks to robots to plant, raise animals and build various buildings to expand your island. Even when you're busy, the game can run quietly at the corner or bottom of the screen and keep developing your farm.

games.name: JPEG
games.summary: A short psychological walk sim from a first-person perspective. Day after day, you perform routine tasks in the same apartment, following on-screen prompts. But the familiar walls begin to change — the protagonist is going mad, and so are you. Will you make it to the day the screen fades to black?

games.name: Judero
games.summary: A handmade action/adventure game based on the rich folklore of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

games.name: Kabuto Park
games.summary: Enjoy summer in Kabuto Park! Capture the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this little bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier beetles, butterflies, bees or dragonflies.

games.name: KatsuobushiClicker
games.summary: A clicker × memory game where you take on flag quizzes while shaving katsuobushi. Shave, answer, remember, and try again. A flag-themed clicker that puts your memory and learning skills to the test!

games.name: Kioku: Last Summer
games.summary: Kioku: Last Summer is a cozy, story-driven adventure where you play as Asti, a young girl spending her first summer on the mysterious island of Kioku. Set in a hand-crafted world blending Scandinavian and Japanese influences, players explore, build friendships, play minigames, uncover secrets, and relive the magic of early 2000s childhood summers.

games.name: Lands of Fury
games.summary:
Fight your way up a brutal mountain. Combine weapons, cartridges, runes, and companions to create devastating combat builds and carve through relentless enemies in this combat-driven roguelite ARPG.

You crash at the base of a Metra mountain that does not let you climb it quietly. Your goal is at the peak.

Each run takes you through a mix of explorable areas, tight paths, and brutal arena fights. One moment you’re scouting ahead and choosing your route — the next you’re locked in, surrounded, and forced to fight your way out.

Shape your play-style through the gear you find and the combinations you create — from controlled, precise combat to overwhelming, screen-filling destruction.

Fight alongside companions you can actively command, turning every encounter into a mix of action and control.

You don’t pick a class. You build one.

games.name: Lavender's
games.summary: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

games.name: Lollipop Chainsaw RePop
games.summary: Lollipop Chainsaw RePop is a remaster of the original. RePOP is a definitive version of the game which leaves the story unchanged, with the focus on quality of life improvements and additional gameplay content.

games.name: Lollipop Chainsaw RePop: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary:
Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP is an action game that follows zombie hunter Juliet Starling as she battles hordes of undead using chainsaw-based combat and ranged weapons. This remastered release updates the original game with enhanced visuals, faster-paced gameplay, and additional quality-of-life improvements.

The Nintendo Switch 2 version includes graphical enhancements, 60 FPS support in both handheld and docked modes, and an exclusive “Gun Shooting Mode” featuring arcade-style zombie defense gameplay with Joy-Con 2 mouse-style aiming controls.

games.name: Magic Beans
games.summary: You've found a jar of magic beans seemingly dropped along the forest path, and feel it's time to revive your disheveled garden to see if the tales are true. A submission for The Fainting Room Jam #3. Also released as part of Shovel Direct 2026.

games.name: Magic Dodgeball: Homeless Edition
games.summary: A chaotic PvP action bullet hell where unemployed wizards battle in magical dodgeball duels. Fight with your friends, choose buffs between rounds and build absurdly powerful spell combos to survive and entertain!

games.name: Majogami
games.summary: The sword fighter Shiroha cleaves through a twisted world with her high-speed Setsuna, facing off against the powerful witches in her way, in 2D paper craft character action. Paper craft character action! Majogami - the story of one girl who cuts gods like paper.

games.name: Map Map: A Game About Maps
games.summary: Embark on a cozy treasure hunt as cartographer of an adventure crew. Use your sense of direction to make maps, help your companions and explore idyllic islands.

games.name: Mashina
games.summary: A little robot digs to repair her world. Dig, build, discover and mend in a chill, stop-motion world.

games.name: Math Pals: Dino Academy
games.summary: Learn math step by step with friendly dinos and fun quizzes.

games.name: Midnight Sin
games.summary: In the wake of a murder, you receive an unexpected offer and find yourself living in a lavish mansion, surrounded by stunning women. Step into a web of lust, temptation, and dark secrets in Faerin’s most seductive game yet.

games.name: Midnight Swamp
games.summary: A grim point-and-click adventure where you dive into a world of dark fairy tales. Play as a tourist who must find a way out of the mysterious Midnight Swamp.

games.name: Misaki's Deduction 2: The Sweet Island Murder Case
Mistaken
games.summary: The world is lost to eldritch mist. No heroes, no grand purpose—only survival. Build, fight, and carve your path through treacherous lands where the remnants of humanity and horrors beyond reason now roam. Survive… or be Mistaken.

games.name: Moonsigil Atlas
games.summary: The deckbuilding roguelike with no energy – play cards using physical space! Slot cards together, manipulate the shape of your cards, and create overpowered combos to break the game!

games.name: Morels: Out of this World
games.summary: Morels: Out of This World is a simulation game about mushroom hunting and wildlife photography on alien worlds. Increase your hunter and photographer levels by collecting a variety of mushrooms, photographing alien creatures, and completing weekly tasks.

games.name: Mushi
games.summary: Welcome to Mushi! The next-gen Auto-RPG set in a rich fantasy world. This is a feature-packed incremental idle game, meaning that it mostly plays on its own. Your hero will automatically defeat enemies and level up on your screen while you do other things. Begin your rise from level 1 today!

games.name: Nameless Lady
games.summary: It happened in a certain mansion. Five men, appointed to the task, arrived there. Each discovered a “woman who was not human.” Five minutes until reinforcements arrived. They had to keep watch over them.

games.name: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness
games.summary:
The complete experience comes alive in Necrophosis: Full Consciousness, a first-person psychological horror adventure with engrossing puzzles that plunges you into a surreal haunting world where only death endures.

Begin as Consciousness, trapped within an emaciated, decaying vessel devoid of memories. Explore grotesque environments cursed with eternal deterioration to unravel fragments of the truth and learn why you have awakened. Soon your journey descends into the darker realms of the subconscious as you become the guiding hand that navigates its shadowy depths while piecing together echoes of the past.

Long forsaken gods have been left to rot beyond eternity, yet something still calls. Prepare for a dark odyssey where every disturbing encounter and mind-expanding puzzle will draw you deeper into the macabre.

games.name: Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis: Next!
games.summary: Challenge a friend to a tennis match where you can play as SpongeBob, Aang, and all your Nickelodeon favorites in fast-paced, local split-screen action!

games.name: Night Swarm
games.summary: Rise as a young vampire, earn your name, and gather powerful allies. In this survivor-like auto-shooter, battle relentless werewolf hordes, grow your strength, build your pack, and dominate the night.

games.name: Office Inspector
games.summary: Identify anomalies and dangers in a mysterious office complex and make the right decisions to escape using the elevator.

games.name: One Military Camp
games.summary: Build and manage your own military camp, enrol the best recruits, set the training courses and finally send them on dangerous missions to win the war. But becoming a Military Tycoon also means improving your financial skills, so don’t forget to make your academy a profitable business.

games.name: One Move Away
games.summary: One Move Away is a cozy, first-person puzzle game where you pack your belongings for another move and embark on a new chapter in life. With each move, you step into the lives of three unique characters, uncovering their personal stories through the items they take with them—or leave behind.

games.name: Orun
games.summary: Follow Orun through his journey to restore the guardian flame that once defended the city from creatures that now have devastated the land.

games.name: Ova Magica
games.summary: Experience a colorful farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

games.name: Phasebreak
games.summary: In this turn based strategy game, your tactics are pushed to the limit as you need to consider not one,- but two gameboards. Warp both friend and foe between them, master interdimensional gunfights, and confidently strategize around RNG-free abilities in this FREE student project!

games.name: Pictonico!
games.summary: Turn your photos into minigames! Sure, it's kind of silly... But there's no telling what will happen next!

games.name: Pigeon's Untitled Screenplay
games.summary: Pigeon is screwed! The studio is expecting the screenplay, but it's still not done. Find inspiration in the cafe and finish the screenplay before eternity ends.

games.name: Plush Parade
games.summary: Design and sell your custom plushies in this cozy and creative sim! Mix and match hundreds of pieces to create unique designs and build your own plush collections. Manage your online shop, launch blind boxes and compete with a rival company to become the ultimate plush designer!

games.name: Realmguard
games.summary: Realmguard is a rogue-like tower defense where every run is a strategic balancing act of expansion and elemental strategy. Expand the map tile by tile, uncover random encounters and hidden rewards, upgrade weapons and combine elemental effects for powerful synergies to survive.

games.name: Riichi Mahjong
games.summary: GameShare Matches! Whether you bring your own consoles to play together in person or play online, this is all you need!

games.name: Ritualis: Summoner Simulator
games.summary: An ancient town needs your magic of summoning. Summon bizarre items and creatures to fulfill townsfolk requests. Earn coins and uncover the strange secrets of the locals. Oh, and try to cure your sudden amnesia. It might just save your life!

games.name: Rival Stars Horse Racing
games.summary:
Breed and train horses, manage your stable, and race to become a champion!
Whether you’re a fan of derby racing, animal games or pet horses, your exciting horse simulation journey begins with Rival Stars Horse Racing.

games.name: Robosynthesis
games.summary: A solar-powered robot awakens in an abandoned data center. — In this short 3D platformer, your movement, health, and ammo all use precious solar energy. Plan your actions carefully to seek freedom, as every step may be your last.

games.name: Rodent Rooms
games.summary:
Rodent Rooms is a game about memories. And cheese! You are a rodent: small enough to slip through tiny gaps, sharp-toothed and stubborn enough to chew through anything.

Explore a series of giant dioramas—reconstructions of times past. Find pieces of cheese along the way to unlock special upgrades that aid your exploration.

games.name: SCAD
games.summary: Scad is an action packed roguelite apocalypse adventure. Fight against zombie hordes, craft & upgrade new weapons and prepare for new missions.

games.name: Salmon Tower
games.summary: Salmon Tower is a free, momentum-based precision platformer (often described as a "semi-Foddian rage climber") developed by Oolong Studios.

games.name: Sandloop
games.summary: Help Hura save her village from invaders by exploring the intricate lands of Iman and gaining ancient skills that will enhance her mobility!

games.name: Scale Of Survival
games.summary: This game is for fans of giantesses growing to massive sizes. Play as a heroine defending the city against a robotic army while rescuing civilians. You can also import your own VRM to play as a custom character.

games.name: Scale the Depths
games.summary: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. Scale the Depths is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.

games.name: Secrets of Velendar Castle: Escape Room
games.summary: Find your way out of Velendar Castle. Discover why everything was taken from you. In this fantasy Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to escape the wrath of the king… and find out what he wants from you.

games.name: Shadow Saloon
games.summary:
Shadow Saloon is a free, browser-based party game that gathers different social games under one moody Wild-West roof — made for game nights with friends and family, whether around the same table or online.

Spin up a private lobby and share the code, or join a public one through matchmaking. Play with a free account or as a guest — nothing to install, no ads, no tracking.

games.name: Sinister Remains
games.summary: In the shadow of a curse that has endured for decades, explore a town haunted by twisted truths and terrifying events. As you search for the remnants of the past, you’ll uncover the darkness around you and within yourself.

games.name: Slot & Learn Katakana
games.summary: Learn katakana the fun, easy way.

games.name: Smash Realm
games.summary:
Every match is a wild 5-min chaotic brawl!
Welcome to Smash Realm, a fast and crazy party MOBA made for mobile. Team up with a friend, jump into 2v2v2v2 fights, pick your favorite hero, and unleash your super power to win as one!
No boring farming. No waiting around. Just fun PvP fights from start to finish. Ready for a brand new adventure? Bring your friend and smash your rivals to the top right now!

games.name: Smol Toad
games.summary: A tiny toad with a big personality lives on your desktop while you work or play. Interact with him, take care of his happiness, avoid overwhelming him, and collect points to unlock hats and unique styles for your little amphibian companion.

games.name: Sneaky Secret Mission!
games.summary:
Let's stir up some undercover chaos!
Slip past teachers, bosses, and parents, and play to your heart's content!

games.name: Sokobear: Winter
games.summary: Sokobear is the spa's maintenance bear, his job is to turn on the heating and massage system of all the natural pools in this winter spa.

games.name: Soul Clicker
games.summary: If you like to torture yourself by clicking a button for small rewards and have hours to sink from not touching grass then this game is perfect for you.

games.name: Soulblaze
games.summary: Soulblaze is a creature-collecting roguelite in which you catch and train creatures called animons to fight your way through several regions and defeat their bosses in tactical turn-based battles with dice rolling mechanics. Build your team, upgrade and customize techniques, collect stickers, and hopefully survive until the end!

games.name: Space Diva
games.summary: An interactive narrative experience about the most flamboyant beings in the universe. Join Carmen, a somewhat absent-minded middle-aged lady who has to endure bizarre situations in her space truck. And possibly mess things up like crazy.

games.name: Springcar
games.summary: Just a small ride with the car and... wait, how did we end up here!?

games.name: Stardust: Wish of Witch
games.summary: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

games.name: Starlocked
games.summary: A voxel-based first-person roguelite miner set in an alternate future where the Cold War never ended. You take on the role of a convict forced to labor in a space prison. Fly out into the machine infested asteroid field and gather resources to pay off your debt.

games.name: Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar
games.summary: Searching for a peaceful farm life, a fresh mountain breeze, and your own market stall? Look no further than the friendly community of Zephyr Town! Here you’ll grow crops and raise animals, get to know the locals, and sell your wares at the town's bazaar to restore it to its former glory.

games.name: Stray
games.summary:
Stray is a third-person cat adventure game set amidst the detailed neon-lit alleys of a decaying cybercity and the murky environments of its seedy underbelly. Roam surroundings high and low, defend against unforeseen threats and solve the mysteries of this unwelcoming place inhabited by nothing but unassuming droids and dangerous creatures.

See the world through the eyes of a stray and interact with the environment in playful ways. Be stealthy, nimble, silly, and sometimes as annoying as possible with the strange inhabitants of this foreign world.

games.name: Tabletop Game Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build the ultimate tabletop gaming store! Stock shelves with miniatures, rulebooks, and accessories, or crack open mystery packs to collect your own figures and play against your customers. Set prices, hire staff, host epic game nights, and expand your shop to become the go-to hub for hobbyists.

games.name: Tacs Classic Collection
games.summary: Dive into the TACS Classic Collection and discover a hidden treasure trove of early indie games that were nearly lost to time!

games.name: Tame-a-goat-chi
games.summary: Tame-a-goat-chi is a cozy world of goats that live alongside your daily routine, gently unfolding at the bottom of your screen.

games.name: Teaching Gender-Affirming Care
games.summary: An educational visual training simulation that follows transgender and gender-diverse patients at a primary care clinic. Step into the role of a new provider as you prescribe and optimize hormone therapy, counsel patients around surgical affirmation and navigate care considerations for adolescents.

games.name: The Angel's Mandate
games.summary: The Angel's Mandate is a first-person horror game where you play as Jesse, who finds himself in the palace of an angel after his mother falls ill, slowly losing her senses and physical control, one piece at a time. The angel claims you can save her, and asks you to face a trial beyond mortal limits.

games.name: The Ballad of a True Thug
games.summary:
The Ballad of a True Thug is a crime ballad written in lead and blood. Your story of revenge begins at the bottom—in the dark alleys of Europe and the neon traps of '90s America. To reach those who took everything, you must rise from a small-time crook to a living legend of the criminal underworld.

Here, every fight is a dance on the edge of a knife. Slow down time to find the right move, dodge bullets with a desperate slide, and use everything from cheap alcohol to a heavy gun to gain an advantage. One false step, one miss, and this ballad will end forever.

Destiny awaits your move. Make it.

games.name: The Big Hollow: 1982
games.summary: A serial killer’s dumping ground is exposed. Find details in the evidence, interpret their behaviors, and prove your worth to the FBI’s new Behavioral Science Unit. A dark, atmospheric 2D animated murder mystery.

games.name: The Black Siege
games.summary: The Black Plague had ravaged 14th Century Europe, turning humans into carnivorous monsters that brought destruction to the continent. Your kingdom stands as the last bastion. Build your fortress, mine resources and train troops to hold out until help arrives in this builder-defense roguelike.

games.name: The Crimson Lyre
games.summary: The Crimson Lyre is an immersive first person RPG adventure into a dangerous fantasy land.

games.name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
games.summary: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time is the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG, "remade” in 3D pixel art complete with director’s commentary, the digital manual, and archival footage.

games.name: The Sensifier
games.summary: A device capable of turning inanimate objects into sentient beings. Danny, a prisoner serving a life sentence, is forced to befriend these objects in the hope of earning a reduced sentence.

games.name: They Can't Hear You
games.summary:
This dying star may kill you.

Something went wrong and your capsule was shot into the void of space during a Supernova blast. Now, your only hope of survival are your drones. Can you triangulate a rescue signal through the surrounding debris before your oxygen runs out? It's the only chance you've got.

games.name: Tiny Aquarium: Social Fishkeeping
games.summary: A happy aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen! Tiny Aquarium is a social idle simulator that keeps growing, even when offline. Hatch, sell fish, decorate, go fishin’, and visit your friends’ aquariums with bite-sized daily sessions.

games.name: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain
games.summary: 3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!! Touhou Project characters are here in their ""Yukkuri"" forms! Stack up the ""Yukkuri"" and create your very own ""Yukkuri Mountain""!

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Utawarerumono: Past and Present Rediscovered
games.summary: Utawarerumono: Past and Present Rediscovered is a role-playing game developed by Aquaplus. It is a sequel to Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten and takes place before the events of Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception. The story follows Oshtor and his allies after their return to Yamato, where new incidents and monster appearances begin to affect the empire. Unlike the main Utawarerumono visual novel/strategy entries, it uses turn-based combat in the style of Monochrome Mobius.

games.name: Vapor Soup
games.summary: Vapor Soup is a SOUP-like game. The concept is simple, spawn into a room and walk into a creature which takes you to another room on a new night. As the nights progress, the more procedurally generated elements are added to the room. You might also encounter modifier cubes that will alter the music, textures, or add something new to the rooms.

games.name: WCP Word Girlfriend
games.summary: A game that combines visual novel elements with gameplay for vocabulary memorization. With this game, we offer an exciting adventure that transforms word learning into an enjoyable and rewarding experience. Join us now to explore the joy of English learning in this visually immersive game!

games.name: Waiting for an Egg
games.summary: A pixel-art idle game for those "waiting for an egg." Here, your time is your budget. Buy "breeds," start the long "review cycle," and automatically "grind" for inspiration. Collect rare "inspiration eggs," expand your coop, and decorate your farm.

games.name: Wall World 2
games.summary: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall!

games.name: Wall of Insanity 2
games.summary: Wall of Insanity 2 once again plunges us into a grim and perilous world, lurking beyond the veil of dimensions — a world of isolation and decay. It is a nightmare from which there is no waking. In this third-person action game, you will uncover the story of a lost squad while confronting an unspeakable horror

games.name: Wandering Sword
games.summary: Wandering Sword is a Wuxia-style pixel RPG. Play as a young man from Liao City in the Outer Lands who is accidentally drawn into a feud between two rival sects. Being in the wrong place at a wrong time results in getting poisoned with the lethal Frozen Toad. However, you are fortunate enough to have Qingxu, Sect Leader of Wudang, come to your aid and save your life. This is your turning point: the moment you decide to become a great warrior and enter the land of the Central Plains.

games.name: What's the Password?
games.summary: "What's the Password?" is a minimalistic puzzle game where you decode 4-digit passwords. Featuring over 100 puzzles!

games.name: Wild Assault
games.summary: Wild Assault is an anthro-themed tactical shooter built with Unreal Engine 5, featuring large-scale battlefield gameplay centered around Valiant abilities. Work closely with your team, harness your instincts, and charge into battle to secure victory.

games.name: Zero Warning: Burnt Out
games.summary: In this anomaly horror game, a boy has been abandoned in a burning train car. Spot the difference, decide when to push forward, and survive long enough to complete the rescue.

games.name: 101 Cats in Hanoi
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Hanoi landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: 17.waves
games.summary: 17.waves is an online co-op tower defense game for up to four players. Strategize with your teammates to build, upgrade, and maintain your towers to defend your base from hordes of invading aliens.

games.name: 3876 AD: Corruption
games.summary: A hardcore military sci-fi survival roguelike set in the post-apocalyptic world of 3876 AD. Engage in tense tactical combat, scavenge for resources, complete dangerous quests, and explore an immersive lore full of dark themes and meaningful decisions.

games.name: A Frog's Job 2: Froggina
games.summary: Your life has come to an end, when you find Frog God he seems impressed. Turns out most frog souls need a soul reaper to show them the way to the afterlife. Find out in this challenging puzzle platformer with a unique clock-stopping mechanic!

games.name: Abyss Deck: Deckbuilding Roguelike
games.summary: A deckbuilding auto-battler roguelike.Build your team, shape your deck, and survive through random events and shifting rules.Every outcome depends on your decisions before battle.

games.name: Alien Market Simulator
games.summary: Run a market on your space station. Restore and upgrade the station, expand your services, and sell to a variety of alien customers. Experience the challenge of managing a business in space and growing your market

games.name: Alone Girl
games.summary: Become a lone girl, fight against endless hordes of zombies and bugs alone in the apocalypse overrun by aliens and mutated monsters, collect resources to upgrade your arsenal, tear through the darkness and blood with firepower, and experience the pure thrill of adrenaline rushing!

games.name: Are You a Pilot
games.summary: Are You a Pilot is a free-to-play neon arcade runner about speed, reflexes, and survival. Dodge obstacles, collect plasma, fire lasers, unlock skins, chase high scores, and jump into online squad runs.

games.name: Aurora's Awakening
games.summary: In a mysterious castle, sorceress Aurora has been asleep for centuries. Able to summon powerful Elementals to fight by her side, Ever must protect the fortress from monsters and its most‑sought‑after secret while trying to discover who was responsible for Aurora's slumber and find a way to wake her.

games.name: Automaton Heart
games.summary: Automaton Heart presents a world unlike any you've seen in a computer game before. Enter the RPG sequel to Automaton Lung, now with a detailed organ management system, many dungeons and overworld areas, experience system and equipment upgrades, plus more.

games.name: Backrooms Game Creator
games.summary: Backrooms Game Creator lets you build and explore your own liminal horror worlds. Design levels, customize enemies, lighting, and items, and create unique experiencesfrom quiet, eerie spaces to intense survival scenarios.

games.name: Backrooms: Into the Hole
games.summary: Discover an in-between space inspired by the Backrooms series. Make your way forward by jumping into holes, find alternative paths, and survive in this labyrinthine dimension. Play solo or in co-op mode and choose your path to the exit… if there is one.

games.name: Becoming a Legend: New Advent
games.summary: A choice-driven fantasy visual novel about ambition, forbidden power, and relationships that can shape the fate of the world. Play as one of two protagonists and forge your own legend.

games.name: Bob Saves the Princess
games.summary: Bob Saves the Princess is a Roguelite about controlling the roguelite elements themselves. Control rooms, items, aid in battles and summon creatures to help Bob reach the end alive.

games.name: Call of Elmore
games.summary: Call of Elmore is an experimental arcade-styled action-adventure game with a unique blend of top-down and sidescrolling gameplay. Acquire a larger arsenal, explore the region, and survive while figuring out how a simple Lighthouse flame has laid waste to the colony.

games.name: Cat vs. Slime
games.summary: The cats can stack on top of each other like human ring performers, easily reaching the flying slime in the air. As the battle progresses, you can randomly unlock new cats, enhance the cat house, and the mild roguelike elements bring new surprises to each game.

games.name: CatBun Idle
games.summary: Tap and idle your way through 40 areas with adorable catgirl and bunny girl companions! Level up your crew, trigger powerful skills, and prestige for Stardust in this cute pixel art idle RPG with a full original soundtrack.

games.name: Chesstro
games.summary: Enter Chesstro, the digital roguelite chess empire ruled by TRO. Engage in intense duels against the AI and fight in hopes of one day escaping the digital prison.

games.name: Circular Defense
games.summary: ”Circular Defense" is a real-time tower defense game in which you intercept enemies by placing circles around them to prevent them from hitting the planet in the center of the screen. Strengthen your turrets and defend your planet from the endless enemies!

games.name: Cochonnet
games.summary: Play Pétanque online with your friends, the traditional french ball-throwing sport where 2 teams compete to land their metal balls closest to the target.

games.name: Cold Snap
games.summary:
Fast-paced multiplayer arena where snowballs turn into chaos.
Fight in intense up to 4v4 matches where every hit matters. Stun your enemies, knock them out, and fight to be the last team standing.

games.name: Collision Course
games.summary: A comet is hurtling toward the planet! Sneak, scavenge and blast your way through an immersive prehistoric world filled with Humans, Dinosaurs, Droids and Mother Nature’s fury!

games.name: Congratulations On Your Purchase
games.summary: The most expensive game on Steam. A palace, a red carpet, paparazzi, and a wall where you leave your name — visible to every owner who comes after you. Ten minutes. The price is not a mistake. It is the point.

games.name: Control, I'm Not Coming Back
games.summary: Control, I'm Not Coming Back is a short and emotional narrative game about a lost astronaut searching for a reason to keep going forward while facing the emptiness of space. Inspired by the Hopecore aesthetic, it’s a story about positivism, friendship and our human connection with Voyager 1.

games.name: Cosmic Rays
games.summary: Jump and shoot in this 2D platformer to destroy the hivemind controlling the aliens that are attacking Earth. Hopefully nothing goes wrong on this mission...

games.name: Curtain Call
games.summary: Explore a cursed theater and persevere through all manners of dangers in this first-person survival horror game. Developed by third year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences.

games.name: Cybermatrix
games.summary: CYBERMATRIX is a game about speed and movement. A difficult and exciting adventure awaits you, which you will have to pass using one multifunctional knife and many different abilities. But the further you go, the more different techniques you will discover, and the stronger your opponents will be.

games.name: Dang Darn Island
games.summary: Dang Darn Island is a 1-4 player co-op roguelike adventure. Explore the procedurally generated island, delve deep into the temple, smash pots, dodge traps, and see if you can escape with the Gold Idol!

games.name: Dead Gears: Space of War
games.summary: Adapt or become part of it.

games.name: Destructive Contraptions
games.summary: Destructive Contraptions is a physics based sandbox simulator where you can create huge contraptions with dominos, balls, canons, pivot etc. and watch them fall apart and destroy giant structures, cities, buildings without having to worry about the legal and life threatening issues.

games.name: Diamond Painting ASMR
games.summary: Let your imagination shine as you create stunning art with diamonds!

games.name: Dominoes Colors
games.summary: Dominoes Colors It is a puzzle relaxing game where you need to mix colors when put each piece on board. The mix result is the next step to solve the puzzle. The piece with a chequered flag is the last piece, your last mix of colors needs to be equal of it.

games.name: Don't Pop the Balloon
games.summary: Team up with a friend in this physics-based 2-player co-op adventure! Control a fragile balloon by managing the distance between you and navigate through challenging obstacles. Perfect synchronization is key to dodging traps. Can you finish the course without popping the balloon (or friendship)?

games.name: Don't Touch the Snail
games.summary: You lose forever the second the snail touches your mouse.

games.name: Flux Ascendant
games.summary: A fast-paced bullet-heaven roguelite where you tame the four elements. Draft cards, fuse them into game-changing builds, and survive endless waves across Fire, Lightning, Water and Earth, then face the chaotic Finale. Made by one developer, balanced by thousands of test runs.

games.name: Frontier Legends
games.summary: Welcome to Frontier Legends, the ultimate Wild West adventure where survival, crafting, and exploration come together in an expansive open world. Step into the boots of a brave settler who has just arrived by train, ready to stake your claim on the new frontier filled with untold mysteries.

games.name: GrigoriNightDragon
games.summary: GrigoriNightDragon is a captivating RPG set in Elyria's fantasy realm. Discover quests, adventures, and formidable dragons guarding castles. Multiple endings ensure endless replayability and a multitude of challanges awit you on your journey!

games.name: Into the Slimy Mines
games.summary: A roguelike tower defence with a card twist! Protect your mine and rescue your crew after crash landing on a slime infested moon. Buy cards and booster packs, expand your tunnels, find crazy combos and squish those frackin’ slimes. Dig, build defend – and get off this B&*@!n Moon!

games.name: Iris Odyssey
games.summary: Iris Odyssey is a text-based adventure game. In the heart of Shibuya, an orphaned girl searching for her family and a magical crime investigator are brought together by fate. Their journey will challenge them and spark a battle against unimaginable forces. A modern fantasy adventure begins.

games.name: It Lives in the Woods
games.summary: It Lives in the Woods is a first-person psychological horror set in the forests of Canada. You are Ibrahim, a father who has recently lost his daughter whilst on a hiking trip in the forest last winter. You hope to find what happened to your daughter and whether you can reunite with her.

games.name: Kiko's Apple Adventure
games.summary: A Sokoban game about a curious bear who loves tasty apples. Explore islands, move the finish line, and outsmart your enemies.

games.name: Kunugi's Life is a Mess!
games.summary: In this roguelike, turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG, play as Kunugi, a homeless girl driven by a pursuit of vengeance after her former bully ruined her life. Dive into dungeons, defeat your enemies, learn new skills, and gear up. Don’t let the bullies gain the upper hand over you!

games.name: Lexispell
games.summary: Strategy meets physics, in this roguelike word game, where you combine spelling with cool upgrades to score high.

games.name: Little Nightmares II: Enhanced Edition
games.summary:
Little Nightmares II: Enhanced Edition is a puzzle-platformer horror adventure where you play as Mono, navigating the distorted Pale City with Six to uncover the secrets of the Signal Tower. Solve environmental puzzles, evade terrifying creatures, and escape the dark world that has been warped by an ominous signal.
The Enhanced Edition features ray-traced graphics, improved shadows, immersive 3D audio, and 4K resolution with options for 30 FPS or 60 FPS performance.

games.name: Lucy Half Lucid
games.summary:
A fragment of an immigrant gets lost inside "her own" life

what happens "next"

games.name: Mighty Meow
games.summary: Mighty Meow is an action RPG with base-building. Rescue adorable animals from dungeons overrun by evil AI robots. While you are fighting relentless foes, your furry friends will be crafting powerful gear for you back at your base. Explore dangerous dungeons, manage resources and expand your base.

games.name: Mina the Hollower
games.summary:
Mina the Hollower is a bone-chilling action-adventure game featuring classic gameplay and an 8-bit aesthetic in the style of Game Boy Color, refined for the modern era.

Quick and deliberate 60fps action combat, captivating world design, and top-down adventuring combine in a nostalgic blend. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

games.name: Momo Don't Leave
games.summary: Return to a town that never changed… and a friend who's supposed to be dead. A psychological horror visual novel about memory and the cost of refusing to move forward.

games.name: My Little Puppy
games.summary: "There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you." While spending time in dog heaven, Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi suddenly catches his dad's scent. Now, he embarks on a journey to meet his dad. Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

games.name: N.E.R.D
games.summary: N.E.R.D is a story-driven escape room puzzle game, brought to life as a gripping interactive movie.

games.name: New Folder
games.summary: You log on to a computer having no clue of what lies within. Explore its files, solve puzzles to recover missing pieces, and decipher passwords to enter otherwise prohibited folders. As you delve deeper into its content, you’ll find that there is a greater mystery to be solved.

games.name: Night Pump: A Horror Game Remake
games.summary:
Night Pump: A Horror Game Remake is a first-person psychological horror game where you play as Nick, a young man working the night shift at an isolated gas station surrounded by fog and woods. What starts as a monotonous shift turns into a nightmare when the lights begin to flicker and a distorted voice through the radio warns you: the killer is already inside.
Inspired by classic indie horror titles like Cry of Fear, this remake expands the original with a revamped atmosphere, immersive sound design, and a story as cold as it is personal. Your choices matter — but your fate may already be written.

games.name: Obby: Build a 3D Amusement Park!
games.summary: Build your dream park and thrilling roller coasters!

games.name: Obsolete Friends
games.summary: Obsolete Friends is a story focused semi-horror RPG Maker game where you play as Luna, a Moon Guardian bunny, in their everyday routine of helping out their neighbors. Help them bring kindness and hope in a world that has been consumed by darkness, get to know your strange but friendly neighbors and be the best friend you can be! Just try to not think about what's missing...

games.name: Paperly
games.summary: Take Flight in a Beautiful World of Paper

games.name: Plants on Fire
games.summary: Step into a world where tower defense, clever deck-building, and auto chess all collide, Captain! Lead your quirky but powerful plant squad, outsmart rivals in fast-paced battles, recruit unique minions, and build the ultimate team to climb the global ladder.

games.name: Pop Balloons and Drop People
games.summary: A short and colorful incremental game about popping different types of balloons and dropping people of all colors.

games.name: Primordio
games.summary: Survive the void. Control a wisp of pure energy in this roguelike bullet-hell survival game. Chain lightning through swarms of primordial entities, level up with powerful upgrades, and fight to stay alive long enough to learn the secrets of... PRIMORDIO

games.name: Project Confluence
games.summary: Jump, jetpack, wall run and grapple your way through 3D environments in a race against time. Swap between parallel worlds to add or remove platforms in your way to reach the goal and complete your simulation of Project Confluence.

games.name: Pulsari
games.summary: Pulsari is a precision rhythm arcade game about pulling sound out of the dark. A rotating nexus hangs in the void while beat rings rush in from four directions — you strike up, down, left, and right not to follow the music but to summon it. Every clean hit builds the track: a bass line emerges at combo 5, an arpeggio at 15, and a full synth pad at 30, until the chart stops feeling like a game and starts feeling like an instrument. Miss, and the layers decay back to silence. Reach full harmonic and the track opens into a trance-like plateau where sound, motion, and timing lock together — 41 hand-designed tracks across five sets, from an 80 BPM tutorial to a 250 BPM hardcore finale, with two play modes, four difficulties, sub-200 ms instant restart, and full controller support.

games.name: RV Roadtrip Simulator
games.summary: Every road tells a different story of survival and skill.

games.name: Reaper Actual
games.summary: Reaper Actual is an open-world persistent shooter where hundreds of players engage in FPS combat against each other and 5 NPC factions on the massive war-torn island of Marova. Level your Reapers, maintain a home base, and complete missions to earn gear and reshape the world.

games.name: Relirium: Iseki to Deai to Bouken to
games.summary: Whirlpool's 20th anniversary and final project.

games.name: Revive & Repeat
games.summary: Revive & Repeat is a card-based dungeon crawler roguelike where you combine modifiers and artifacts, build insane setups, fight powerful bosses, and compete with other players on the leaderboard — every death makes you stronger.

games.name: Rock Island
games.summary: Explore the mystery of the mysterious cube at the center of Boulder Island, dig out endless treasures, wake up the sleeping little boulder people, and lead them to create prosperity!

games.name: Scorched Lands
games.summary: The world burned. Something survived. So did you.

games.name: Secrets of the Heart
games.summary: To help her photographer boyfriend, she meets new people and enters different worlds, gradually discovering a hidden side of herself. Her ending depends on the choices you make.

games.name: Shadow Saw Us
games.summary: After their grandfather’s passing, Bell and Mark inherit the burden he left behind as the spirits he once sealed begin to break free. With the help of Banana, a Tani spirit and his old friend, they must help people, search for enchanted blades, and face dangerous spirits like Isacus.

games.name: Shale
games.summary: Discover the abandoned world of Shale in this 1-3 player action adventure. Shoot, craft and loot through cities of possessed creatures, industrial parks of corrupted bodies and fields of forgotten souls.

games.name: Shamania
games.summary: Shamania is an open world survival game. Get ready to farm, craft, build and fight, but with a unique feature: use your shamanic skills to your advantage in creative ways! Survive in this sandbox with your friends in CO-OP mode.

games.name: Signalfall
games.summary: Crash-land on a hostile planet and build automated extraction outposts to survive. Defend your operations, manage power networks, and send resources to orbit to unlock new technologies.

games.name: Snip Snap
games.summary: Test your reaction speed and precision in this exciting game!

games.name: Solis
games.summary:
Solis is a hand-drawn adventure about technology and deception in a city at night.
During a company trip you explore the city of Solis from dusk till dawn, talking with its inhabitants and meeting colleagues. This night you learn the painful truth about the company you work for. Will you remain loyal?
In the game you explore an atmospheric and compact open world. Decisions within the game carry weight, influencing subsequent events, while the in-game text adjusts to reflect your choices.

In Solis you explore the city, investigate your surroundings and talk with the inhabitants and colleagues you meet. Decisions within the game carry weight, influencing subsequent events, while the in-game text dynamically adjusts to reflect your choices. Interactions are streamlined to utilize a single button, aided by context-sensitive interaction icons. The GUI is a sparse as possible. Solis offers multiple endings and is crafted to be concise and compact. The complete game is estimated to run for approximately 2,5 hours.

games.name: Starvester
games.summary: A short incremental game about expanding a star-system wide factory to build giant megastructures in space. Deploy swarms of drones, mine resources, unlock upgrades and harvest the power of the stars!

games.name: SubZero
games.summary: A frozen apocalypse. Three unique survivors join you. Lead them through the icy wasteland! Zombie whispers, blizzards blur morality... Hope or doom? The fateful die burns in your grip.

games.name: Tail of Glory
games.summary: A charming 2D adventure where a witty thief solves puzzles with knives, potions, and magic books. Light, humorous, and easy to play — a small game crafted with heart and full of unexpected moments.

games.name: Teeth Cutter
games.summary: A collection of short horror experiences meant to give you horror, disgust, curiosity, dread and much much more

games.name: The Rainy Night
games.summary: On a rainy night, it's all up to you whether to show love or be cruel.

games.name: The Retro Exorcist
games.summary: You've been hired to perform exorcisms on all sorts of entities. The only thing you can't seem to understand is...why do they all haunt video games?

games.name: TimelineTown
games.summary: Invite friends to TimelineTown and grow your SNS together! Enjoy a relaxing sandbox-style simulation where numbers keep rising and new features unlock as your SNS levels up. Create trends, chat, and make posts go viral!

games.name: To Kill Eros
games.summary: To Kill Eros is a drama-filled BL Visual Novel exploring the flavors of love and the depth between people who join hands — while also blaming Eros for everything, of course!

games.name: Trakonius
games.summary: A gladiator fighting for his freedom in the sands of the arena... Unaware of the prophecy, Trakonius has fallen into the arena through the machinations of the senate. Even the gods will help him in his tough battle for freedom in the name of justice, but still can he win his freedom?

games.name: Truck Driver: The American Dream
games.summary:
Truck Driver: The American Dream is a truck-driving simulation game that is setting out to mix storytelling.

Start from the bottom and work your way to the top in the name of getting your life together and chasing the American Dream.

games.name: Under Kingdom: Scam Centre Simulator
games.summary: Run your own scam centre and pay off your debt. Expand your business by recruiting workers through shady means. Bribe the police, trade with others, and use every strategy to survive in this city. Will you rise to power or fall under the pressure? The choice is yours.

games.name: Vem, Exu
games.summary:
Vem, Exu is a narrative adventure game about anger, memory and reconciliation. After losing his kite during a fight with his brother, Exu falls asleep carrying his rage and enters a storm where dreams, memories and imagination merge together.

Players progress through the story by interacting with symbolic environments and completing simple activities such as connecting stars, bursting bubbles and rebuilding objects. Inspired by Brazilian culture, cordel art and Afro-Brazilian symbolism, the game focuses on visual storytelling and emotional progression.

games.name: VoxelMancy
games.summary: Dive into VoxelMancy, a revolutionary online voxel sandbox where you can build anything imaginable with friends! Forget simple cubes – sculpt slopes, curves, and structures of any size with over 1500 PBR materials. Your imagination is the only limit!

games.name: When We Arrive
games.summary: When We Arrive is a co-op travel game set in a fantasy world, where you and your friends embark on a shared journey. Play as a hunter, mage, or warrior, manage your supplies, discover hidden treasures, and make sure you all reach your destination safely.

games.name: Zoo Orbs: Safari
games.summary: Stack, Merge and Reach the Giraffe

games.name: 100 Music Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: Action Janken
games.summary: Ever heard how Every Game is just Rock, Paper, Scissors? This one takes it literally.

games.name: Aromantic Confession
games.summary:
Two friends reconnect after one spent a few months abroad. One is looking to hang out, but the other fell in love and is looking to confess...

Aromantic Confession is a dating sim that explores the aromantic experience during a love confession. Think about it: one person stammers out a few words while caught up in a swell of emotion, and the other doesn't understand that experience at any level.

games.name: Backrooms: The Twisted One
games.summary: Backrooms: The Twisted One is a tense horror escape experience set in the classic yellow liminal halls of the Backrooms. Explore 3 levels across Normal and Hard difficulties while haunted doll entities stalk your every move. They freeze when watched, but the moment you look away, they close in. Search the maze for collectible VHS tapes, stay alert, and find your way out before the twisted ones reach you.

games.name: Backrooms: The Wrong Door
games.summary: Backrooms: The Wrong Door is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1-4 players. A single wrong door leads you into a shifting nightmare where reality feels broken, familiar places become hostile, and every step forward may bring you closer to something watching from the dark.

games.name: Car Sales Simulator
games.summary: Grow from a small dealer into a successful automotive tycoon.

games.name: Cat in a Jam: City Secrets
games.summary: A mysterious feline adventure! An emotional and light-hearted story that proves that, sometimes, what we are looking for is closer than we think.

games.name: Crossbars
games.summary: Get ready for the ultimate downhill mountain biking experience in Crossbars, where speed, skill, and adventure collide. Set across four stunning, mountainous islands, Crossbars challenges you to race through 20 thrilling tracks, each with its own unique terrain and environmental hazards. From rocky cliffs and forested trails to muddy paths and open hills, every track offers a new adventure—will you stick to the main path and race against the clock, or venture off-road and discover hidden secrets?

games.name: Dawn of Corruption
games.summary: Dawn of Corruption is a Dark Fantasy NSFW RPG. Warning, this game is nsfw 18+ only. It features male gay characters and fetishes such as: Muscle Growth, Macro, Hyper, Goo, Transformation, Corruption What will you grow into? Will corruption seep into your being?

games.name: Draw Save Puzzle
games.summary: Draw to save Stickman from deadly traps and puzzles!

games.name: Evil of Fate
games.summary: Evil Of Fate is a horror-thriller game. Features first- and third-person weapon mechanics Experience this fascinating and frightening atmosphere with up to 4 friends. Fight in a universe where a witch has imprisoned people.

games.name: Fathoms
games.summary: Hop into a ship and escape! With the help of an aquatic ally, you pilot an underwater vessel in an attempt to escape the clutches of the Sea Intelligence Bureau.

games.name: Fish House Simulator
games.summary: Catch it, cook it… or sell it under the table. In Fish House, catch fish, cook, and serve customers! Upgrade your gear, catch valuable fish, and grow your restaurant. Not everything is legal—some fish are risky but profitable. Every fish ends up on a plate… some leave through the back door.

games.name: Foobse
games.summary:
Foobse is a competitive multiplayer trivia game where knowledge and speed determine the winner. Challenge players in real-time quiz battles across multiple categories and climb the global leaderboard.

Play in Solo, 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 6-player Battle Royale, and 12-player Battle Royale modes. Answer quickly, outscore your opponents, and become the world's top-ranked Foobse player.

games.name: Hentai Age Airport
games.summary: Enjoy a tranquil puzzle adventure where every completed challenge reveals another stunning portrait. Free from stress and designed for pure relaxation, it offers a calming escape filled with gentle gameplay and beautiful imagery.

games.name: Nights of the Sleeping God
games.summary: Highly moddable classical roguelike with persistence dungeons and fully simulated physics and chemistry.

games.name: Nine Spaces
games.summary:
Nine rooms filled with scattered thoughts, surreal visuals, hand drawn characters, and atmospheric audio.

This is a short "look around and walk" type of experience inspired by Don's Soup 0.9.

games.name: Roll'N With Da Punchez
games.summary:
"Roll'N With Da Punchez" is a stylistic, physics-based platformer with a unique twist! Punch a ball through challenging obstacle courses, and reach the goal as fast as possible!

But stay alert of your surroundings, as one wrong move could send the ball plummeting back down!

Don't let that get you down though! Roll With The Punches and Try Again!

games.name: Signal Zero
games.summary: Humanity is enslaved by AI. Your keyboard is the last weapon. Inject viruses into the AI network and liberate 20 countries in this pandemic-style idle strategy. Build your virus, spread the infection, sever the AI's bandwidth. Full localization, 16 achievements.

games.name: The Legend of You
games.summary: Shape a fantasy realm with your words. Choose your hero’s tale, recruit, train, and equip allies, and battle through turn-based encounters of your own design. Each victory writes your legend, each choice brings you closer to the ultimate treasure.

games.name: This Game Is Not Real
games.summary: You are [GAME]. A universally hated destructive mental health horror novel, where you [TALK] with a slightly delusional game developer, debug their creation, and guide the game to “completion.”

games.name: Vesperis
games.summary: Vesperis is a first-person horror game that takes players on a journey filled with mystery and fear. Explore a chilling environment, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Immerse yourself in a story full of dark secrets and horrors lurking beneath history.

games.name: Vigil in the Mist
games.summary: This is an atmospheric survival horror game, where you are stranded on a watchtower. Something knows you're there... and alone. Contact help, and use what you have to survive.

games.name: Chicken TD: Defenders of the Coop
games.summary: Chicken TD is a unique tower defense game where you strategically summon and upgrade creature towers to defend your coop from waves of enemies, while also engaging in Souls-like melee combat with a chosen weapon to directly hold the line and collect meta-progression currency.

games.name: City Pixel Transporters
games.summary: Build your city in two dimensions.

games.name: Dancing Line
games.summary:
Dancing Line combines fast-paced gameplay with a carefully selected soundtrack to create an experience like no other. Featuring different worlds of increasing difficulty, each one paints a unique picture and evokes different emotions. The key is to not only watch for obstacles and traps, but also play to the music. Listen to the beat and the melody, and after a short while you will find yourself doing better and better.

Come on! Test your reflexes and rhythm skills! See the surprises and wonders every level holds for you.

games.name: Drowning in a Sea of Blue
games.summary: 「drowning in a sea of blue」is a short, linear game made in RPG Maker VX Ace, with some puzzle and exploration elements. Walk around a near-abandoned world, talk to [OCTOPUSES], and attempt to convince Mr. Octopus to rebuild it, together with your friends named [FRIEND], [HALF], and [OTHER HALF].

games.name: Ethereal Storm
games.summary: Survive the Ethereal Storm — a thrilling 4-player co-op bullet hell with an FF5-inspired job system, layered building mechanics, and expansive Skyrim-style quests. Play solo or team up for explosive fun!

games.name: Generalskie kotly
games.summary: A humorous parody game based on a popular meme. Despite its short length, every single detail in this project has been meticulously thought out.

games.name: Gohei
games.summary: Your vocabulary is your weapon. Purge yokai with the power of words. A roguelike word-association game judged by AI.

games.name: Hidden Rabbit 2
games.summary: Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of a special location, and in a theme-filled place teeming with bunnies, try to find 100 cute little rabbits and 30 carrots hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

games.name: Linebound
games.summary: One player navigates. One player creates. Linebound is a 2D asymmetric co-op puzzle platformer where one player navigates the world while the other draws platforms in real time. Progress is only possible through communication.

games.name: Lord and Maiden
games.summary: "Lord and Maiden" is a fantasy simulation building and girl-raising strategy game. Freely plan the development of your city-state, explore secret realms, challenge powerful enemies, and form alliances of up to 100 players to fight together and create your ideal home.

games.name: Noema
games.summary: Noema is a first-person puzzle game about perception, hidden systems and the fragile line between logic and distortion.

games.name: Nomia
games.summary:
Nomia is a story-rich tactics roguelike where two heroes coordinate to execute brilliant skill combos.

Guide a warrior and a wizard through a mystifying tale. Harness grid-based strategy and deep deckbuilding mechanics to battle gorgeously illustrated foes. Blast monsters off cliffs, steal their cards, and sling spear and spell to reach the horizon.

games.name: Nova Strider
games.summary: An indie top-down sci-fi score-attack game about blowing up aliens in the upper atmosphere! Compete against your friends locally and see who can get the highest score on the leaderboard.

games.name: Project Threshold
games.summary:
You are a participant in Project Threshold, an experiment designed to force people to confront their deepest fears. Pass through sets of blue and red doors, survive what waits beyond them, and reach the end, if escape is even possible.

Project Threshold is a psychological horror and memory-based walking simulator where players must confront the fears and horrors waiting beyond each threshold.

games.name: Raise-a-Wish
games.summary:
A daughter raising visual novel project inspired by titles like Princess Maker and Tamagotchi where you play as an unnamed protagonist to raise a member of Phase Invaders Wish.

Guide Dizzy, Lumi, Jelly, and Ember through their short yet eventful lives, learn their stories, and raise them as if they've always been yours. Don't let them down!

games.name: Reincarnated as a Dark Lord Before Taking Over the World with Power 999999999
games.summary: An idle RPG where you play as a dark lord with the power to reincarnate. Choose different paths with each life to grow progressively stronger, eventually gaining enough power to conquer the world.

games.name: Sanctum Mage
games.summary: 《Sanctum Mage》is a magic-fantasy roguelite action-adventure game. you will: forge dynamic combat strategies, combine randomly empowered arcane blessings, and pilot enchanted war machines to break through swarms of foes.

games.name: Starship Theory
games.summary: Starship Theory is a ship building survival game. Mine and trade to gather resources. Plan and construct new upgrades. Train and manage crew. Fight to survive.

games.name: The Endless Night
games.summary:
The Endless Night is an urban fantasy roguelite deck-builder where modern mages battle cultists, monsters, and creeping darkness across a city on the edge of collapse.

Build a deck of spell cards, chain magical combos, protect civilians, gather allies, and choose which threats to confront before the night spirals out of control. Each run challenges you to balance power, survival, and corruption as dark rituals spread through the city and an Avatar of Darkness waits to be summoned.

games.name: The Hand of the Crownbearer
games.summary: “The Hand of the Crown-Bearer” is a character-training adventure game where you develop the protagonist while building relationships with specific characters. With numerous branching paths and a higher difficulty level, your choices shape the story. One playthrough lasts about two hours.

games.name: Welcome to your Life
games.summary: A game about life and work

games.name: Where the Forest Ends
games.summary: Where the forest end is a story-driven, top-down horror shooter set in a zombie-infested post-apocalypse. Visceral, grounded, and realistic. A fresh take on a classic genre.

games.name: Where's Our Ouis?
games.summary:
An entry for the 2026 itemLabel "Friends of Peepy" Art Contest.
This game follows itemLabel's own Professor Item and Assistant Label as they navigate the Juldarian Jungle, keen to solve the mystery of the missing Ouioui crisis.

games.name: Yclept
games.summary: A grim adventure where the King is destroying his own city, and you must stop him. To survive, you must navigate the game board, hunt down and eliminate his accomplices, and frame others to draw the King's wrath away from yourself.
